sanskrit: vidyārṇavākhye tantre prathamaḥ śvāsaḥdvitīyaḥ śvāsaḥśvāsaḥcaturthaḥ śvāsaḥpañcamaḥ śvāsaḥśrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ śvāsaḥaṇimādibhirāvṛtāṃ mayūkhairahamityeva vibhāvaye bhavānīmśrotrayorbhujayoḥ pṛṣṭhe jānvornābhau ca vinyasetmūlavidyāṃ pṛthaṅnyaset tritārādi yathākramamsphicordhvajāgre cādhāre mūlādhāre ca vinyasetanāhate viśuddhau ca lambike bhrūyugāntaresundarī tripurādyā ca tathā tripuravāsinīsaptamī tripurāsiddhā tripurāmbāṣṭamī bhavetnavacakreṣu vinyasediti nyāsaḥ samīritaḥmāṃ rakṣayugalaṃ proktvā ṣaḍaṅgānyatra vinyasetkuryācca sādhako bījaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥvidyāpañcadaśīmūlaṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥśrīvidyāṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'yamudāhṛtaḥsvatantrā ca tato nityāluptaśaktistataḥ paramṣaḍaṅgayuvatīnyāsaḥ proktaḥ sarvārthasiddhayesarvajñatāśatidhāmne ityādi prāgvadīritaḥlāvaṇyalīlākhilayauvanāḍhyāḥ śrīdevadevyāstanavo yuvatyaḥsampūrṇāṃ cintayedvidyāṃ brahmarandhre'ruṇaprabhāmvāmāṃsadeśe saubhāgyadāṃgulīṃ bhrāmayettataḥpunaḥ sampūrṇayā devi galordhve vinyasettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāpakānte yonimudrāṃ mukhe kṣiptvābhivandya casammohanākhyo deveśi nyāso'yaṃ kṣobhakārakaḥpādayorjaṅghayorjānvoḥ kaṭyorandhuni pṛṣṭhakekarṇayorbrahmarandhre ca vadane caiva pārvatisaṃhāro'yaṃ mahānyāso bījaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kramātsṛṣṭyarthaṃ vinyaseddevi mātṛkāṃ pūrvavat priyetrividheti yaduktaṃ tu prakaṭīkuru śaṅkaraśivaśaktimayaṃ tattra kathayāmi tavānaghepūrvaṃ guṇaistu kathitā śivaśaktyātmikāṃ śṛṇuhakāraḥ parameśāni kevalaṃ śiva ucyateyaducyate mātṛkārṇaistatsarvamahamīśvaraḥsakāraḥ śaktirūpatvāt paravācī ca sargavānātmānaṃ darśayedyogaḥ so'haṃśabdena sundarinādarūpeṇa sā devī hakārārdhasvarūpiṇītasyārdhāṅgaṃ mahāśaktirhakārārdhasvarūpiṇīnityeti kathyate devi citkalā paradevatāprātarutthāya deveśi guruṃ smṛtvā svanāmabhiḥsarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyaḥ karpūraghusṛṇādibhiḥnavaratnavibhūṣāḍhyo raktāmbaravirājitaḥyāgamaṇḍapamāsādya lākṣācitravicitritamgomayena ca saṃliptaṃ cārupuṣpavitānitammantroddhāraṃ prakurvīta sarvakāryārthasiddhayekumāryāstu tṛtīyaṃ tu tripurā parameśvarikumārī tu dvitīyā sā tripureśī maheśvarianayā cāsanaṃ vidyāt tripureśyā ṣaḍaṅgakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakrāsanagatāviddhi devi tripuravāsinīśivacandrasamāyuktā tārtīye śivarūpiṇīātmāsanagatāyāstu hitvā tārtīyamadrijesādhyasiddhāsanagatā viddhi tripuramālinībinduṃ hitvā tatra sargaṃ nikṣipet surasundarisarvadarśanavandyāṃ ca citkalāmavyayāṃ śiveardhacandraśca binduśca navārṇo merurucyatelakārāt pṛthivī devī saśailaṃvanakānanāsakārācandratārādigraharāśisvarūpiṇīīkārādviśvamūrtiryā mahāturyātmikā priyerakārāt tejasā yuktā parajyotiḥsvarūpiṇīardhacandreṇa deveśi viśvayoniritīritāanayā saha sarvatra vyāptirniścalatātmanāevaṃ ca navabhirvarṇairjāyate tripurāmanuḥśrīcakramapi deveśi merurūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥsakāraścandramā bhadre kalāṣoḍaśakātmakamaṣṭamūrtiḥ sadā bhadre tasmādvasudalaṃ bhavetpālayantī parā tasmācchakrakoṇaṃ bhavet priyeviśvayoniriti khyātā sā viṣṇordaśarūpakādaśakoṇaparā tasmādrakārājjyotiravyayaḥkakārānmādanaṃ devi śivaṃ cāṣṭasvarūpakamardhamātrā guṇān sūte bhedarūpā yatastataḥkāmeśvarasya rūpaṃ tadviśvādhārasvarūpakamagastyanandisūryāśca viṣṇuskandaśivāstathāsmṛtāḥ śakraśca cotmanī caiva tathā ca varuṇastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākopāsakānāṃ maheśvarisakalā bhuvaneśānī kāmeśībījamuttamamśaktyantastūryavarṇo'yaṃ kalāmadhye sulocanemādanaṃ śivacandrādyaṃ śivāntaṃ mīnalocanesarvasākṣimayī nityā sarvayonimayī parāsarvadevamayī sākṣāt sarvasaubhāgyasundarīkena kenopāsiteyaṃ viśadīkuru śaṅkarakāmarājākhyavidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ turyaṃ ca sundarieṣā vidyā kāmarājapūjitaiva na saṃśayaḥkāmarājākhyavidyāyā vāgbhavena varānaneśivaṃ kuryādvāgbhave tu śivādyaṃ kāmarājakammādanaṃ kāmabījaṃ tu śaktibījaṃ hasānanammādanaṃ kāmabīje tu tārtīyaṃ ṛṇu pārvatiśaktibījaṃ sahādyaṃ syādvidyāgastyaprapūjitācandraṃ tatraiva saṃyojya kāmarāje tataḥ paramśaktibījaṃ varārohe candrādyaṃ sarvasiddhidamśaktibīje sthitāṃ devi candrādhaḥ kuru tatra cakāmarāje bhṛguṃ hitvā mukhe kuryāttameva hieṣā vidyā vārārohe tripurā sūryapūjitālopāmudrā dvitīyāṃ tu vilikhya surasundarihitvā tu bhuvaneśānīmekocāreṇa coccaretnandikeśvaravidyāṃ ca ṣaṭkūṭā vaiṣṇavī bhavetyā sthitā bhuvaneśānī dvidhā kuru maheśvaridurvāsasā purā devi niṣkalā pūjitā parātvaṃ manohāriṇī yasmāt kathyate bhuvi durlabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmākṣibindunādāḍhyaṃ viśvamātṛkalānvitamutpattirjāgaro bodho vyāvṛttirmanasastathājāgrat sattvaguṇā proktā kevalaṃ śaktirūpiṇīvaiṣṇavī vasukūṭā syāt ṣaṭkūṭā śāṅkarī bhavetlajjābījādikūṭaistu proktā jāgararūpakāḥjāgratsvarūpā śrīvidyā caturddhā sā prakīrtitāvaiṣṇavī saptakūṭā syātpañcakūṭā tu śāṅkarīmāyālakṣmyādikāścaitā abhilāṣasvarūpakāḥramāmāyādikāścintārūpiṇyaḥ kūṭayojitāḥpaścakūṭā bhavantyete vasukūṭā tu vaiṣṇavīvedādibījayugalayogāt sarvāḥ samīritāḥmaraṇaṃ vismṛtirmūrcchā nidrā ca tamasāvṛtātāramāyādikāścaiva māyātārādikāstathātadā bhedāstu sakalāḥ ṣaṭkūṭāḥ parameśvariasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa jagadānanditaṃ bhavetyasya vijñānamātreṇa brahma sākṣānna saṃśayaḥavasthāśeṣatāṃ prāptā turyā tu parameśvarivairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ samādhirvimalaṃ manaḥādyabījadvayaṃ bhadre viparītakrameṇa tuantarmukhī vārārohe kumārī tripureśvarīṣaṭkūṭāṃ parameśāni vidyeyaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarīvaiṣṇavyekonaviṃśārṇā śaivī saptadaśākṣarīkāmabījaṃ samālikhya vāgbījaṃ tadanantarampraṇavaṃ bhuvaneśānīṃ ramāṃ caiva maheśvarivyutkramāt parameśāni pūrvoktaṃ bījapañcakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktyādibījaiśca vilomataḥ sā śrīṣoḍaśīyaṃ ca śivapradiṣṭāharipriyā trikūṭā sā parā vāṇī manobhavaḥbālāṃ cāntarmukhīṃ kṛtvā vilikhettadanantarambālādi saṃpuṭāṃ kuryādramākhyāṃ parameśvariviparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsaṃpuṭaṃ smṛtamvedādirbhuvaneśānī śrībījaṃ ca trikūṭakambālāntaḥ saṃsthitaṃ bījaṃ praṇavaṃ ca tataḥ paramlopāṃ vā kāmarājaṃ vā trikūṭāmathavā parāmviparītakrameṇaiva vinyaset ṣoḍaśī parāśrīṣoḍaśākṣaramihāgamasuprasiddhambījaṃ pañcakamitthamevamuditaṃ sarvārthasiddhipradamsārātsāratarā samastajagatāmutpattibhūtā śivāvarṇituṃ naiva śakye'haṃ śrīvidyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarīmyato nirakṣaraṃ vastu parā tatraiva kāraṇambrahmavidyāsvarūpā hi bhuktimuktiphalapradāaśvamedhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathātulāṃ nārhanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā na prakāśyā kadācanaṣoḍaśīyaṃ sugopyā hi snehāddevi prakāśitārājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyā ṣoḍaśākṣarīkālī kāmakalā kūrcaḥ sarvādau praṇavaḥ priyejñānena mṛtyuhā vidyā sarvāmnāyairnamaskṛtātāsāṃ sāratamā bhūtā yā yā vidyāḥ sugopitāḥprakāśitā mahādevi yā pṛṣṭā te punaḥ punaḥtadā saptadaśavidyā sākṣājjñānasvarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakāraṃ kāmarājādau lopā tu ṣoḍaśākṣarīṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā cidbrahmakyamayī śubhātathaiva śaktibīje tu lopā saptadaśākṣarīaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīśaḥ sākṣādbhūmipurandaraḥmādanaṃ kāmabījādye tartīyādye maheśvariaṣṭādaśākṣarī hyeṣā śrīvidyā bhuvi durlabhānavalakṣaṃ japitvā tu lopāmudrāṃ maheśvarianyathā śāpamāpnoti kulaṃ tasya vinaśyatisarvasaubhāgyadā devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇībhuvaneśīṃ kāmarāje śrībījaṃ śaktipūrvataḥbhogamokṣapradā sākṣāt puruṣārthapradāyikānāsti nāsti punarnāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyahamkāmākṣaraṃ śaktivarṇaṃ purandaraharau tataḥpraṇavaṃ savisargaṃ ca punaśca kulasundarīṃpraṇavaṃ savisargaṃ tu tato vai kulasundarīmvilomāṃ bālikāṃ tatra brahmārṇaḥ savisargakaḥasyā lakṣajapenaiva kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtalenādabindukalābhedāt turīyasvarasaṃyutamkakāre sarvamutpannaṃ kāmakaivalyadāyakamevaṃ bījatrayaṃ devi vidyānāṃ sārasaṃgrahamekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalamādyabhūtairvidyamānā sundarī ṣaḍvidhā smṛtāramāmāyā tathā kāmo vasucandrākṣarī tridhājātavedomṛgāṅkena lāñchitaṃ parameśvarivāmanetreṇa saṃyukto nādabinduvibhūṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prathamā sundarī devī dvitīyā brahmasundarīeṣā tu ṣoḍaśī vidyā matabhedena darśitāeṣā śrīprāṇasaṃyuktā dāridryaduḥkhanāśinīmahāmāyā tataḥ paścāttavasnehāt prakīrtitamiti śaktī mahāvidyā paścimāmnāyayojitāvyomavahnisamāyuktaṃ turīyasvarabindukameṣā vidyā maheśāni varṇituṃ naiva śakyatekāmaṃ vyoma ca deveśi mahāmāyā tataḥ paramrudraśaktiriyaṃ devi pūrvāmnāye hi yojitānādabindusamāyuktaḥ kathitaḥ parameśvarimāyābindusanādena kāmarājaṃ samuddharetbindunādasamākrāntaḥ kathitaḥ kāmado manuḥarihā siddhidā devī mahātripurasundarīpurandaro mahāmāyā vāgbhavaṃ bījamuttamamvāmākṣivahnicandrāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvaribhuvaneśī tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ tvayiśaktiḥ svayambhūḥ śambhuśca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarīkāmaḥ śivastato brahmā indraśca bhuvaneśvarītrikūṭānte haṃsabījaṃ tadā saptadaśī bhavetmānmathaṃ śivaśaktī ca mādano hara indrakaḥcandraḥ prajāpatiḥ śakro mahāmāyā tataḥ paramsarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā viṃśākṣarī tadā bhavetbrahmā śivendrau śaktiśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parāśivendrakāmarudrāśca candraśca parameśvarīkāmaścandro maheśaśca indraḥ śaktiśca pārvatī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaśaktī mādanendrau śivo vahnīndumāyayāvāgbhavaṃ kathitaṃ caitatkāmarājaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuśivaḥ śaktiśca somaśca śūnyo brahmā maheśvarīidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yadi cāsti kṛpā mayimaheśo brahma haṃsaśca indro'pi bhuvaneśvarīagnimāyākalāyuktaṃ nādabinduvibhūṣitambrahmā maheśa indraśca śaktiśca bhuvaneśvarīmādanaṃ somacandrau ca śakraśca bhuvaneśvarīvāmakeśvara vidyaiva trikūṭakramapāṭhitātripurāyā mahāvidyā kūṭaikādaśanirmitāmahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścādvāgbhavaṃ bījamuddharetmāyāsvareṇa saṃyuktaṃ nādabindukalānvitamviyadviṣṇuyutaṃ kāmo haṃsaḥ śakrastataḥ paramindrabījaṃ tataḥ paścānmahāmāyāṃ samuddharetmahāmāyāṃ tataḥ paścācchaktikūṭaṃ samuddharetmadhyakūṭatrayaṃ devi kāmarājaṃ manoharamvāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ kūṭaṃ kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakamjīvaprāṇau mahādevi mādanaṃ tadanantaramkūṭatrayaṃ kāmarājaṃ śaktibījaṃ (kūṭaṃ) ca pūrvavatarihā siddhidā vidyā sarvadoṣavivarjitāmadhye ṣaḍakṣaraṃ caiva śaktiśca caturakṣarātadadho haṃsabījaṃ tu indrabījaṃ vicintayettadadhaścandrabījaṃ tu pṛthvībījaṃ tato likhetramāṃ māyāṃ haṃsabījaṃ vāgbhavādye niyojayetebhiryuktena deveśi vidyājapanamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktyante tu maheśāni haṃsaṃ māyāṃ ramāṃ tathāmāyābindvīśvarayutaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhamvāntaṃ vahnisamāyuktaṃ vāmanetreṇa bhūṣitamdvitīyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tu japeduktvā tu sundarīmnādabindusamāyuktaṃ māyābījaṃ prakīrtitamkulākulamaye madhye dhyeyaṃ sākṣānmaheśvarietajjaptvā tataḥ paścādvāgbhavākhyaṃ samuddharetkāmarājaṃ tato japtvā trailokyakṣobhakārakamsvapnāvatīṃ mahādevi prajapecca samāhitaḥmadhumatīṃ tato japtvā māyāṃ śrīkūrcabījakametadbījaṃ samuccārya śaktikūṭaṃ tato japetkāmarājādividyānāṃ dīpinīṃ caiva kārayetsaptatriṃśatprabhedena ṣaṭtriṃśattatvarūpiṇīśrīkaṇṭhadaśakaṃ tadvadavyaktasya hi vācakamśivakāmaharendrāṃśca bhuvaneśīmataḥ paramunmanyāḥ kāmarājaṃ tu candrahaṃsau tu mādanamśivayormādanaṃ māyā tārtīyaṃ varuṇasya caśivacandrendramadanā bhūmiśca bhuvaneśvarīvahnīnopāsitā vidyā bhogamokṣaphalapradāsakalā vahnibhūmiśca bhuvaneśīṃ samuddharetśivamādanabhūmiśca rahalā bhuvaneśvarīvāyūpāsitavidyeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradāśivamādanasūryendravahnayo bhuvaneśvarībudhopāsitavidyeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradāśivamādanabhūmiśca śivendrendrānalāstathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devatāyai nivedyātha taṃ japaṃ saṃpade tataḥsuvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ karakaṃ jalapūritampaścimāsyāṃ khaḍgakheṭadhāriṇīṃ siṃhasaṃsthitāmbhramedantastu rakṣeti lokeśānāmitīrayansvasthāne sthāpayettaṃ tu phaṇmantreṇa tato'rcayettato vahniṃ susaṃskṛtya caruṃ gopayasā pacetmūlāṇunābhimantryātha taṇḍulāñśālisambhavānprakṣālitena pātreṇa pātravaktraṃ pidhāya capaced guruḥ prāṅmukhastu svinne tamabhidhārayethuṃmantreṇāstrasaṃjapte kuśāstīrṇe vibhajya tatśiṣṭaṃ śiṣyeṇa sahito gururbhuñjīta mantravitprādeśamātraṃ hṛñjaptaṃ yathoktaṃ dantadhāvanamgadito'dhivāsaḥmṛṇmayyaudumbarī vāpi carusthālī praśasyatenacātiśithilaḥ pācyo na ca vītaraso bhavetniṣpannasya ca te sarve vidheyāḥ syuḥ krameṇa vaisusaṃskṛte guroḥ kuṇḍe saṃskāraiśca yathāvidhimūlāṇunā ca saṃvīkṣya saṃprokṣyāstrāṇunā tataḥkhananaṃ syācchareṇātha tenaivoddhāra īritaḥkavacenātha śastreṇa kuṭṭanaṃ varmaṇā matamkuryāt trisūtrīkaraṇaṃ namomantreṇa pūrayetkavacenendriyāṇāṃ cāpyudghāṭanamathācaretsaṃskuryādathavā tāni caturbhiḥ prathamoditaiḥaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu hṛdayenātha pūrayettrisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ hṛdā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tenaiva vidhinā nābhiṃ pūjayeccandrasannibhāmkuṇḍabhittigaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varmaṇā paribhūṣayetudaṅmukhāgrarekhāṇāṃ brahmasūryendavaḥ kramātudagagraṃ puraḥsaṃsthaṃ paścimārambhamālikhetbhūmāvabhyantare kuṇḍe dakṣiṇāśāditaḥ kramātpratyagbhāgātsamārabhya yāvatpūrvāvadhiṃ tathāatīndriyābhāṃ sakalajagadātmasvarūpiṇīmśaktimantreṇa tāṃ śaktimīśānaṃ mūlamantrataḥkulīnadvijagehotthaṃ pātre hutavahaṃ tataḥdevāṃśa mūlamantreṇa sthāpayedagrataḥ sudhīḥpradīpakalikākāraṃ teja āvāhya yatnataḥsmṛtvāgnibījakenāsya caitanyaṃ yojayedathasaṃrakṣya ca śareṇātha kavacenāvaguṇṭhayetpraṇavena tataḥ svasya sammukhaṃ svīyakuṇḍakeśivabījamiti dhyātvā nikṣipedāśuśukṣaṇimlakṣmyākṛtipadaṃ prāptā amṛtāmṛtajīvanītayoḥ saṃgamayogena vahniḥ sañjātasaṃsthitiḥgrāmyadharmeṇa sañjātamagniṃ tatra vicintayetagnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāccharāve tādṛśe'pi vākravyādāṃśaṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ tyajedastreṇa pārvatināgnipraṇayanaṃ kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvahamdahayugmaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ ājñāpaya tato dviṭhaḥsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvatomukhamsaliṅgagudamūrdhāsyanāsānetreṣu ca kramāthiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: analerārghibindvantasādiyāntākṣarānvitāḥvinyasedatiraktāntāḥ sarvāṅgebahurūpiṇīmsahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇa uttiṣṭha puruṣastathāaṅgamantrān kramādaṣṭa mūrtīścāpi pravinyasetpradakṣiṇyena vinyased yathāvaddeśikottamaḥaśvodarajasaṃjñaśca savaiśvānara eva casyuraṣṭa mūrtayo vahneragnaye padapūrvikāḥmekhalopari saṃśuddhaiḥ punardarbhacatuṣṭayaḥnikṣipet paridhīn brahmaviṣṇavīśāṃstatra pūjayetdvimekhale dvitīyāyāṃ madhyamāyāṃ trimekhalerandhraṃ kuryāttathā vidvān madhyasthamekhaloparisvagṛhyoktavidhānena vāyudeśāttato munetānyavokṣya pavitreṇa cottānāni vidhāya cadattvākṣatān pavitraṃ ca tadutpūya nidhāpayettataḥ kiñcit praṇītāmbu prokṣaṇyādāya tajjalaiḥtadbāhye vasumūrtīśca madhye vahniṃ tato yajetaṅgamantraistato bāhye cāṣṭabhiḥ mūrtibhiḥ kramātvaiśvānara jātaveda proktvā cehāvaheti cabrūyācca sādhayetyantaṃ vahnijāyāntiko manuḥkṛśānumaṅgāni mūrtayaḥ śaktisvastikodyatadordvayāḥhiraṇyādyāḥ sthitā vahne rasanāḥ ṣaḍanukramāthiraṇyā taptahemābhā śūlapāṇidiśi sthitātaruṇādityasaṅkāśā raktā jihvāgnisaṃsthitāsuprabhā padmarāgābhā vāruṇyāṃ diśi saṃsthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bahurūpā yathārthābhā dakṣiṇottaramadhyagākarālā lelihā ceti kuṇḍaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitāḥrakṣovāruṇavāyavye marīcyādyaṃ trayaṃ tathāraktāgneyī nair-ṛtī ca kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matāp. 254) māraṇe nigaditā bhuvi kṛṣṇā suprabhā budhavarairiha śāntyāmvyāhṛtyanantaraṃ tena juhuyānmanunā triśaḥghṛtaṃ tatra samāpūrya vīkṣaṇādisusaṃskṛtamtāpanaṃ tu samuddiṣṭaṃ kuśadvayamataḥ kṣipetpavitrīkaraṇaṃ darbhadvayena jvalitena tuabhidyotanametat syāduddyotanamathocyatevahnābudvāsya ca ghṛtamaṅgārānagniṣu kṣipetastramantraṃ japanmantrī kuśau prādeśamātrakautato hṛdā kuśābhyāṃ tu svābhimukhyena samplavetadhamaṃ chāgalījātaṃ tasmādgavyaṃ praśasyatesvakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintya paritāpayetghṛtābhyāṃ saṃmukhaṃ vahnerastreṇotpavamācaretpratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśetkramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasyet hrāṃhrīṃhrūṃbījakaiḥ priyetrisūtraveṣṭitagrīvau pūjitau kusumādibhiḥbhūyo'gnau tau pratāpyātha kuśānagnau nivedayetmūlamadhyāgrake nyasecchaktīricchādikāḥ kramātsagranthi kṛtvā sāgraṃ dvau śuklakṛṣṇau vicintayetsuṣumnāṃ saṃsmarenmantrī tato homaṃ samācaretjuhuyāddakṣanetre'gneḥ svāhāntāyāgnaye tataḥjuhuyācca hṛdā somāya svāheti ca deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdāṇunāgnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti juhuyāt sudhīḥvaktre vahneḥ sviṣṭakṛte svāheti ca tato guruḥjuhuyādagnimantreṇa trivāraṃ deśikottamaḥkriyāstāreṇa vai kuryādājyāhutyaṣṭabhiḥ kramātnālāpanayanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ saṃśodhya sūtakampitrorvisarjanaṃ kṛtvā cūḍopanayanādikamjātakarma tato nāmakaraṇaṃ copaniṣkramammahānāmnyaṃ mahāpūrvavrataṃ ca tadanantaramsamāvartanamudvāhaḥ saṃskārā maraṇāntikāḥsampādayāmi svāheti sarvakarmasvayaṃ vidhiḥjuhuyādrasanāṅgāṣṭamūrtimantraiḥ sakṛdghṛtaiḥtannāmānte niśitadhīḥ svāhāntaiśca yathākramamsvāhāvasāne juhuyāddhyāyanvai mantradevatāmnenaiva tāṃ pidhāyāgnau hunettiṣṭhan guruḥ svayamtārādyairdaśabhirmantraiḥ pūrvapūrvasamanvitaiḥjuhuyācca caturvāraṃ samastenaiva tena tujuhuyāt sarvahomeṣu sudhīranalatṛptayetārādibījaṣaṭkeṣukaraṇeṣvadrivarṇakaiḥagnirūpadharāṃ tatra pūjayediṣṭadevatāmhunenmantrī cā (jya ? gni) mukhe vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ matamekādaśātha mūlena hunedājyena cāhutīḥaṅgaprabhṛtyāvṛtīnāmekaikāmāhutiṃ hunetgururvahni praviharet saṃskṛteṣūktavartmanāsarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktāṃ mūlena juhuyustataḥtattaddravyeṇa hotavyaṃ tīrthenārṣeṇa vā tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mandāgnirāmayāvī ca daridraścopajāyatenakṣatrāṇāṃ savārāṇāṃ sarāśīnāṃ yathākramaṃtārāṇāmaśvinyādīnāṃ rāśiḥ pādādhikaṃ dvayamdevatābhyaḥ padaṃ proktvā divānaktaṃ vadettathāevaṃ rāśau tu sampūrṇe tasmiṃstadvat prayojayetsaptānāṃ karaṇānāṃ ca dadyānmīnāhvameṣayoḥpunarnivedyamuddhṛtya pūrvavat paripūjya castutvā yathāvat praṇamedbhaktiyuktastu sādhakaḥkulīrasiṃho ca tathā nair-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitānakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitamdvādaśaḥ śvāsaḥpunaḥ sādhyena manunā aṣṭottarasahasrakamśiṣyaṃ snātaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pāyayenmantravittamaḥhṛtpuṇḍarīkāccaitanyaṃ tasya svātmani yojayette kalātattvabhuvanārṇapadā mantrapūrvakāḥkalā nivṛttiprasukhāstadadhvā pañca kīrtitāḥtatra śaivāni tattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśatpramitānyathavidyā caitāni śuddhāni śuddhāśuddhāni sapta capuruṣaścāpyaśuddhāni prakṛtirbuddhyahaṃkṛtiḥuktāni śaivatattvāni ṣaṭtriṃśanmantravedibhiḥvakṣyante jīvasahitaḥ prāṇo buddhirmanastataḥhṛtpadmaṃ tejasāṃ caiva trayaṃ catvāra eva catanmātrāścendriyāṇi syurmano'haṅkārabuddhayaḥ(nivṛttyādyāḥ kalāḥ pañca tato bindukalā punaḥsapta tattvāni proktāni tantrajñaistripadātmanaḥ)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvatattvaṃ ca samproktāstattvādhvānastu deśikaiḥrasātalaśca tadanu talātala iti smṛtāḥsatyalokaśca samproktā lokā ete yathākramampadādhvā varṇavṛndaṃ syānmantrādhvā padasaṃcayaḥkūrcena ca guruḥ śiṣyaṃ spṛśan kuṇḍe svake hunetśodhayāmi dviṭhāntena mantreṇāṣṭāhutīḥ pṛthakpādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryāt pāpavimocanamsṛjet sṛṣṭyā vilīnāṃstāñ śivāntāṃśca gurūttamaḥtaccaitanyaṃ sthitaṃ tasmiṃstasminneva niyojayetaṅgaprabhṛtyā vṛtīnāṃ hunedbhūyo ghṛtena vaibhuvaḥ syādvāyave cāntarikṣāya ca yuto manuḥbhūrbhuvaḥsvaścandramase nakṣatrebhyaśca pūrvataḥmahate ca dviṭhāntāḥ syurmahāvyāhṛtimantrakāḥjuhuyādāhutīraṣṭau kevalājyena mantravitdehadharmādhikāraṃ ca jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣukarmaṇā caiva hastābhyāṃ padbhyāmuktvodareṇa cauktaṃ ya yatkṛtaṃ tacca sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavahutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ mantrī srucā mūlāṇunā tataḥnyūnātiriktapūrṇārthaṃ dadāmi saghṛtaṃ tilamyānulomāṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhopāntyasvarākulamsahasrārcirmahātejaḥ namaste bahurūpadhṛk (t)tvaṃ raudro raudrakarmā ca ghorahā tvaṃ namāmi tesarpiṣā srucamāpūrya puṣpaṃ coparyadhomukhamsavyottarakarābhyāṃ ca sampuṭābhyāṃ ca śaṅkhavatpūrṇādarvīti mantreṇa mūlena ca susaṃyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidhāya puṣpaṃ tasyāgre sruveṇādhomukhena tāmvauṣaḍantena juhuyāddhārāṃ japasamanvitāmvauṣaḍantena mantreṇa vaiṣṇavena surottamamtasyopari ghṛtaṃ dadyāttadūrdhvaṃ kusumādikamtadūrdhve'dhomukhaṃ kṛtvā sruvamutthāya mantravitmūlaṃ namontamuccārya vāmapādapuraḥsaramkarmāntare'pi saṃprāpte sannidhiṃ kuru sādaramkuṇḍādudvāsya cācāryo devatāṃ kalaśe nyasetsaptavyāhṛtyāgnijihvādīnāmekāhutiṃ kramātdvātriṃśatpalatāmreṇa nirmitaṃ tāmrapātrakamgururvṛtāya tattasmai pūrṇapātraṃ vidurbudhāḥtataḥ paristarānagnau paridhīn nikṣipannatuvastreṇa netramantreṇa śiṣyanetre nibadhya casumanobhiḥ prapūryāsya hyañjali kṣepayedghaṭenetrabandhamapāsyopaveśayet kuśasaṃstareajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayāataḥ pūjāvidhānena saṃharejjanayecca tampañcopacārairabhyarcya kalaśastheṣṭadevatāmathopaveśayecchiṣyaṃ bhūṣitaṃ maṇḍalāntareatha pañcaninādaiśca viprāśīrvacanaiḥ sahayena prakāreṇa purā pūritaśca sudhārasaiḥtathaivainaṃ cābhiṣiñcedāśu saṃpadavāptayetattoyairabhiṣiñcet taṃ rakṣāyai deśikottamaḥtaddevatāsvarūpaṃ ca vidadhyāt sakalīkṛtimācamya nikaṭe tasya niviśedvāgyataḥ śiśuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aikyaṃ gururvinītasya samyak tasya manuṃ triśaḥanyebhyastu vadedevamevaṃ mantrī vicakṣaṇaḥāgatāṃ bhāvayecchiṣyo dhanyo'smīti viśeṣataḥaṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ vā hyaṣṭakṛtvo'thavā japaḥpraṇāmaṃ vibhave kuryāt sādhako bhaktimān muhuḥhastābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca jānubhyāṃ vakṣasā tathāhastajānuśirovākyadhībhiḥ pañcāṅga īritaḥalaṃkārāṃśca vāsāsi dadyādṛtvigbhya ādarātpradadyādgurave śiṣyo vicāryārdhaṃ tadardhakamtadadhīnamanā nityaṃ taccittastatparāyaṇaḥsarvasvaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadājñayāgajāśvamahiṣīmeṣapaśudāsīmahīyutamsvadehaṃ svātmaprāṇāṃśca dadyāt svaśaktibhaktitaḥbrāhmaṇān bhojayetpaścāt pradadyādbhūridakṣiṇāmpuṃsprakṛtyātmakatvaṃ hi varṇānāṃ samudīritamtatastanau śiśornyasedvarṇān deśikasattamaḥdeśikendrasya sāmarthyādājñayā devatātmanaḥtatastu śiṣyacaitanyaṃ paramātmani yojayettasmiṃśca sṛṣṭikramatastaccaitanyaṃ punarnyasetjñānadārṇamayī dīkṣā kathitā sarvasiddhidākalā nivṛttipramukhā bhūtānāṃ pañca ceritāḥpādādijānuparyantaṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃsthitā kalānābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ vidyākhyā saṃsthitā kalābhālācchirovadhi proktā śāntyatītā kalā tathāsthāneṣvīśājñayā caiṣā kalādīkṣā samīritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturdale smaret patre mūlādhāre śiśostanautrirāvartamayīṃ devīṃ vidyutpuñjasvarūpiṇīmaṇoraṇīyasīṃ devīṃ cakraṣaṭkaprabhedinīmsāntān vādīn dalasthārṇān padmayonau samāharetsvādhiṣṭhāne guruḥ samyag yojayitvā tu vedhayetphāntaḍādyarṇasaṃyukte digdale vedhayet svayamṭhāntakādyarṇapatrābje vedhayedīśvare svayamkalāmayadale padme svarān saṃyojya yatnataḥdvidale hakṣasaṃyukte vedhayitvā tu deśikaḥkalāṃ nāde samāyojya nādaṃ nādāntake punaḥviṣuvaktraṃ svake vaktre saṃhared deśikaḥ svayamdeśikājñāvaśācchiṣyo dagdhājñānastadā kṣitausadāśivaḥ svayaṃ bhūyāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥcatasrastvevamuddiṣṭā dīkṣāḥ samyak śubhāvahāḥguruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ sparśadīkṣā bhavediyamuccaret saṃhatān mantrān vāgdīkṣeti nigadyatesamyakpaśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā sā bhavet priyesadyaḥ saṃjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matāantareṇopadiṣṭā ye mantrāḥ syurviphalā yataḥgurumantrāgamābhijñaṃ samayācārapālakamkañcitkālaṃ vidhāyaitat suśiṣyāyā samarpayettatastu śāśvatī muktiriti śaṅkarabhāṣitamsampradāyamavicchinnaṃ sadā kuryādguruḥ priyepaścādupadiśenmantramanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetdadato gṛhṇato devi kulaśāpo bhaviṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānopāsitā vidyā hyaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidānārāyaṇopāsiteyaṃ ṣaṭkūṭā bhuvi durlabhāśivamādanasūryenduvahniśca bhuvaneśvarīlopāvāgbhavakūṭaṃ tu jīvenārādhitātviyammāyāśrībījapūrvā tu svapnāvasyāsvarūpiṇīśrīmahāṣoḍaśārṇā tu turīyā samprakīrtitāsadasadvastunirdhārasturīyāyā imāḥ kalāḥmāyādiḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tu mumukṣutvasvarūpiṇīramādiḥ ṣoḍaśī cittavaimalyasya svarūpiṇīpañcadhā ṣoḍaśārṇā tu durlabhā bhuvanatrayebhedāḥ pūrvoktarītyā ca jñātavyāstantrakovidaiḥubhayātmakabhedāśca śavalāśca tathaiva caaśuddhā iti vijñeyā ubhayātmāna eva caevaṃ caturvidhā vidyā vijñeyā deśikottamaiḥyayā vijñātayā devi sākṣāt suraguruprabhaḥsvarāntaṃ pṛthivīsthaṃ tu turyasvarasamanvitamśakrasvarasamopeto vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matāmahāsaubhāgyajananī mahāsārasvatapradānyasecchirasi pūjyatvāt paṃktiśchando mukhe priyebījaṃ tu vāgbhavaṃ śaktistārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ tathānābhyādipādaparyantaṃ galādānābhi cāparamvāmapāṇitale caikaṃ dakṣapāṇitale tathāpañca bāṇān krameṇaiva karāṃguliṣu vinyasetthāntadvayaṃ samālikhya vahnisaṃsthaṃ krameṇa tubāṇadvayamidaṃ proktaṃ mādanaṃ bhūmisaṃsthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upadeśaṃ dadadgṛhṇan tau prayātāṃ piśācatāmbhuñjāte tāvubhau ghorān narakānekaviṃśatimvinyasyati ca taṃ mantraṃ saikate śālibījavattasmāt parīkṣya vaktavyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavettat prāpayati tattattvaṃ gauḥ kṣīrāttu ghṛtaṃ yathādevatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ bhavetvinā yenābhiṣekeṇa sādhakaḥ pūrṇabodhatāmtasmād guruḥ priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ bodhayitvābhiṣecayetkhārītoyabhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ sthāpayeccakramadhyataḥdaleṣu vidhivat sthāpya tatrābāhyeṣṭadevatāmśiṣyasya janmanakṣatre prāgvat tairabhiṣecayetcaturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthamāḍhakaṃ taiścaturguṇaiḥkumbhaistairaṣṭabhiḥ khārī --------------------------sindūravarṇaṃ tapanīyabhūṣaṃ vahniṃ jaṭābhūṣitamaulimīḍeavighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadādevasenā svadhā svāhā mātaro lokamātaraḥbrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāsthānaṃ tyaktvā tu tatsarvaṃ yatrasthaṃ tatra gacchatusarveṣāmavirodhena brahmakarma samārabheatrigotrastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kurusaṃvījyamāno'psarasāṃ gaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃ no bhagavan namasteśatayajñādhipo devastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥtejovatā lokagaṇena sārdhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ pāhi kave namastedhūmraketurajo'dhyakṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥkāśyapeyastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuru
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śubhāśubhānandaśucāmadhīśa śivāya naḥ pāhi makhaṃ namasteāvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatāmmamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanāya lokeśvarastvaṃ bhagavan namastenīlaṃ rakṣogaṇairjuṣṭaṃ nīlābharaṇabhūṣitamāvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatāmbhāradvājastu viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kuruvidyādharendrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasmān bhagavan namasteāvāhayāmi yajñe'smin varuṇāya namonamaḥprāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāya gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namasteāvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatāmtasmai pūjyāya jagatī vāyave'haṃ namāmi cavaiśampāyana viprendra śāntipāṭhaṃ makhe kurusarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sahaiva gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namastetasmai somāya devāya nakṣatrapataye namaḥlokeśa yajñeśvara yajñasiddhyai gṛḥāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavan namasteāvāhayāmi yajñe'smin pūjā me pratigṛhyatāmśūlapāṇirvirūpākṣastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥyakṣoragendrāmaralokasaṅghairananta rakṣādhvaramasmadīyampadmaśaṅkhadharordhvādhodakṣabhāgakaradvayampuṣpavaddhārayenmūrdhni tasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥsarvasya dhātāsyamitaprabhāvo viśādhvaraṃ naḥ satataṃ śivāyayajñādhyakṣaścaturvaktrastasmai nityaṃ namonamaḥbrahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārdhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvantu tāni meṛṣayo manavogāvo devamātara eva cabrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca kṣetrapālā gaṇaiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyateihāgacchatetyāvāhyeha tiṣṭhateti sthāpayetaśvināvihāgacchateha tiṣṭhateti ketordakṣiṇe'śvinauviṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha memūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥatra gāyatrī sāvitrī śāntiḥ puṣṭikarī tathādevadānavasaṃvāde mathyamāne mahodadhautvattoye sarvatīrthāni devāḥ sarve tvayi sthitāḥśivaḥ svayaṃ tvamevāsi viṣṇustvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥtyayi tiṣṭhanti sarve'pi yataḥ kāmaphalapradāḥsānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva prasanno bhava sarvadāsarvāśine sarvagata pāvakāya namo'stu teviṣṇustvaṃ lokapālo'si śāntimatra prayaccha mekarmāntare'pi samprāpte sānnidhyaṃ kuru sādaramcakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥvikāśāśca śikhāścaiva saṃvedyāḥ karmasiddhayebālārkavarṇo hutabhugjapābhaḥ śasyate budhaiḥśakracāpanibhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kusumbhābhastathaiva caāyurdaḥ padmagandhaḥ syādbilvagandhaśca suvrataḥpadmendīvarakahlārasarpiguggulasannibhaḥśabdo'gneḥ siddhaye hoturanyathā syādasiddhidaḥvimānānāṃ hayānāṃ ca prāsādānāṃ vṛṣasya catadākṛtiḥ sadā vahniḥ sadyaḥ siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥyadrūpaṃ kathitaṃ caitadyadi tasya pratīkṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hrasvā hrasvonnatā dīrghāgnijvālāḥ siddhidāḥ smṛtāḥśubhadā yajamānasya rājyasyāpi viśeṣataḥhṛdye tuṣṭiprade caiva hotavyaṃ siddhimicchatānityamevaṃ śubhakaro yadanyairvarjito'guṇaiḥdhūmāvalīḍhajvālaśca kṛśānurnaiva siddhidaḥbhūmiṃ ca vilikhedyastu so'pi dadyāt parābhavamśveto rāṣṭraṃ nihantyāśu vāyasasvarasaṃnibhaḥpūtigandho hutavaho hoturduḥkhaprado bhavetśukapakṣanibho dhūmaḥ pārāvatasamaprabhaḥrūkṣaścaṭacaṭāśabdastvapasavyagatistathāneṣyate'sau muniśreṣṭha śāstre'smin pārameśvaremūlenājyena juhuyāt pañcaviṃśatimāhutīḥbhadralohitā | caturthī lohitā śvetā dhūminyanyā karālikāsphuliṅginī dhūmravarṇā caturthī tu manojavākālī ca saptamī proktā jñātavyāḥ kāryabhedataḥgandharvayakṣanāgāśca piśācā rākṣasāstathātṛptā dadyustato devā vāñchitāṃ siddhimuttamāmśayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇaṃ śeṣakarmasucakṣuḥkarṇādikaṃ jñātvā homayed deśikottamaḥnāsikāyāṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ cakṣuṣornāśanaṃ bhavetyatra kāṣṭhaṃ tatra karṇau yatra dhūmastu nāsikāyatra prajvalito vahnistatra jihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥkarṇahome bhavedavyādhirnetre tvandhatvamīritamsadhūmo'gniḥ śiraḥ proktaṃ nirdhūmaścakṣureva caagnirvijāyate yatra śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candanadvayadevadruvikaṅkataśamībhavaubakulāśokapunnāgaplakṣanyagrodhacampakaiḥgṛhītvā vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥekāṃśena mitaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ saptabhāgamitaṃ mukhamagraṃ kaṇṭhasamānaṃ syānmukhe mārgaṃ prakalpayetvedīmadhye vidhātavyā bhāgenaikena karṇikātasya khātaṃ tribhirbhāgairvṛttamardhāṃśato bahiḥmekhalā mukhavedyoḥ syāt parito'rdhāṃśamānataḥda (ga) ṇḍīyugaṃ yamāṃśaiḥ syāddaṇḍasyānāha īritaḥhaṃsasya vā hastino vā potriṇo vā mukhaṃ likhetsrucaścaturviṃśatibhirbhāgairārarcayet sruvamcaturbhiraṃśairānāhaḥ karṣājya grāhi tacchiraḥdaṇḍamūlāgrayorgaṇḍī bhavet kaṅkaṇabhūṣitāvidadhyādvāśvatthapatre saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇiuktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni maniṣibhiḥdadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisaṃmitāḥguḍaṃ palārdhamānaṃ syāccharkarāpi tathā smṛtāekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayetmātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtamtridhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhāphalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥvrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā apigodhūmā raktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥśuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi viṃśatiḥcandanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ ikṣaṇaśca (?) saḥpicurbiḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayammuṣṭirāmraṃ praguñjo'tha dve pale prasṛtistathāviśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhāviśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryāt dvidalā vyādhisambhavāsthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥdveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ kṛtāḥārdratvacaṃ samacchedā jarjharyaṃgulavartulāmśraute smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥavakrā na svayaṃ śuṣkāḥ satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥprādeśamātrā vā lābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā apipiśācatvamavāpnoti narakaṃ ca prapadyatepañcaṣaṭkūṭavidyābhyāṃ śodhitaṃ bahuvāsaraiḥādhāre hṛdaye mūrdhni cakraṃ sañcintya madhyataḥtriśo vidyāṃ japetkarṇe devyātmā pūrṇamānasaḥśataṃ japettadagrastho nikaṭe tridinaṃ vasettasmāttadantike tasya pūjādeśādikṛdvasettatastadā samārabhya tadāyatto dhanādibhiḥanugrahādi kurvīta siddhye nānyathā bhavetkvāthodakaiḥ samāpūryābhiṣicyābhivadenmanumdvitīyamabhiṣekaṃ tu kuryād devyātmasiddhyetrikoṇāni vidhāyātra madhye kumbhaṃ tu vinyasetpūritaṃ khāritoyena kathitenākṣarauṣadhaiḥhiraṇyāni satāmrāṇi vāsobhyāmabhiveṣṭayetśatakratulatābaddhairmātuluṅgaphalānvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatpañcasaṃkhya kramoditāḥkālātmanityāmantrāṃśca japitvā pūrvavāsaresahasraṃ prajapet paścāddhomaṃ kṛtvā samantataḥmuditairyoginīvṛndairekaikaṃ devatātmabhiḥsvakramaṃ tasya kathayettadā prabhṛti so'pi tamsahasraṃ prajaped vidyāmabhiṣekasamanvitamteṣu śaktīḥ samāvāhya sampūjyaivābhiṣecayetevaṃ naimittikaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ samācarettrikuṭāśca catuṣkuṭāḥ pañcakūṭāstathaiva cadaśaikādaśakūṭāśca ravikūṭāstathaiva catathā pañcadaśākhyāśca tathā ṣoḍaśakūṭakāḥpañcāyatanavidyāśca nyāsajālaṃ tathaiva catā vidyāḥ prajapecchiṣyaḥ kramaprāptāḥ krameṇa vaikramaprāptamahāvidyānicaye bhaktiśāliniprākproktavidhinā samyaṅmaṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥsudine śubhanakṣatre sumuhūrte śubhodayeprākproktavidhinā samyak kuryāt puṇyāhavācanambrāhmaṇān pūjayet paścāt svastivācanapūrvakamdadājñayānyaviprāṃśca vṛṇuyāt svarṇavastrakaiḥbrāhmaṇān navasaṃkhyāṃśca hyaṣṭau ca dvārapālakānsvavidyopāsakān bhaktyā svarṇaratnāṃgulīyakaiḥśrīgurūktaprakāreṇa samasūtraṃ manoharamsaptasaptatikoṇeṣu yoniṣu pratiyoni casarvatra śālipuñjeṣu kalaśān sthāpayedbudhaḥprasthamātragrāhighaṭān itareṣu nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāyudhānāṃ sthāneṣu pratiheti ca ṣoḍaśapārśvayorekamekaṃ ca devyāḥ pṛṣṭhe ghaṭatrayamgurumaṇḍalanirmāṇaṃ ṣaḍkoṇāṣṭābjamadhyataḥgrahamaṇḍalamīśāne sarvatobhadramaṇḍalamāgneyapūrvamadhye tu kūryānnakṣatramaṇḍalamyāmyanair-ṛtamadhye daddinanityāprapūjanevṛttatrikoṇamadhye tu dhātudaivatamaṇḍalamāgnaye kurukullāyā vārāhyā vāyugocaretena teṣāṃ pūjārthaṃ vakṣye taddhāmamaṇḍalamsudhāvyañjanarūpaṃ syāditare tanmayā yataḥteṣāṃ navānāṃ pūjāsu tanmayaṃ navamaṇḍalamkrameṇa śṛṇu deveśi sarvaśreyaskarātmakamtrihastamātre janayennava koṣṭhāni teṣu vaitanmadhye tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca sūtradvayanipātanātvātādyaṣṭasvarān madhye praṇavaṃ nabhasā yutamtatrārkamarcayet tasya nāmabhirdvādaśoditaiḥsomasyādyaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā tena tathārcayetṣoḍaśasvarayuktaṃ ca mātṛkāṃ ca svayogataḥdāhavahnisvasahitamarcayettatra maṇḍalenivedya śarkarādugdhapāyasaiścopacārakaiḥtattadvargādivarṇaṃ ca svaraistāṃ mātṛkāmapitattadvargākṣarāṇyākhyātryakṣarairālikhedapievaṃ kṛteṣu navasu pūjayecca nava grahāntryakṣarāṇi caturthyantānyarccayettaiśca tānitiketumetaistu sarvatra mantrānuktau ca pūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣveva teṣāmarcātaste kuryustadanugrahamsvoccayoḥ sthitayoḥ pūjāṃ maṇḍalaṃ śṛṇu pārvatirekhābhirnavabhirmadhye tvekāśītipadaṃ likhetmāyantāśītisaṃkhyātān madhye dāvagataṃ ca tatapañcabhiścālikhettatra bimbe somaṃ samarcayetraktacandanasindūragairikeṣvekato raveḥdvivṛttāntastiryagūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā rekhāḥ samāntarāḥprāṇādikānnamontāṃstu svairupetān svarairyutānsvarairbhāntayutairvahnidaśārṇairgrathitāṃ lipimtanmadhye bhānumāvāhya pūjayet prāgvadīśvarisusame'nāvṛte kṛtvā bimbāyuktāni pūjayetviśeṣādeśarahite tatra tatkramato'rcayetravau sūryaśivau devi candre somāmbike tataḥpare gurucaturvaktrau bhṛgau śukrapurandarauindraśca vasavo nāgā dharmaḥ śivadivākaraudarśe tu pitaro devi pūjyāḥ sarvopacārakaiḥguruḥ sarpāśca pitaro bhago'ryamadineśvaraunir-ṛtiścaiva toyaṃ ca viśvedevāḥ prajāpatiḥahirbudhnyaśca pūṣā ca proktā nakṣatradevatāḥpraṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśvaridviruktaistaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni kuryādarṇaiḥ karāṅgayoḥraktā raktāmbarā raktabhūṣaṇasragvilepanāḥtadāvṛtīnāṃ pañcānāṃ śaktīstatsadṛśīḥ smaretaṣṭapatrāmbujaṃ madhye navayonau ca tāṃ yajetpṛṣṭhato gurupaṃktiṃ ca koṇeṣvaṣṭasu ca kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rūpiṇīśaktisahitairmāyāsaptākṣarīyutaiḥāsāṃ balipradānaṃ ca karotu kurukullayāmadhye ca tatra tāṃ nityānityāṃ gandhādibhiryajetbāhyeṣvapi ca tāḥ prāgvat proktavarṇāḥ samarcayetṣaṭtriṃśattāḥ samā devyāḥ sarvarūpāyudhādibhiḥpareṣu yavalakṣārṇarahitaistaistathārcayetpūjā nigrahasaṃjñā syātsā śatrūṇāṃ vipattayebījadvayādyaiḥ saptākṣaryyantaiḥ pañcadaśākṣaraiḥteṣāṃ bījadvayaṃ varṇā rūpakṣetreśasaṃyutāḥcatuṣṣaṣṭipade madhyacatuṣke dinavidyayāghaṭikākramayogena hṛnmāyāmadhyage'rcayetevaṃ maṇḍalamāsārdhātprāpnotyevābhivāñchitamsamastavāñchitaprāptiḥ sadā bhavati sarvataḥkāmīśvarīti tāṃ sarvakāmadāṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥśūnyamagniyutaṃ paścādrayo vyāptena saṃyutaḥnabho gotrā punaścaiṣā dāhena samayojitāeṣā kāmeśvarī nityā kāmadaikādaśākṣarīkāmeśvarīdevatā syādbrahmabījaṃ tu bījakamekena hṛdayaṃ śīrṣaṃ tāvatātho dvayaṃ dvayātdikśrotranāsādvitaye jihvāhṛnnābhiguhyakenyasedvidyākṣarāṇyeṣu sthāneṣu tadanantaramatha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi nityapūjāsu coditambālārkakoṭisaṅkāśāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmmaṇḍitāṃ raktavasanāṃ raktābharaṇaśobhitāmpañcāṣṭaṣoḍaśadvandvaṣaṭkoṇacaturasragām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phāntaṃ śakreṇa saṃyuktaṃ vāmakarṇavibhūṣitampañca bāṇā maheśāni nāmāni śṛṇu pārvativaśyonmādau krameṇaiva nāmāni parameśvariparābījaṃ madhyabāṇaṃ vāgbhavaṃ parameśvaripañca kāmāḥ kramāddevi nāmāni śṛṇu vallabhemīnaketurmaheśāni pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥmūlavidyādvirāvṛttyā sarvāṃgulitaleṣvapikurvīta dehasannāhaṃ tribhirbījaiḥ kramāt priyedakṣe vāme ca vinyasya dakṣakūrparapāṇiṣunādānte hṛdaye liṅge nyaseddevi tataḥ paramvidyāsṛṣṭikrameṇaiva jānīhi parameśvarikarṇayościbuke devi śaṅkhayormukhamaṇḍaletathā karpūrayoḥ kukṣau jānvorjaṅghe ca vinyasetkaṇṭhe ca navayonyākhyaṃ nyasedbījatrayātmakamtridvyekadaśakatridvisaṃkhyayā śailasambhaveratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntareanarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalāmpustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikāmsaṃpatpradā nāma tasyāḥ śṛṇu nirmalamānasekāmarājaṃ tathā devi śivacandrānvitaṃ tataḥśaktibīje maheśāni śivavahnī niyojayettripurābhairavī devī mahāsaṃpatpradā priyemūlamantradvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥdevīṃ baddhahimāṃśukhaṇḍamukuṭāṃ vande sumandasmitāmvāgbhavaṃ bījamuccāryaṃ jīvaprāṇasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśāṃkuśau ca puṇḍrekṣacāpaṃ puṣpaśilīmukhamevaṃ dhyātvārcayed devīṃ nityapūjāsu siddhayemadanonmādanau paścāttathā dīpanamohanaukusumā mekhalā paścānmadanā madanāturātato bhuvanapālā syācchaśirekhā tvanantarāśraddhā prīti ratiścaiva dhṛtiḥ kāntirmanoramāmadanonmādinī paścānmohinī śaṅkhinī tataḥsasvarāḥ ṣoḍaśa proktāḥ priyadarśinikāntikāḥpūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathāśaśinī cāṅgirā cchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalāsoḍaśasvapi patreṣu pūjayettā yathākramamtadbahiścaturasrasthalokeśāstatsamā yajetagnyādyasreṣu vidyādisaptākṣaryyantarāsthitaiḥtatastāmaṅgavidyābhyāṃ kḷptārghyaḥ pūjayecchivāmghṛtāktairmadhurāktairvā prasūnairaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇām kramātdharāyuk sacarā paścāt sthirā paścādrasaḥ smṛtaḥsthirā bhūsahitā gotrā sadāho'gnī rasaḥ sthirātato rasaḥ sthirā paścānmarutā saha yojitāsthirā dharānvito haṃso vyāptena ca careṇa turasaḥ sthirā tataḥ sāgniḥ śūnyaṃ javiyuto marutrasaḥ sthirāmbu ca viyat svayutaṃ prāṇa eva casacaraḥ syāñjavī pūrvavidyātārtīyataḥ kramāthṛdambuyuk kṣmayā dāhaḥ sacaraḥ syāñjavī ca hṛtsthirā tu marutā yuktā śūnyaṃ sāgni nabhaścarau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dāho gotrā carayutā tathā dāhastathā rayaḥrasaḥ sthirā tataḥ prāṇo rasāgnisahito bhavetśūnyayugmaṃ ca gotrā syāddāhayuktāmbunā caraḥgotrā dāhamarudyuktā tvambu vyāptamato bhavetrasaḥ sthirāmbvagniyutaṃ vāyuyugmaṃ carānvitamgrāso bhūsahito devi raso vyāptaṃ tataśca hṛtśūnyaṃ ca kevalaṃ bhadre rasaśca sacarā sthirābhūmi rasākṣmāsvayutā pañcaikāntaritāḥ sthitāḥtāni kramājjyā sacaro raso bhūśca nabhoyutāśūnyayugmaṃ carayutaṃ hṛddāho'mbumarudyutaḥśūnyaṃ sāgni namaḥ kuryāccareṇa sahitaṃ priyeśūnya vyāptaṃ ca hṛdyuktaṃ rayadāhasvavahnibhiḥhaṃsaḥ syād dāhavahnisvairyuktamantyamudīritamdevateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priyetataścaturbhiḥ śīrṣaṃ syācchikhā tribhirudīritāaruṇāmaruṇākalpāṃ sundarīṃ susmitānanāmkahlārapāśapuṇḍrekṣukodaṇḍān vāmabāhubhiḥtathāvidhābhiḥ paritovṛtāṃ śaktibhirātmabhiḥpañcatriṃśacchatārṇaistai rūpiṇīśaktipañcakammadanāṃ mohinīṃ lolāṃ bhañjanīmudyamāṃ śubhāmsarvonmādāṃ sarvasukhāṃ sabhaṅgāmabhitodyamāmetāḥ syuḥ śaktyaḥ pañcapañcāśadbhiḥ śataṃ tvitiatha pūjākramaṃ devi śṛṇu sarvārthadāyakamcaturasradvayaṃ kṛtyā kuryād dvāraṃ tu paścimeyonidvayaṃ tato madhye tiryagrekhāvidhānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agrādvilomagāstāsu śaktīḥ saṃsthāpya pūjayetniṣpādya tāvatīryonīrmadanādyāḥ samarcayettanmadhye bhagamālāṃ tāmāvāhyoktasvarūpiṇīmarghyāmaṅgaiśca mūlena saṃsthāpyābhyukṣya mūlataḥśabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pūrvavattadantarbhagamālāyāṃ madanādyāstathārcayettato devīṃ ṣoḍaśabhirupacārairudīritaiḥjapedaṣṭottaraśatamagre devyāstu nityaśaḥsaṃyojya bindau tāṃ prāgvanmūlenābhyarcya tāṃ tathādevyātmā vaśayedviśvaṃ naranārīnarādhipānnityaklinnābhidhānāṃ tāṃ tanmantraṃ prāgudīritamkāmeśvaryāstṛtīyādivarṇānāmaṣṭakaṃ bhavetekādaśākṣarī nityaklinnā nityā samīritānityaklinnā devatoktā vanitā drāviṇī parātato dvābhyāṃ punardvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvayena catantre ṣaḍaṅgaṃ yatroktaṃ tatra tatra karadvayeśeṣaṃ taladvaye nyasya hṛddṛkśrotranasordvayoḥaruṇāmaruṇākalpāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīmnetratrayollasadvaktrāṃ bhāle dharmāmbumoktikaiḥcaturbhirbāhubhiḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ pānapātrakamdhyātvaivaṃ pūjayennityaklinnānityāṃ svaśaktibhiḥnityā nirañjanā klinnā kledinī madanāturāmadābilā maṅgalā ca manmathārtā manasvinīcaturasragatāḥ pūjyā madāruṇacalekṣaṇāḥcaturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā prākpratyakdvārasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamūlābhyāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ prāṅmukho'rcayetdvārapārśveṣu koṇeṣu dikṣu tā daśa pūjayetarcayedaṣṭaśaktīstāstadantaryonikoṇagāḥkarṇikāyonimadhyasthadeśe vāyvīśavahniṣutato devīṃ tu tāṃ nityāṃ nityaklinnāmudīritaiḥtadagrato japedvidyāṃ sahasraṃ yadi vā śatamājyasiktāndhasājyena puṣpairvā saurabhānvitaiḥabhyarcya devīmatha tāṃ svātmanyudvāsya pūrvavattadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe kathayāmi yathāvidhiraso dāhena tadyuktaṃ prāṇo dāhavanasvayukajyā ca dāhena tadyuktā nityaklinnāntato dvayamdevateyaṃ varārohe tṛtīyaṃ bījamucyaterandhrājñāmukhakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhyādhārapaddvayetataḥ śaktīsavṛtisthā dhyānaṃ ca śṛṇu pārvatitadantaraṣṭapatreṣu vijayāṃ vimalāṃ śubhāmtadantaraṣṭakoṇeṣu kamalāṃ kāminīṃ tathākalyāṇīṃ kākakolāṃ ca pūjayeduktayogataḥśākinīṃ hākinīṃ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu kramato'rccayetaṣṭakoṇāntarāleṣu pūjayedāyudhāṣṭakamtadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vṛttayugmamathāntarātadantastādṛśaṃ kuryāt ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vā tu vigrahambheruṇḍāṃ pañcamīṃ nityāmuktaśaktibhirāvṛttāmbaliṃ ca ṣoḍaśārṇena dadyādādyantayoḥ kramāttadāvṛttisthaśaktīnāṃ krameṇa śṛṇu pārvaticārusmitāñcitamukhīṃ divyālaṅkārabhūṣitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rasānānūpurormyādibhūṣaṇairatisundarīmkarairdadhānāmāsīnāṃ pūjāyāmanyadāsthitāmpūjayettadvadabhitaḥ smitasaumyamukhāṃ sadābalirmādyantayordadyāt pūrvoktavidhinā yutamsā vidyā vahnivāsinyāḥ kathitābhūnnavākṣarītato'mbu śūnyaṃ haṃsāgniyutambu marudyutamśūnyaṃ namaḥ śaktiyutaṃ navārṇeyamudīritāādyantaṃ bījaśaktī syāt kīlakaṃ madhyamena camāyāntān ṣaḍbhirevāṅgānyācaret svakarāṅgayoḥvyāpakaṃ tu samastena kuryād devyātmasiddhayetena tattanmayo būyāt sādhakastena siddhayaḥmātṛkāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca mātṛkānyāsameva calalitāyāstu vargaistat proktamaṣṭābhireva cataptakāñcanasaṃkāśāṃ navayauvanasundarīmaṣṭābhirbāhubhiryuktāṃ māṇikyābharaṇojjvalāmpītakauśeyavasanāṃ raktamañjīramekhalāmraktābjakambupuṇḍrekṣucāpapūrṇendumaṇḍalāmpuṣpeṣu mātuliṅgaṃ ca dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥevaṃ dhyātvārcayedvahnivāsinīṃ viśvavigrahāmkanakā kitavā viśvā vividhā ceti śaktayaḥdaleṣu dvādaśasvetā rāśiśaktīḥ samarcayetghasmarā sarvabhakṣā ca viśvā ca vividhodbhavāacintyavaibhavā raktā daśamī parikīrtitāyatra noktā devatā tu balikarmaṇi tatra tāmvṛttayornavayoniṃ tu kṛtvā tadbahirambujam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbahiścaturasre dve dvāradvayasamanvitetasyā vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvārthasādhakamtadaṅgāni lipinyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ śaktibhirarcanampañcamaṃ bhagamālādyaṃ bheruṇḍāyā dvitīyakamaṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ ca syādetadādyamitīritammāyayā puṭitaṃ kṛtvā kuryādaṅgāni ṣaṭ kramātdṛkśrotranāsāvāgvakṣonābhiguhyeṣu ca kramātcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmdadhānāṃ bāhurbhirnetrairdayāmadasuśītalaiḥcakramadhye sukhāsīnāṃ smeravaktrasaroruhāmsiṃhāsane'bhitaḥ preṅkhatpotasthābhiśca śaktibhiḥkurvāṇamaruṇāmabhodhau cintayenmantranāyikāmḍākinyādyāḥ ṣaḍasrasthā padmadvādaśapatragāḥnirañjanā rāgavatī tathaiva madanāvatītataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrasthāḥ śaktīrākarṇayāmbikekirātāṃ kālakadane kauśikīṃ kambuvāhinīmcaturasrasthāśca śaktīrākarṇaya ca tāḥ kramātratiḥ śraddhā bhogalolā madonmatte manasvinīdvādaśaitāmahādevyāścaturasrābhito yajetśoṇābdhiṃ hemapotaṃ ca siṃhāsanamataḥ parammāyāsaptākṣarīmadhyagatairnāmabhirarcayetdevyāstu kurukullāyā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhiprāgvat samāpayeditthamarcanaṃ te samīritamtadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe samīhitaphalapradamtathāvaraṇaśaktīśca taddhyānaṃ tatprapūjanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ambu syānmarutā yuktaṃ gotrā kṣmāsaṃyutā tataḥantyarṇau vahnivāsinyā dūtī nityā samīritātenaiva puṭitairarṇairnyasecchrotrādipañcasuprāgvadarghya samuddiṣṭaṃ tacchaktīḥ śṛṇu pārvativinodā kautukā puṇyā purāṇā caturasragāḥvīrā vighnaharā vidyetyuktvā yantrāṣṭaśaktayaḥsamayā sarvagā vidyetyuktāstvaṣṭāsraśaktayaḥmūladevīsamākāravarṇākāra (yudha) samanvitāḥnādāṃ manonmanīṃ ṣaṭsu patreṣu parito'rcayetmadhye devīṃ hetivṛtāṃ pūjayedaṣṭamīṃ śivāmtathāpi bhaktasarvāṇahetoḥ kḷptāṃ parāṃ tanumnavaratnakirīṭāṃ ca trīkṣaṇāmaruṇāmbarāmśucismitāmaṣṭabhujāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥdakṣiṇairaṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ kuṭhāraṃ kamalaṃ tathādhyātvaivaṃ pūjayed devīṃ dūtīṃ durnītināśinīm(tathā ṣaḍasramaṣṭāsraṃ tadvaṣṭadalāmbujam)āvāhyābhyarcya tacchaktīḥ prāguktavidhinā sthitāḥproktaiva tvaritā vidyā prāgeva dvādaśākṣarāyena mantrī manmathābho vikṣobhayati bhūtalamhaṃso dharāsvasaṃyuktaḥ tejaścarasamanvitamhṛdā rayeṇa dāhena vahniḥ syādaṣṭamaṃ priyedyutirnādayutā nityā tvaritā dvādaśākṣarīkavacaṃ strī śaktibīje kṣeca kīlakamīritamkuryādaṅgāni yugmārṇaiḥ ṣaṭ krameṇa karāṅgayoḥūruyugme tathā jānuyugme jaṅghādvaye tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvitīyopāntyamadhyasthairmantrārṇairitarairapiśyāmavarṇāṃ śubhākārāṃ navayauvanaśobhinīmtāṭaṅkamaṅgadaṃ tadvadraśanānūpurānvitaiḥpallavāṃśukasaṃvītāṃ śikhipucchakṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥbarhibarhakṛtāpīḍāṃ tacchatrāṃ tatpatākinīmtrinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ mandasmitamukhāmbujāmdhyātvaivaṃ totulāṃ devīṃ pūjayecchaktibhirvṛtāmprasāde phaladāne ca sādhakānāṃ tvarānvitāmkṛṣṇavarṇo gadāpāṇirvarvarordhvaśiroruhaḥtaddvārapārśvayoḥ pūjye jayāvijayasaṃjñikehuṃkārī khecarī caṇḍā chedinī kṣepiṇī tataḥpūjyāḥ padmāṣṭapatreṣu sthitā mantrārṇaśaktayaḥśṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ tasyāstvaritāyā maheśvariāsane hemaracite vidadhyāt bhūpuradvayamtadantaraṣṭapatrābjaṃ vidhāyātra parāṃ śivāmmudrādarśanapūrvaṃ tu pūjayettāṃ yathoditāmkiṅkarasya baliṃ dadyād devyagre prāgudīritaiḥevaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyāgre japedvidyāṃ sahasrakamvidyoktā kulasundaryāstasyāḥ pūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇuprāṇo dvitīyaḥ svayuto vanahṛcchaktibhiḥ paraḥchandaḥ paṃktistu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya devatāmvāgbhavaṃ bījamityuktaṃ śaktistārtīyamīritamādyamadhyāvasāneṣu pūjājapavidhau kramātkuryāt karāṅgavaktrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ proktaṃ yathāvidhiśucinatyantarasthaistaistadātmasu yathākramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ śrotracibuke caturthaṃ ghrāṇatāluṣumūlamadhyāgrato nyasyennavadhā mūlavarṇakaiḥlohitāṃśukabhūṣāsraglepanāṃ ṣaṇmukhāmbujāmanarghyaratnaghaṭitamāṇikmukuṭojjvalāmratnastabakasaṃbhinnalasadvakṣaḥsthalāṃ śubhāmbhujairdvādaśabhiryuktāṃ sarveśīṃ sarvavāṅmayīmratnapūrṇaṃ tu caṣakaṃ luṅgīṃ vyākhyānamudrikāmhaimīṃ ca lekhanīṃ ratnamālāṃ kambu varaṃ bhujaiḥyakṣarākṣasadevarṣisiddhavidyādharādibhiḥsitāṃ kevalavāksiddhyai lakṣmyai hemaprabhāmapinīlāṃ ca mūkīkaraṇe smarettattadapekṣayābahurūpā citrarūpā ramyāpyānandakautukebahiraṣṭacchadāmbhoje brāhmyādyāstāḥ samarcayetindrāgniyamarakṣorbhirvaruṇānilasomakānśaktyāntairnāmabhiḥ prāgvat pūjayet sarvasiddhayetanmadhye vṛttayugmasthaṃ kuryādaṣṭacchadāmbujamkṛtvātra tāṃ samāvāhya prāgvat samyagathārcayettathaiva lokapālāntaśaktī dvāradvaye'rcayetsaptākṣaryā baliṃ dadyāt pūjānte kurukullayānityānityāṃ śṛṇu prājñe tadāyattamidaṃ jagatyāsau samastabhūtānāṃ dehasthitividhāyinīvidyayā kulasundaryā yojitaḥ sampradāyataḥbhrūmadhye kaṇṭhahṛnnābhiguhyādhāreṣu ca kramātvyāpakaṃ tu samastena vidhāya vidhinā yutamudyadbhāskarabimbābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cārusmitalasadvaktraṣaṭsarojavirājitāmpāśākṣaguṇapuṇḍrekṣucāpakheṭatriśūlakānpuṣpeṣu maṇḍalāgraṃ ca kapālamabhayaṃ tathāanantāḥ śaktayo devyāstvākarṇaya vadāmi tepūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syurante śaktītisaṃyutāḥṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ yajettābhirvṛtāṃ śivāmrakṣonilendravahnīśavaruṇeṣu kramācca tāḥśākinī hākinī mūladevīsadṛśavigrahāḥkṛtanyāsārdhasaṃkalpaḥ pūjayedīritakramātṣaṭkoṇādbahirabjaṃ tu śatārdhaikadalānvitamdvicatuṣṣaḍdalaśatairdvādaśāṣṭadalacchadaiḥcaturasradvayaṃ bāhye caturdvārasamanvitambrāhmyādilokapālākhyāḥ ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥtasyā nīlapatākāyā vidhānaṃ sarvasiddhidamhṛcca dāhakṣmāsvayutaṃ (vajreśīpañcamaṃ tataḥbhūmī rasākṣmāsvayutā) vajreśī ṣaṣṭhataḥ kramātdyutirdāhacarasvena asyā ādyamanantaramnityā nīlapatākākhyā hrīṃbījaṃ hrīṃ ca śaktikamdvicatuṣṭayaṣaṭtryarṇaiḥ krameṇa ṣaḍītiritaiḥnābhāvādhārake pādasandhiṣu triṣu ca kramātvyāpakaṃ samastena vidadhyācca yathāvidhipañcavaktrāṃ trinayanāmaruṇāṃśukadhāriṇīmratnastavakasambhinnadehāṃ cārusmitānanāmdadhānāṃ vāmapārśvasthaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥdadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairāsīnāṃ padmaviṣṭare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīvaprāṇaṃ vahnisaṃsthaṃ śakrasvaravibhūṣitamtrailokyamohanī devī parabrahmacidātmikāmukuṭordhvalasaccandralekhāṃ raktāmbarānvitāmvaradābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghaṭastanīmtadante parameśāni nityaklinne madadraveraktāṃ muṇḍasrajaṃ pañcapretasiṃhāsanasthitāmśaktibhinnaṃ bindunādakalāḍhyaṃ vāgbhavaṃ priyesadāśivasya bījaṃ tu mahāsiṃhāsanasya caudyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanāmvamadrudhiramuṇḍālikalitāṃ raktavāsasampinākaṃ ca śarān devi pāśāṃkuśayugaṃ kramātaghore vāgbhavaṃ paścādghore tu bhuvaneśvarīnamaste'stu rudrarūpebhyo devyā bījayugaṃ likhetnādabindususaṃyuktaṃ prathamaṃ bījamuddhṛtamśivacandrau vahnisaṃsthau manusvarasamanvitaumadhyakūṭena ṣaḍadīrghayuktenāṅgāni kalpayetkirīṭaratnavilasaccitracitritamauktikāmnayanatrayaśobhāḍhyāṃ pūrṇenduvadanānvitāmraktāmbaraparīdhānāṃ yauvanonmattarūpiṇīmvaradānaratāṃ nityāṃ mahāpretāsanasthitāmpretabījaṃ samuddhṛtya vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavetudyatsūryasahasrābhāṃ māṇikyamukuṭojjvalāmratnamañjīrasubhagāṃ raktavastrānulepanāmbālyalīlāparāṃ devīṃ kumārīrūpadhāriṇīmkāmeśvarīdevatā syādbījenāṅgakriyā matā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktivṛndairvṛtāṃ dhyāyeddevīṃ nityārcanakramedvya(a)ṣṭāraṃ bhūpuradvandvād vṛtte tatpurayugmakamkṛtvā tāmāvṛtāṃ śaktigaṇaistatrārcayecchivāmagrāt pradakṣiṇenaiva yajedāvṛttipañcakam)brāhmyādīraṣṭapatreṣu tatkoṇeṣu bahistathābalidvayaṃ ca kurvīta pūjāṃ prāgvat samāpayettilataṇḍulakairvāpi proktaṃ dravyānudīritetadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe vidyā prāguditā tavasvena yuktā bhavennityā vijayaikākṣarā matāśeṣābhyāṃ ca dvayaṃ kuryāt ṣadaṅgāni karaṅgayoḥakṣarāṇi kramādbinduyutātvanyattu pūrvavatbhāsvanmukuṭavinyastacandrarekhāvirājitāmudyadbhāsvadbimbatulyadehakāntiṃ śucismitāmcakraṃ tathāṃkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ sāyakaṃ mātuluṅgakam(upāsane'tisaumyāṃ ca siṃhopari kṛtāsanām)samare pūjane'nyeṣu prayogeṣu sukhāsanāmsarvā devyāḥ samākāramukhapāṇyāyudhā apiśākhāṣṭakasamopetaṃ tatra prāgvat samarcayettadantaśca tathā padmaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadasaṃyutamtattacchaktyāvṛtāṃ samyagupacāraistathārcayetbalidvayaṃ prakurvīta pūjāṃ cāpi samāpayetcandrakhaṇḍalasanmauliyutāḥ sā tanmayī sadātadāvaraṇagāḥ śaktīstatsamākārahetikāḥtāsāṃ krameṇa nāmāni śṛṇu vakṣye yathāvidhibrāhmyādilokapālāśca ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃsthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ durgāṃ bhadrāṃ bhadrakarīmapitadantaḥ ṣoḍaśadaleṣvarcayet ṣoḍaśābhitaḥvidārikāṃ viśvamayīṃ viśvāṃ viśvavibhañjikāmavītaśokāṃ viṣagrīvāṃ vipulāṃ vijayapradāmtadantaraṣṭapatreṣu śaktīraṣṭābhito yajetmanoharāṃ maṅgalāṃ ca madotsiktāṃ manasvinīmevaṃ pūjājapadhyānahomopāsanato vaśīekākṣarā tu sā proktā vidyā sā sarvamaṅgalāpūjākramaṃ sādhanaṃ ca viniyogādikān kramātekākṣaryānayā siddho jāyate khecaraḥkṣaṇāttāni tatsvarabhinnāni tāni ṣaṭsumanovadhimāṇikyamukuṭāṃ netradvayapreṅkhaṅkhaddayāparāmpatrairupete sacaturdvārabhūsadmayugmakevāmena nijabhaktānāṃ prayacchantīṃ dhanādikamṣaṭsaptatibhiranyābhirakṣarotthābhiranvitāmtāḥ śaktīḥ śṛṇu deveśi yā nityāvaraṇasthitāḥkuṃkumāṃ kamalāṃ kalpāṃ pūjayedaṣṭapatrakeaśokāmamalāṃ pūrṇāṃ puṇyāṃ bhāgyāmathodyatāmpūjayedabhitaḥ śaktīḥ prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vaigaurīṃ śivāmameyāṃ ca vimalāṃ vijayāṃ parāmaśeṣarūpāmānandāmambujākṣīmaninditāmvandyāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ satyāṃ saṃ (ñjā?ya) tāṃ ca sarasvatīmprāgvadgandhādibhiḥ sarvāḥ kramādatvarthasaṃjñitāḥpaścimādi caturdikṣu catasraḥ proktavigrahāḥbalidvayaṃ ca homaṃ ca kuryāt prāgvat samāpanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadvidhānaṃ śṛṇu prājñe jvālāmālinyudāhṛtārayo'gninā yuto jyāmbu marudyuktā rasā marutgotrā caraṇe sahitā ambu pūrvākṣaraṃ tathāhaṃsaśca marutā dāhaḥ prāṇaśca marutā yutaḥcareṇāmbu ca gotrā hṛtsāgni jyāmburasā svayukdāhenānena te dviḥ syāt haṃso dāhamarutsvayuksapta dāhāstato'syāḥ syuraṣṭamādyāstu pañca vaitvaritāntyaṃ ca bheruṇḍā aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathārephāstre bījaśaktī tu kīlakaṃ kavacaṃ priyekuryādaṅgāni mūlārṇairāditaḥ ṣaṭ karāṅgayoḥṣaḍvaktrāṃ dvādaśabhujāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmśūlavahnī varābhītī dadhānāṃ karapaṅkajaiḥcārusmitalasadvaktrasarojāṃ trīkṣaṇānvitāmcaturasradvayaṃ kṛtvā caturdvārasamanvitamṣaṭkoṇaṃ madhyatastryasraṃ vidhāyātra śivāṃ yajetḍākinyādyāśca ṣaṭkoṇe tvaṣṭāsre ghasmarādikāḥsarvabhakṣā sahasrākṣī niḥsaṅgā saṃhṛtipriyāacintyāmaprameyāṃ ca pūrṇarūpāṃ durāsadāmbahirdvāreṣu koṇeṣu pūjayet prāgudīritāḥbalihomāvasānāntamiti samyak samīritamproktā tatkalpamadhunā śṛṇu sarvārthasiddhidamdhyānaṃ śaktīḥ pūjanañca sādhanaṃ tatphalāni caṣaḍaṅgāni yathāpūrvaṃ mātṛkāṃ vidyayā nyasetnavaratnakirīṭāṃ ca citrapaṭṭāṃśukojjvalāmsarvānandamayīṃ nityāṃ samastepsitadāyinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadhānāṃ maṅgalāpadmakarṇikānavayonigāmnavayonāvaṣṭavargayutā brāhmyādikā yajethetiśca parito devyāḥ pūjayet tadbhujāntikepūjayet tattadakārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhisarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥsā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥvyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayamdāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ paramambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priyeasya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥtṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramātoṃ kurukulle svāhā iti saptākṣarīkurukullāyāḥ oṃkurukulle hrīḥ svāhā iti trayodaśākṣarīsvāhā iti pañcaviṃśākṣarīsaptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā parāevaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadādvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajettatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajetbalicakraṃ ca tenaiva tanmadhye tu samarcayetkṛtvā tadantaḥ padmaṃ ca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamṣaḍaṅgaṃ bālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayetdhyātvaivaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramātdadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥtatastadājñayārohed bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūryaṃ somaṃ tithiṃ vāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapiprāṇaṃ buddhiṃ tathā śaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayettato bāṇān dhanuḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ cābhito yajetśaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye saṃvidāsanamarcayettatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥparīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarcayet tatra tatra vainamontairnāmabhiḥ pūrvamarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥevaṃ samarcitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaramprasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvaripañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvaritāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye! vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīmrayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutamṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyād hṛdambumarudanvitamdhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanamśyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkajeśaktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇāmnavayonāvaṣṭavargayutā brāhmyādikā yajethetiśca parito devyāḥ pūjayet tadbhujāntikepūjayet tattadakārāṃstattanmantrairyathāvidhisarvāsāmapi nityānāṃ yadādyāsyandajā imāḥsā vidyā kurukullāyāḥ pañcaviṃśākṣaro manuḥvyāptaṃ marucchaktiyutaṃ bhūḥ svayuktā tatastrayamdāhena vahniśaktibhyāṃ yuto haṃsastataḥ paramambu paścādviyadyuktaṃ marutā tu nabhaḥ priyeasya ṣaṣṭhādipañcārṇādantyau syādādya īritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīyaḥ pañcaviṃśārṇaḥ proktā mantrā iti kramātoṃ kurukulle svāhā iti saptākṣarīkurukullāyāḥ oṃ kurukullehrīḥ svāhā iti trayodaśākṣarīsaptabhiḥ prathamā proktā trayodaśayutā parāevaṃ sā tribhirapyetairvidyārūpairabhīṣṭadādvīpe tāṃ lalitāṃ nityavinodānanditāṃ yajettatsāgareṣu parito ratnapotacarīṃ yajetbalicakraṃ ca tenaiva tanmadhye tu samarcayetkṛtvā tadantaḥ padmaṃ ca sāṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamṣaḍaṅgaṃ bālayā kṛtvā tenārghyamapi sādhayetdhyātvaivaṃ parivāraistāṃ devīṃ gandhādibhiḥ kramātdadhānāṃ cintayedbāṇacāpapāśasṛṇīḥ karaiḥṛtusnātāḥ sphuradyonyaḥ sadānandāruṇekṣaṇāḥtatastadājñayārohed bhrāmiṇīṃ drāviṇīṃ yajetsūryaṃ somaṃ tithi vāraṃ yogarkṣakaraṇānyapiprāṇaṃ buddhiṃ tathā śaktimaṣṭapatreṣu pūjayettato bāṇān dhanuḥ pāśamaṃkuśaṃ cābhito yajetśaktīryaṣṭvātha tanmadhye saṃvidāsanamarcayettatastadājñayā potaparītaṃ dvīpamāgataḥparīyamāṇe dikṣvetānarcayet tatra tatra vainamontairnāmabhiḥ pūrvamarcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥevaṃ samarcitaṃ devyā lalitāyāḥ priyaṅkaramprasīdati yatastasmāt pūjayedevamīśvaripañcaviṃśārṇamūlena pūjānte parameśvaritāṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ priye! vacmi tārāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm
