sanskrit: rayo dharānvitaḥ paścādrayayugmaṃ marudyutamṣaṣṭhaṃ tadaṣṭamaṃ vidyād hṛdambumarudanvitamdhyānaṃ devyāḥ śṛṇu prājñe samastāpannikṛntanamśyāmavarṇāṃ trinayanāṃ dvibhujāṃ varapaṅkajesaktibhiḥ smeravadanāṃ raktamauktikabhūṣaṇāmtaddvidhā kathitā pūrvaṃ tadaṅgāni ca pūjanamhomairyantraiśca vakṣyāmi samastābhīṣṭasiddhayeambu paścādrayaḥ sāgnirmarutāmburayau tathādāhaśca marutā haṃsastvagniretattrayaṃ punaḥtejo'gninā yutaḥpañca vātaḥ svena samāyutaḥśūnyaṃ vyāptena śucinā śūnyaṃ śaktyā nabhoyutametatpūrvamadhaḥ proktacatuṣṭayamataḥ paramraso'gninā punaḥ proktacatuṣkāt trayamantataḥhaṃso'gninā prāk tritayaṃ hṛdayaṃ svasamāyutampaścāduktatrayaṃ vāto dharayā ca nabhaḥ priyevyāptametattrayaṃ paścād hṛd dāhenāmbusaṃyutamdāhena pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca pūrvaṃ ca marutā yutamsparśo marutsvasahito hṛd dāhenāmbunā yutamhṛdayena svena yutaṃ rasaśca svena saṃyutaḥvārdāhayuktamambu syādviyad vyāptasvasaṃyutamsthirā rasā vanasvena dāvau haṃso dharāsvayukhaṃsaśca marutā vidyā daśottaraśatākṣarīdaśabhiḥ saptabhiḥ saptasaṃkhyairjātibhiranvitamvidhāya cakraṃ tatraiva svanāmnāvāhya pūjayetsarvamadhye samabhyarcya vāmadakṣāgrakoṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādyabījāntyasaprāṇairupetāmatha pūjayetvṛtte caiva mahālakṣmīṃ pañcamīṃ madhyatastathāākaṇṭhavanitārūpāṃ jvalatpiṅgaśiroruhāmpāśaṃ ca musalaṃ sīramabhayaṃ varadaṃ tathātantre caturdaśaḥ śvāsaḥśrīmattripurasundaryā jananyā jagatāṃ sadāprātastripurasundaryā namāmi caraṇāmbujam(prātastripurasundaryā namāmi padapaṅkajam)prātaḥ pāśāṃkuśaśarapāśahastāṃ namāmyahamprātarnamāmi pādābjaṃ yayedaṃ bhāsate jagatyaḥ ślokapañcakamidaṃ prātarnityaṃ paṭhennaraḥādhāre hṛdaye śīrṣe vahnau sūrye niśākarenyasecca mātṛkāsthāne tadā taddehaśuddhayeprauḍhā ca niṣkalāceti sandhyā devi prakīrtitākāmeśvarī ca madhyāhne sāyāhne purabhairavītaḍitkoṭisamābhāsāṃ bālāmakṣasragujjvalāmvāgbhavāṃ vāgbhavaudbhūtāṃ trīkṣaṇāṃ sasmitāṃ smaretvāgbījarūpāṃ nityāṃ tāṃ vidyutpaṭalabhāsvarāmsvecchāgṛhītavapuṣaṃ yuganityākṣarātmikāmjñānamudrāvarakarān vāgbhavopāstitatparānkartavyā matriṇā nityaṃ mantrasiddhisamṛddhayeaśuddhaḥ sa durācāraḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥhomān kṛtvā maheśāni nārakī jāyate naraḥkurvannakāraṇaṃ viprastyajañ śvā ca bhaveddhruvamsandhyānāmapi sarvāsāṃ prātaḥsandhyā garīyasī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇāḥ pañcāśad parivṛttitaḥkāmarājātmikāṃ devīmarkakoṭisamaprabhāmparitaścātmamukhyābhiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaśaktibhiḥyuganityākṣaramayīṃ ghaṭikāvaraṇāṃ smarethṛtpaṅkaje ca tāḥ kāmarājopāstiparāyaṇāḥśaktibījātmikāṃ cāpavāṇapāśāṃkuśānvitāmcintayitvā bhagavatīṃ nityābhiḥ parivāritāmnityāḥ ṣoḍaśa cājñāyā.ṃ sāyaṃkāle tu saṃsmaretdīkṣitaḥ sandhyayā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnutevidhāyottarasaṃdhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryat samāhitaḥdadhānāṃ kāmarājāṅke yantritāṃ muditāṃ smaretnavaratnamayaiścitraiḥ stavakaiścopaśobhitāmvirājamānāṃ tāṃ divyāṃ divyāṃśukavidhāriṇīmsahajāsavasaṃbhogaiḥ sañjātānandavigrahāmparito bhūṣaṇaiścitraiḥ kārṣṇacāmarakādibhiḥśaktibhirdarśitānagre paśyantīmabhitotsavāmmadhyapradhānadevyāstu samullāsātmakatvataḥkāmāṅkayantrādanyatra bhūṣāvarṇāyudhādikampradarśayet || iti prathamāvaraṇamsarvavidrāviṇīmudrāṃ pradarśayed || iti dvitīyāvaraṇapūjāsarvākarṣiṇīmudrāṃ pradarśayet | iti tṛtīyāvaraṇapūjāiti caturthāvaraṇapūjāpañcamāvaraṇapūjāṣaṣṭhāvaraṇapūjāsaptamāvaraṇapūjā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityaṣṭamāvaraṇapūjānavamāvaraṇapūjāvarṇaistajjanitairmantrairyantraiḥ kālātmatāṃ kramātyajjñānopāstibhedābhyāṃ mantrāḥ siddhyanti varṇinaḥmātṝṇāṃ tu svaraireko vargaḥ pūrvavaduttaramṣaṭsaptatyā pañcaśataṃ tāvadabdaistu pūrṇatātrisahasrasamāvṛttyā proktā kṛtayugāvadhiḥmāyādharāgnivātasvaiḥ kṛtādyarṇāḥ samīritāḥdinārṇeṣu svarā nyāse bindurūpā anukramāttattadyugārṇāṃstatsthāne svarūpeṇa vyavasthitāḥsarvatra yantravinyāsapratiṣṭhārcādyanugraheārabhya bhānorudayamekaśo ghaṭikākramātdivasaiḥ pañcabhistasyāḥ ṣaḍāvṛttirudīritāyonau trikoṇamālikhya tasmin yoniṃ samālikhetyugārṇaṃ ghaṭikārṇena madhye vinyasya tatra vaiuttamā nityanityaṃ hi madhyamā parvaparvaṇipūrṇamaṇḍalavarṇāḥ syuḥ prathame tvāditaḥ kramāttṛtīyā sarvato vahnirevaṃ vidyāstu tryakṣarāḥetāḥ pustakamāropya pīṭhe saṃsthāpya pūjayetbhūtāpamṛtyukṛtyādyā na bhavanti purādikesaṣaṭtriṃśatsaptaśataṃ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥstambhanādyeṣu tadvarṇāstadrūpā hetivāhanaiḥnāthāvṛttirmantrarāśau dvisahasraṃ śatatrayampūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkhyayaiva nityāvṛttiḥ sahasrataḥmātṛbhairavagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ mohayantīṃ jagattrayamsakalā vahnimāyābhyāṃ dvitīyaṃ bījamīritamṣaḍdīrghacandrabījena ṣaḍaṅganyāsa īritaḥratnakuṇḍalamuktālipadakāṅgadabhūṣaṇāmpāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca dadhānāṃ cākṣamālikāmnitambinīṃ kṣāmamadhyāṃ prāntaraktasulocanāmvākśāntimanubhiryuktaṃ bījatrayamudāhṛtambālasūryaprabhāṃ devīṃ japākusumasannibhāmsuvarṇakalaśākārapīnonnatapayodharāmdadhatīṃ bhairavīṃ dhyāyet pretasiṃhāsanasthitāmnityā ca bhairavī proktā caturvargaphalapradāpañcamuṇḍasamāsīnāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāmpāśāṃkuśābhayavarān dadhatīṃ bhāvayecchivāmjūṃjīvaṃ prāṇapadaṃ granthiṃ kuruyugaṃ tataḥmṛtasañjīvanī devī devatā parikīrtitāhaṃsastu kīlakaṃ proktaṃ mṛtasañjīvanāya caṣaṭcaturdikakenaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni samācaretvidyācatuṣṭayaṃ sākṣādamṛtānandavigrahamśaktibījaṃ samālikhya śivacandrau samālikhetsañjīvani ca jūṃ jīvaṃ prāṇagranthisthamālikhetsañjīvanī devatā syācchaktirasyādibījakamtrikaṃ ca kramato devi ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyasetjñānamudrāmakṣamālāṃ dadhatīṃ cintayet parāmvadadvandvaṃ vādanīti vāṅmadhye nikṣipet priyemahākṣobhaṃ kurudvandvaṃ śivacandrakalānalām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭaśaktyāvṛtāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmṣaṭtriṃśattattvagāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmkāditattvāntarāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmsarvātmikāṃ parāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmliṅgatrayātigāṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmprācyāṃ pratyakcitiṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmśaktiṃ viśveśvarīṃ vande devīṃ tripurabhairavīmjapanto vāramekaṃ tu vidyā nityātmikāstutāḥlabhante lalitā yābhiḥ saṃpradāyavatī bhavetmadhyāhne tu samārabhya madhyarātrau samāpayetvaśinyāḥ prathamaṃ varga kāmeśvaryā dvitīyamkamdineṣu modinīvargādekaikaṃ prajapet sudhīḥpaṃktidvayasthā vidyāstu prajapet prativāsarampūrṇāsu prajapedvidyāścatuṣpaṃktibhavāḥ sudhiḥnaitābhiḥ sadṛśī kāpi vidyā lokeṣu vidyateyadyannijopsitaṃ tattadduḥkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavetpañcāśadvāramāvartya vidyā bhaktisamanvitaḥśatavāraṃ samāvartya vidyāvibhavavaibhavāḥadhyardhaśatavāraṃ tu vidyā āvartya bhaktitaḥtāvadāvartya kanyā vā patiṃ sarvaguṇānvitamdviśataṃ tāḥ samāvartya dāridryānmucyate dhruvampañcabhiśca śatairbhūpo bhavet ṣaḍbhiḥ śatairnṛpaḥaṣṭabhistu śataistāsāṃ nṛpāḥ sarve'tha kiṃkarāḥevaṃ navaśataṃ japtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātdevīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāṃ pīṭharūpiṇīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālahallohalollolakalanāśamakāriṇīmravitārkṣyandukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥvande sarveśvarīṃ devīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkāmbrahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ tāṃ vande siddhimātṛkāmbrahmāṇḍādikaṭāhāntaṃ jagadadyāpi dṛśyatejyeṣṭhāṅgabāhuhṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭipādanivāsinīmpraṇamāmi mahādevīṃ paramānandarūpiṇīmkeyaṃ kasmāt kva keneti svarūpārūpabhāvanāmdevīṃ kulakalollolaprollasantīṃ paraulijāmvande tāmaṣṭavargotthamahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīmcaturājñākośabhūtāṃ naumi śrītripurāmahamdevyāstvakhaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanaṃ tava tadyataḥbhūtapretapiśācādipīḍāśāntyai sukhāptayecaurasiṃhadvīpigajagavayādibhayānakesalilāgnimarutpīḍāsvabdhau potādisaṃkaṭesukhī jivati nirdvandvo niḥsapatno jitendriyaḥyenāhamapi yuddheṣu devāsurajayī sadākāmeśī purataḥ pātu bhagamālā tvanantaramnityaklinnā tu bheruṇḍā diśaṃ pātu sadā mamamahāvajreśvarī rakṣedanantaradiśaṃ sadāpālayettu diśaṃ vātyāṃ rakṣetmāṃ kulasundarīnityā nīlapatākākhyā vijayā sarvataśca māmdehendriyamanaḥprāṇān jvālāmālinivigrahākāmāt krodhāt tathā lobhānmohānmānānmadādapistaimityācca samudyogādaśubheṣu tu karmasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rakṣantu māṃ sarvadā tāḥ kurvantvicchāṃ śubheṣu catathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadārathārūḍhāśca māṃ pāntu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇebhūgatāḥ sarvadā pāntu māṃ sarvatra ca sarvadādrāvayantu svaśaktīnāṃ bhīṣaṇairāyudhairmamaasaṃkhyāḥśaktayo devyaḥ pāntu māṃ sarvataḥ sadākadācinnāśubhaṃ paśyenna śṛṇoti ca tatsamaḥcaturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaḥ prasthāścatvāra āḍhakaḥkumbho droṇadvayaṃ śūrpaḥ khārī droṇāstu ṣoḍaśavṛttaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadasraṃ ca tadvadaṣṭādaśāsrakamcaturasramatha tryasramiti bhedā nava kramāttena dvāsaptatirbhedāsteṣu nityārṇabhedataḥeteṣvādyasya vṛttasya vinyāsenānyadunnayetevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryādekaikāṃgulato bahiḥṣaṭtriṃśadbhistatasteṣu nyasedvarṇāstathāditaḥbāhyāntaraparāvṛttī tathā vyākīrṇamityapiyojayedvāhyakoṣṭhasthaiḥ prāguktavidhinā kramātaṣṭāsre ṣoḍaśārāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvṛttamanyavatkṛtvā daleṣu kramaśo vāgdevyaṣṭakamālikhetvidhāta pūjayennityaṃ pustapūjoktasiddhayena kadācicchriyo hānirbhaviṣyati ca tatkuletatra devīṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya vidhivanniśisaṃpūjya śiṣyaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktyā tamabhiṣecayetkuryāt karṣasuvarṇasya mudrikā gauśca dakṣiṇāpārthivastasya vandyo vā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varṣatrayābhiṣekeṇa siddhyā vidyādharo bhavetpañcavarṣābhiṣekeṇa pañcatvaṃ nādhigacchatisaptavarṣābhiṣekeṇa divākarasamo bhavetnavavarṣābhiṣekeṇa devīsārūpyamāpnuyātāvṛttirjapahomārcātarpaṇaiḥ sādhu sadhayettathotpāteṣu sarveṣu tathā rogādyupadravetathā kṛtyāsamutpattāviyaṃ sarvārthasiddhidāetaccakrāravinyāsarūpā bhūmiśca dṛśyatesarve manorathāḥ siddhā bhajanaiḥ saṃpradāyataḥjapatarpaṇahomārcāsnapaneṣvapyayaṃ kramaḥkṛtyotpattau śatrubhaṅge nigrahe pratilomakamvaśīkaraṇarakṣāsu saṃpuṭadvitayaṃ kramātgobhūhiraṇyavāhādilābheṣu ca samīritaḥetadvidhānaniṣṇātaṃ praṇamanti surāsurāḥpratyutaiva parāvṛttāḥ kartāraṃ nāśayanti vaiśmaśāne parvate śūnye vipine kṣudrapīḍanesarvavyākīrṇacakreṇa sthāpitenāmarāvatīśilāyāṃ tāmrapaṭṭe vā rājate hemanirmitekṛtvā devālayaṃ tatra cakraṃ saṃsthāpya tasya vaigrāmādirakṣaṇe tatra madhye cāṣṭasu dikṣvapisamāvāhyābhipūjyāntaḥ sthāpayenmūlavidyayānityaśaḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ samamtatkāloktāni kuṇḍāni nava homeṣu sarvataḥyadyannijepsitaṃ tattad duṣkaraṃ sukaraṃ bhavetanyathā bhajanaṃ cecchan karotyāpatparamparām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadvidhānamato vakṣye caitrādyaṃ phālgunāvadhiubhayoḥ kāmyakarmāṇi ceti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥpūrvapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ niśi saṃsthāpya vidyayāasmin māse ca pūrṇāyāṃ vasantotsavapūjanamsaugandhikaiḥ sakāśmīraiḥ pūjāṃ pūrvaduvajjvalāmapi vā candrakastūrīcandanaiḥ śiśirodakaiḥphalaistu pūjayeddevīṃ pūrvavat sarvasiddhayeelākakkolajātībhirupetaiḥ pūjayecchivāmtadvidhānamidaṃ bhadre śṛṇu saubhāgyadāyakamkārpāsasaṃbhavai raktairnavadhā guṇitaiḥ śubhaiḥnavāṃgulairvā tatsaṃkhyasaragranthyādisaṃyutamkṛtvādhivāsapūrvaṃ tu pūjayet tairyathākramātaṣṭottaraśataiḥ sūtraiḥ kuryācchaktyavatārakamvārāhīkurukullādiśaktīnāṃ mūlaśaktivatkramāgamajñaśiṣyāṇāmātmavat samudīritamparidhānapramāṇena maṇḍapasyaikasūtrataḥkṛtvā pavitratritayaṃ tāni devyai samarpayetna kuryānmānasāṅkarya yadi kuryādvinaśyatihīno bhādrapado māsaḥ pakṣau sitasitetaraucaturdaśyaṣṭamīpūrṇamāsītithiṣu vai yajetprasūnairarcayaid devīṃ pūrvoktavidhinā yutamārabhya pūjayed devīṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥsahasraṃ juhuyānnityaṃ japaṃ caiva samācarethutvā bhūṣaṇavastrādidakṣiṇāṃ ca samudvasettena viddhān bhavet siddho nṛpatiṃ kurute'rcakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpaphalādīnāṃ prītistasyā na vidyatepūjayeduktamāgreṇa tasmāt sādhakasattamaḥekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayetgranthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitāmsaṃtyajed rogiṇīṃ kanyāṃ dāsīgarbhasamudbhavāmlābhārthe vaiśvavaṃśotthāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajāmśaṅkāhīnā bhaktiyuktā gūḍhaśāstropayoginīgurudaivatasadbhaktā sucittā kaulikapriyāmantratantrasamāyuktā samayācārapālikādurācārā parādhīnā bhāvahīnā durālasādurgandhā duḥkhitā mūrkhā vṛddhonmattā rahasyabhitvirūponmārgagā kruddhā paṅagvandhā vikṛtānanārātrau pradīpakairhomaṃ kuryād ghṛtasamedhitaiḥśaktīnāmekamekaṃ tu sthāpayet tattadagrataḥkṛtvā nivedayenmūlavidyayā saprasūnakamnivedyābhyarcayenmāṣapiṣṭāpūpairyathāvidhipūjayediṣṭasaṃsiddhyai gavyaṃ dugdhaṃ nivedayetpūjayeddugdhanaivedyaiḥ sitāpupādibhiḥ sadācūtasaugandhimadhukaiḥ pūjayedīpsitāptayekuryādvaiśeṣikaṃ puṇyeṣvāgamokteṣu teṣvapilepaṃ vilīnayed dehe repho binduriti smṛtaḥvyāpyamānā mahāśaktiḥ kāminīnāmṛtukramepuṣpībhūte bhage puṣpaṃ māsapakṣādiṣu kramātnyastaṃ vāpyatra deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarācaramdevī rakṣatu divyāṅgī divyātmā bhogadāyinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madīyaṃ madirānande āpādatalamastakamna guroḥ sadṛśaṃ vastu na devaḥ śaṅkaropamaḥnaca śānteḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ naca kṣānteḥ paraṃ sukhamdarśaneṣu samasteṣu pākhaṇḍeṣu viśeṣataḥdehi me devadeveśi (varaṃ ni)tyamabhīpsitamnetrayugmaṃ mahākālī karṇau rakṣatu kuṇḍalīdantān rakṣatu cāmuṇḍā cibuke meruvāsinījihvāṃ sarasvatī rakṣet tāluka tāluvāsinīkukṣau vināyakī sthātu jayānandā stanadayebrahmāṇī nābhideśe tu sthātu jvālāvatī gudenāḍīcakre mahāyogā udbhaṭā dakṣiṇe karevaiṣṇavī vāmapāde ca sthātu cakrāyudhānvitāpādāṃgulīṣu kauverī romakūpe mahādbhaṭājālandharī jalasthāne kāmākṣī kāmamadhyagāpṛṣṭhavaṃśe jayādevī asthisandhiṣu carcikāraktamadhye mano'nte ca sthātu me hiṃsinī śubhāvāmadakṣiṇayoścaiva vīrālī kaṭisandhiṣupṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva carājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatīraṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvanesamayā samayaṃ rakṣedvidyāṃ vidyā kulāgameprāṇā karotu me siddhiṃ trailokyavijayā sukhamsaptakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ nāyikā tu yāulkāmukhā mukhe sthātu mārjārī dehasandhiṣutrikoṇaṃ ca tridhāvartaṃ traipuraṃ cakramuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvoktā traipurī śaktiḥ sthātu me manmathotthitānivāsaṃ kuru me dehe sāṃprataṃ divyayoginīśatrūṇāṃ ghātanārthāya jetṝṇāṃ bhogadāyinīmāhendrī ca sikhāṃ sthātu yonimadhye gaṇeśvarīḍākinī pūrvabhāge ca mama saukhyaṃ prayacchatuvāmabhāge mahāmāyā karotu kuśalaṃ mamayā viśālā viśālākṣī nirmalā malavarjitāyā kālakalpitā kālī kālarātrī tu kathyateyā niśācararājanyapūjitā ca niśācarīyā cordhvakeśikā nāma muktakeśī mahābhayāyā vīreti samākhyātā vīrāṇāṃ jayadāyinīyā mālinī samākhyātā nāsāgre vidrumājinīyā kaṅkālakarālāṅgī caṇḍakaṅkālakuṇḍalāpracaṇḍā ca virūpākṣī virūpā viśvarūpiṇīkhaṭvāṅgī kathyate yā ca raudrī rudreṇa pūjitākaliyāginī prasiddhā ca yā loke śrūyate kalaupretākṣī kathyate yā ca phetkārokaṭavarjitā(?)dhūmrākṣī yā samākhyātā śāstre'smin yoginīmateghorarūpā mahādevī kathyate yā kulāgameviśvarūpā viśeṣeṇa karoti ca jagattrayambhayaṅkarī samādiṣṭā yā coktā vai kulāgamekapālamālikā proktā yā devī muṇḍadhāriṇībhīṣaṇā bhairavī nāma yā devī bhīmavikramānyagrādhavāsinī yā ca kathyate ca surārcitābhairavī bhīṣaṇī yā ca bhairavāṣṭakavanditā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: procyate dīrghalamboṣṭhī mahāmāyā mahābalākhaṭvāṅgī yā mahāśaktiḥ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīsamasteṣu mantreṣu procyate mantravādinīkālaghnī kathyate yā ca yugānte parameśvarīgrāhiṇīti samākhyātā surāsuramahoragaiḥcakriṇī gadyate yā ca ekapādā trilocanāyā viśvabāhukā devī viśvanāthapriyā sadādarśaneṣu samasteṣu viditā parameśvarīkaṇṭakocchedanārthāya śāstre yā kaṇṭakī smṛtākīlakī kathyate yā ca saptahastā mahābalāsaṃgrāme yā mahādevī mahāmārīti kathyateyamadūtīti vikhyātā yā surāsurapūjitākarālinīti yā devī mahāvidyā mahābalālalitāmbā mahārājñī sarvacakraikanāyikānāsāgre kaulikā sthātu madanasyā tathā mukhesā yoginī mahāmāyā sthātu śrīrmastake mamaraudrakarmā mahāghaṇṭā camarī tvaritā mataiḥkapālakuṇḍalo dīrghā kapālī kulagāminībhumirāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva carājyaṃ dadātu me caindrī prajāṃ caiva prajāvatīraṇe rājakule caiva śatrumadhye mahāvanesamayā samaye rakṣet vidyāṃ vidyā kulāgamedvijaṭī trijaṭī proktā kandalī lalitākhilāmādinī madanonmādā mandārī madanāturākṣudhā tṛṣṇā tathā nidrā kāntirbuddhistathā dyutiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suranātheti vikhyātā nagaretaradevatākāverī narmadā caiva gaṅgeti yamunocyatetrailokye'pi mahādevī strīnāmnī yā prakāśitāsuvarṇarekhiṇī proktā vidyā yā procyate kilakurukulleti vikhyātā pakṣirājamukhodbhavāoṃkāriṇīti vikhyātā dehe sthātu sadā mamabheruṇḍā sthātu me kaṇṭhe toralā sthātu mastakejāṅgalī viṣanāśāya vācāṃ siddhiṃ karotu meahaṃ brahmā ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ devo maheśvaraḥśaktinyāsena pūtena śarīreṇa surāsurāḥyatkiñcidyoginīrūpaṃ trailokye cāsti śaṅkarakāminī kurute cāpi yā nyāsaṃ bhaktinirmitamnamo'stu te jaganmātarnamo'stu bhuvaneśvariprakaṭā gopitāḥ sarvā nirvāṇā bhairavī śivāyakṣiṇī cūḍakanyā ca tathā cākāśagāminīcatuḥṣaṣṭyāśrayā devī yoginyo yena cintitāḥlalāṭe maṇḍalā sthātu virajā sthātu mastakejayantī sthātu me kukṣau kaṭyām kandarpakuṇḍalīambikā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe ca pārśvayoḥ sthātu medinīvyāghrī cakrī ca jaṅghāyāṃ syātu pādatale mahīkālindī mūlajihvāṃ ca raktaṃ rakṣatu raktinīmañjinī dehamañjāṃ tu śukraṃ śukreśvarī tathārudghaṭā kurute śāntiṃ sadaiva mama vigrahecorāgnirājasarpebhyo bhayādrakṣatu bhairavīcāpeṭī nāma yā vidyā sā me karotu maṅgalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mokṣaṃ kuruyugaṃ haṃsraṃ śakrasvaravisargavatgāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devateyaṃ tu bhairavīantyakūṭaṃ bhavecchaktiḥ sākṣānmṛtyuvināśinīdhyātvā cāvāhayeddevīṃ kadambavanamadhyagāmvibhratīṃ kundadhavalāṃ kumārīṃ cintayet parāmtato nityamadaprānte drave māyāṃ ca saṃlikhetchando virāṭ ca vajreśī devatā parikīrtitātārtīyaṃ kīlakaṃ devyāstato'ṅgāni pravinyasetdvikaṃ dvikaṃ trikaṃcaiva ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetraktāṃ candrakalācārumukuṭāṃ varabhūṣaṇāmśoṇitābdhitaratpotamahāyantroparisthitāmcāpaṃ kapālaṃ dadhatīṃ śoṇamālyānulepanāmrephaṃ śivādho niḥkṣipya bhuvaneśī ca bhairavījapākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhāmnānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmpāśāṃkuśavarābhītīrdhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śrayekumāryā eva munyādyā dhyānamasyā vadāmi tecandrakhaṇḍasphuradratnamukuṭāṃ kṣāmamadhyamāmunmattayauvanaprauḍhāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmpustakaṃ cābhayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe cākṣamālikāmmahāsiṃhāsanagatā bhairavī ḍāmareśvarīhitvoccaret tadā vidyāṃ mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarīmbandhūkakusumābhāsāṃ pañcamuṇḍādhivāsinīmtrinetrāṃ raktavasanāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmdadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityamuttarāmnāyamānitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghurghurā kīrtivikhyātā vande vidyācatuṣṭayamvighnarājaistato nāma tuṣṭā santānarūpiṇīdaśaitā mantravidyāstu tiṣṭhantu mama mastakevāmāṅgaṃ ratikāle ca paścime sthātu śṛṅkhalākavace kavacāṅgī ca netre netrakṛtotsavāyoginyo yāstu tāḥ sarvā dehaṃ kurvantu me vapuḥśaktinyāsamidaṃ deyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacityaḥ karoti mahānyāsaṃ ṣoḍhānyāsādikaṃ vibhośaktinyāse kṛte jīved yaḥ kaścicchedako bhavettantre pañcadaśaḥ śvāsaḥkiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥpuraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamucyatepuraścaraṇahīno'pi tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥpurataścaraṇīyatvād viniyogākhyakarmaṇāmphalāya mantrasevāyā rājasevā yathā tathāanarcito haretkāmāṃstasmāt tritayamācaretpañcāṅgopāsanenaiva puraścārī sukhaṃ vrajet || 1 || iti ||svābhiṣekaśca viprāṇāmārādhanamapīśvaripañcāṅgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇamucyatesūryārghya jalapānaṃ ca praṇāmaṃ devapūjanamdaśāṃśo (ṅgo) pāsanaṃ bhaktyā puraścaraṇamucyatetāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapiyadi na kṣubhyatītthaṃ hi sādhakasya mano manāktāsāmapi yadā nāsau kṣobhaṃ yāti manāgapievaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svayambhūrbāṇaliṅgaṃ vā vṛṣaśūnyaṃ jalasthitamśaktikṣetreṣu gaṅgāyāṃ nadyāṃ parvatamastaketatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣāddevīsvarūpavānevaṃ japaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvādau sādhakottamaḥkusumbhakusumairvāpi madhuratrayamiśritaiḥsarvakāmapradaṃ rājyabhuktimuktiphalapradamyasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadā śivaḥpūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥyoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥtaddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥatha muktāphalamayīṃ vāṅmokṣaphaladāyinīmyathā muktāphalamayīṃ tathā sphaṭikanirmitāmpravālamālā vaśye tu sarvakāryārthasādhikāputrajīvakamālā tu vaśyadā bhogadā bhavetsamāśritya japedvidyāṃ lakṣamātraṃ yadā śuciḥtadā dvitīyalakṣaṃ tu prajapet sādhakottamaḥtāsāṃ kaṭākṣajālaistu na mohaṃ yāti sādhakaḥtṛtīyalakṣe samprāpte grāvayanti surāṅganāḥsādhakaṃ drāvayantyeva tataścāsau manaḥsthiraḥevaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā vratasthaḥ svasthamānasaḥpuruṣā yoṣito vaśyāścarācaramapi priyeśamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallaverarkasambhavaiḥsahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥlakṣadvayena pāpāni saptajanmakṛtāni cajaptvā lakṣatrayaṃ mantrī yantrito mantravigrahaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japtvā vidyāṃ caturlakṣaṃ mahāvāgīśvaro bhavetjaptvā ṣaḍlakṣametasyā mahāvidyādhareśvaraḥaṣṭalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā vidyāṃ maheśvarinavalakṣapramāṇaṃ ca japtvā tripurasundarīmkartā hartā svayaṃ gauri loke cāprahataḥ prabhuḥtaddaśāṃśena homaṃ tu pūrvoktavidhinācarettatra tu sarvamantrāṇāṃ saṃkhyāvṛttiryugakramātdvāpare triguṇā proktā kalau saṃkhyā caturguṇāupoṣya śukladvādaśyāmārabhyāṣṭākṣaraṃ japetśuklācāraḥ śuciḥ snāto vāgyato vijitendriyaḥtato hi dviguṇābhyāsādaihikyāmūṣmikī ca sātretāyāṃ dviguṇaḥ prokto dvāpare triguṇastathāaśvatthabilvamūle vā sindhutīre jalāśayedeśāḥ puṇyā japasyaite yatra vā jāyate ruciḥgurorvā saṃnidhau goṣṭhe vṛṣaśūnye śivālayeabhīṣṭadevasāṃnidhye japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥharervivikta ityete deśāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥviprāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva saṃnidhau śasyate japaḥgṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto goṣṭhe daśaguṇastu saḥayutaṃ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣaguṇastu saḥekānte pāvane nindārahite bhaktisaṃyuteramye bhaktajanasthāne nivasenna parāśrayecaranti yena mārgeṇa na vasettatra tattvavitnadīkūlādrikūleṣu bhūchidrādiṣu no vasetbrūyādamukamantrasya puraścaraṇasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kṛtvā parimāṇaṃ ca sarvataḥgrāme krośamitaṃ sthānaṃ nagare taddvayaṃ smṛtamnikhaneddaśadigbhāge teṣvastraṃ ca prapūjayetkṣetrapālādikāṃstatra pūjayedvidhivittamaḥkūrmacakramavijñāya yaḥ kuryājjapayajñakamprāpnoti sakalānyuktānyanyathā nāśameti casa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakārastathocyategrāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā sa vyavasthitaḥprāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyasetīśe dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyasettanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥmukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoḥ sarvasiddhayaḥpucche mṛtyustu niyataṃ sarvārthasiddhayaḥarṇaṃ binduyutaṃ kṛtvā sveṣṭamantraṃ japetsudhīḥkṣārṇaṃ merumatho tatra kalpayejjagadīśvarianayā sarvamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥekaikāntaritaṃ mantraṃ japedevaṃ phalapradamtadābhimukhyacihnāni vighnāni prāktanādyataḥyena martyo'pi siddhyeta jīvanmukto bhavanmayaḥguruṃ vittena saṃtoṣya raktāgare kramaṃ bhajetmocāguḍasitāpetaṃ payaḥ pāyasamarpayethomaṃ daśāṃśataḥ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ cendumajjalaiḥkuryāttena bhavet pūrṇaṃ lakṣaṃ pūrṇāntamīśvaritretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ tadvaddvāpare triguṇam smṛtamtārtīyasaptasaṃkhyā sā tena syādekaviṃśatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vanītākṣobhato bhogānna vighna yadi jāyatevarjyāni śṛṇu deveśi taddineṣu sadaiva hicintāśokau tathālāpaṃ deśāntaraparibhramamśṛṇu sarvatra sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nāśakāni castrīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca duṣṭāsvapi na yojayetanukūlyasya cihnāni śṛṇu sādhayatastadāgajādrisaudhaśṛṅgeṣu vihāro rājadarśanamutsavaṃ sasurāmāṃsadarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ tathākuṣṇavarṇairbhaṭaiḥ svapne prahārastailalepanamrāṣṭrakṣobho vahnivāyuja(nanī?labhī) bandhunāśanamanyamantrārcane śraddhā vighno nityārcane'niśamśraddhāsthairya saṃpradāyasiddhi nityārcane bhavetsa nāpnoti phalānyuktānyanyathā nāśakāni casa caturdhā sthito loke tatprakāraṃ śṛṇu priyegrāmago gṛhagaśceti caturdhā tadvyavasthitiḥprāgādipaścimāntaṃ tu kādimāntāni vinyasetīśo dvayamatho madhye svarān prāgādi vinyasettanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ pāṇī kukṣiḥ pādau tatastataḥmukhe sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt karayoralpasiddhikṛtpucche mṛtistu niyatā pṛṣṭhe sarvārthadāyakamvyañjanaṃ deśakūrme syād gṛhakūrme svarāstathānityaṃ pūrvamukho yasmāttena tatsiddhirīritāmantrāṇāṃ yena siddhiḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sarvatastadāvijñāya varga teṣvekaṃ nāmādyaṃ nāmni kalpayetvāstuṣvajñātarūpeṣu prasiddhaṃ nāmato bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahākāle ca kāśyāṃ ca dīpasthānaṃ na cintayettadakṣaśāstrato jñātvā tatra samyak parityajetṛdvayasya ṭhakāreṇa ṭhakārasyāpi tena caodvayasya ṣakāreṇa ṣakārasyauyugena caḍakārasya takāreṇa phakārasya dhakārataḥaritvameṣāṃ varṇānāmanyeṣāṃ mitrabhāvanāyathā gargasya vairī syādaṭṭahāsaṃ mahatpuramṛjubhaṭṭasya ṭhakkākhyaṃ ḷtakasyāriḥ padmakamjyantī ṭaṅkadhārasya khaṃdhāraṃ ṛṃṝ(jhaṃjha)ṇasya cabhadrasya ramyakaṃ caiva yajñadattasya somakaḥanulomavilomasthaiḥ kḷptayā varṇamālayāvairimantrā api nṝṇāṃ susiddhādyāstu kiṃ punaḥtadvarṇasaṃkhyamaṇibhirjapamālāṃ prakalpayetkṣāntaṃ saṃhārayuktaṃ paśupatigaditā yāmale mālikeyampañcaviṃśatibhiḥ proktā maṇibhirbhuktidāyinīabhicārakarī pañcadaśabhiḥ parikalpitāaṣṭottaraśataiḥ kḷptā sarvābhīṣṭapradā matāmuktipradāḥ sphaṭikajāḥ padmākṣāḥ puṣṭivardhanāḥputrajīvabhavāḥ putrapaśudhānyasamṛddhidāḥmauktikā muktidāḥ proktāḥ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidāḥpadmākṣairvihitā mālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinī matāputrajīvaphalaiḥ kḷptā kurute putrasaṃpadamhiraṇmayairviracitā mālā kāmān prayacchatisaubhāgyaṃ sphāṭikī mālā mauktikairvihitā śriyamsarvairetairviracitā mālā sā muktaye nṛṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānyanmadhye prayoktavyaṃ putrajīvādikaṃ ca yattasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca na dadāti priyaṅkarīmiśrībhāvaṃ tato yāti caṇḍālaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥniśādārukṛtā vaśye lākṣayā jvarakarmaṇigajadantasya maṇibhiḥ kuryāt sarvārthadāyinīmāraṇe cāyasī proktā śrīphalairbilvakāṣṭhajaiḥtāmasī ceti tāsvādyā śatairaṣṭottaraiḥ śubhaiḥmaṇibhiḥ sāttviko putrajīvai rajatasaṃbhavaiḥkuśagranthibhavaiḥ kḷptā rājasī caturuttaraiḥsauvarṇai raktatarujaiḥ pītasārasamudbhavaiḥdevadārusamudbhūtaiḥ kṛṣṇākāṣṭhasamudbhavaiḥsā śamīnimbabimvākṣairindrabhadrasamudbhavaiḥnarāśvarāsabhebhānāṃ snāyubhirgrathitairapimantrajñairviṣṇumantreṇa divyabhāge prayatnataḥcaturdaśyāṃ tathā kuryācchivasyāpi sureśvaripūrvāhne devi kartavyā saptamyāṃ jagadīśvarikārpāsairvaiṣṇavī mālā padmasūtrairathāpi vākārpāsasūtrairanyeṣāṃ vidadhyāñjapamālikāmrudrākṣairjapamālā tu kathaṃ kāryā maheśvarajapamālā vidhānena yena sā japasiddhidāṣaḍvaktrairvātha kartavyā (nitho) miśraistu varjayetrudrākṣasyottamaṃ proktaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnagambadarārdhapramāṇena caṇakānmadhyamādhayenavena tantunā caitad grathanīyamasaṃspṛśatādyaṃ sthūlaṃ tatastasmāt nyūnaṃ nyūnataraṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmagranthiyutaṃ kuryāt pratibījaṃ yathāvidhitrirāvṛttyāśca madhyena cārdhavṛttyāntadeśataḥyathākāmaṃ yathālābhamakṣānānīya yatnataḥkīṭādibhiradaṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni cagomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyā nīlāyāśca bhaveddadhigavāṃ varṇāstu sulabhāḥ santi deśeṣu yatra cavarṇālābhe na doṣo'sti mātrāhīnaṃ tu varjayetkṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pañcagavye tathā dadhiāpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrābṇetyṛcyā dadhisadyojāteti mantreṇa kṣālayet pañcagavyakaiḥdhūpayet tāmaghoreṇa kṛṣṇāgurusuguggulaiḥsūtraṃ maṇīṃśca gandhādbhiḥ kṣālitāṃstatra nikṣipetvinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥgopucchasadṛśī kāryā ekāgrā vā samerukāgrathitaṃ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pūrvavacca sadā śivejitāstena surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇvīndradevatāḥlokānāṃ bhayanāśāya ṛtudharmapravṛttayecintitaṃ yanmayā putra aghorāstramanuttamamdivyavarṣasahasrāṇi cakṣurunmīlitaṃ tayāte cāsrubindavo jātā mahārudrākṣavṛkṣakāḥphalanti sarvakālaṃ hi avicchinnaphalapradāḥvakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayati ca śataṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥkūrpare ṣoḍaśa proktā dvādaśa maṇibandhayoḥtadardhamuraso mālā śikhāyāmekamucyatesaṃkhyāhīnaṃ na kartavyamadhikaṃ naiva duṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mokṣārthe pañcaviṃśatyā saptaviṃśatiḥ pauṣṭikebrāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraśceti caturvidhaḥeteṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭho japamālākṛte bhṛśamatisthūlo'tisūkṣmaśca sphuṭito bhaṃguro laghuḥmaṇau yadunnataṃ sthānaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ tu nimnakamanyonyagharṣaṇādeva japahānirbhaved dhruvamanyonyamadhyadeśe tu kartavyā granthayaḥ śubhāḥdhāraṇasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyate vidhivat kramātdvivaktraṃ devadevyau tu govadhaṃ nāśayed dhruvamcaturvaktraḥ svayaṃ brahmā guruhatyāṃ vyapohatiṣaḍvaktraḥ kārtikeyastu dhārayeddakṣiṇe karesaptavaktro mahānāgo hyananto nāma nāmataḥaṣṭavaktro mahāsena sākṣāddevo gaṇādhipaḥnavavaktro bhairavaḥ syād dhārayedvāmahastakedaśavaktro bhavedvatsa sākṣāddevo janārdanaḥsambhavāni ca doṣāṇi kṣipraṃ naśyanti dhāraṇātśikhāyāṃ dhārayennityaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇugavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalamvaktradvādaśarudrākṣaṃ bhāskaradvādaśātmakamvaktratrayodaśaṃ vatsa rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayetcaturdaśasuvaktraṃ vai rudrākṣaṃ yadi dhārayetpavitramayavaktrastu (?) śaśikhaṇḍaśirāḥ svayambahulaṃ prāpyate puṇyaṃ bhāgyavān jāyate naraḥprāyaścitte tathā śrāddhe dīkṣākāle viśeṣataḥyo vipraḥ satataṃ kuryāt tatkarma saphalaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrākṣadhāraṇādeva rudro bhavati mānavaḥtatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ proktaṃ lakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ dhruvamtataḥ koṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate dhāraṇānnaraḥgale baddhavā koṭiśataṃ mūrdhni koṭisahasrakamaprameyaphalaṃ haste surudrākṣadharo bhavetsadyo bhavati pūtātmā rudrākṣe śirasi sthiteso'pi rudratvamāpnoti kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥmucyate sarvapāpebhyo naro rudrākṣadhāraṇātpāpakarmāpi yo nityaṃ rudraloke mahīyatesaṃkīrṇā sā bhaved brahmaṃsteṣāṃ vaṃśaparamparāmālāṃ vidhāya vai pātre kvacidgandhādicarcitāmgaṇeśasūryaviṣṇvīśadūrgāścāvāhya pūjayettasmāduttolya tāṃ mālāṃ svarṇapātre nidhāya catayodhūpāntikaiḥ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtavidhiṃ budhaḥtataścandanasaugandhikastūrikuṃkumādibhiḥtasyāṃ navagrahāṃścāpi dikpālāṃśca prapūjayetdurgāṃ ca pūjayed vidvān mālāyāṃ susamāhitaḥtatastūttolya tāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayeddhemapātrakecandanena sugandhena kastūrīkuṃkumādibhiḥprānaṃ jīvasamārūḍhamaukārasvarabhūṣitamnava grahān pūjayitvā tato dikpālapūjanamsvarṇaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād viprāṃstu paritoṣayetsaṃhṛṣṭaḥ kārayenmālāṃ viśuddhāṃ svarṇarūpyiṇīmvarṇamānena sā kāryā pañcagavye tryahaṃ kṣipetsamānavarṇasūtreṇa māpayed hṛdayāṇunā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāminībhairavī ceyaṃ bhayavidhvaṃsinīti vāātāmrārkāyutābhāsāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāmmuṇḍamālāvalīramyāṃ cintayedbhairavīṃ parāmvidyānāṃ pañcakaṃ devi triṣu lokeṣu durlabhamhakālānte maheśāni śivabījaṃ tu saṃlikhethasānugrahasargāḍhyaṃ vidyaikā sundarī priyeantyaṃ sasargamādye hi bindunādakalātmikehasa-ehasahasrāṃśca vāgbhavena ca yojayetcatuṣkaṃ śivabījānāṃ repho'nugrahasargavānparayā piṇḍitaṃ kuryāt kūṭametat tridherayetcaturthī sundarī khyātā bhogamokṣapradāyinīetadādyaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca hasayukkṣmākṣahendumattripureśīmanoreṣā pañcamī sundarī bhavetṛṣyādipūjā vijñeyā tripureśīva nānyathāmahālakṣmīśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitābindunādasamāyuktaṃ lakṣmīmantra udāhṛtaḥśaturye bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ repha ucyatedhyāyet tataḥ śriyaṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtāmāsicyamānāmamṛtairmuktāratnadravairapiratnaughabaddhamukuṭāṃ śuddhakṣaumāṅgarāgiṇīmevaṃ dhyātvā japeddevīṃ padmayugmadharāṃ sadāśrīpuṭaṃ cātha kamale kamalāye prasīda caprasīda pūrvabījāni sampuṭatvena yojayetgāyatrī devatā lakṣmīrhṛdayaṃ parikīrtitampraṇavaḥ kīlakaṃ devi tato'ṅgāni pravinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmagranthiṃ tato dadyānnāgapāśamathāpi vāsarvaśeṣe tato meruṃ sūtradvayasamanvitamevaṃ niṣpādya deveśi pratisṭhāṃ ca samācaretpūjayitvā yathānyāyamiṣṭadevamanukramātjuhuyācca daśāṃśena yasya devasya yatpriyamastramantraṃ tato nyasya mūlamantraṃ tato nyasetabhedarūpamāsādya mālāṃ kuryāt tadātmikāmevaṃ pratiṣṭhāmāpādya mālāyāmiṣṭadevatāmnānyamantraṃ japet tatra yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥjīrṇa sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ granthayitvā śataṃ japetpratiṣṭhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ tu mantraṃ japyādananyadhīḥakṣasrajā vāṃgulibhirjapet taṃ nātidrutaṃ nātivilambitaṃ camadhyamāmūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitāaṃgulījapasaṃkhyājaṃ phalamekaguṇaṃ smṛtamśataṃ syāccheṣamaṇibhiḥ pravālaistu sahasrakampadmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyateśvetapadmākṣamālābhirjape syādamitaṃ phalamaṃguṣṭhena vinā japtaṃ viphalaṃ bhavati priyemadhyamānāmikāmadhyaparvadvayamiha priyeanāmāmūlaparvādikaniṣṭhānukrameṇa tugaṇayecca krameṇaivaṃ kiñcit saṃkocayet talamaṃgulīnāṃ viyoge tu cchidreṣu sravate japaḥyatastajjapamīśāni balād gṛhṇanti rākṣasāḥmeruṃ kṛtvā japed devi tarjanīmūlakāvadhipṛthak kṛtāstaiḥ kurvīta varṇamālāṃ viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śīghraṃ siddhirbhavatyeva satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥtadbhūtavarṇadeśake vyañjanānāṃ sureśvaritattadbhūtapradhānārṇaṃ meruṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥmantrārṇauṣadhicūrṇasya guṭikākṛtamālayāavyagratvamanirvedo japasampattihetavaḥsarvathā labhate siddhimanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavettadeva karma kurvīta tanmanāstatparāyaṇaḥyajet vaiṣṇavaṃ karmasthiradhīrniyatendriyaḥdūrato'pi na siddhiḥ syāditarasya dvijottamaḥnityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānaṃ kṣudrakarmavivarjanamnaimittikārcanaṃ caiva viśvāso gurudevayoḥsaṅkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyāniṣpattireva caviparītaṃ brahmacaryametadevāṣṭalakṣaṇamjapet pratidinaṃ yattu nitya eṣa japaḥ smṛtaḥdvādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu teṣu naimittiko japaḥtasmādāśīḥ sadā grāhyā tataḥ santoṣamācaretnāstyasādhyaṃ jagatyatra suprasanne guro muneśrutismṛtipurāṇoktamantraiḥ snāyādanantaramkandamūlaphalairvāpi kuryādaśanamanvahambhavecchuddhamatirmantrī naca drohaṃ samācaretnityaṃ goṣu prasannāsu gopālā'pi prasīdatina cchāyāmākramedvidvān vibhītakakarañjayoḥtailābhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayetna nagno na sugandhāḍhyo gītavādye vivarjayetstrīśūdrapatitavrātyanāstikocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samyairapi na bhāṣet japahomārcanādiṣutāmbūlaṃ gandhalepaṃ ca puṣpadhāraṇameva caasadbhāṣaṇamatyarthaṃ varjayedanyapūjanamasaṅkalpitakṛtyaṃ ca varjayenmardanādikamprokte pāmaraśabde'pi prāṇāyāmaṃ sakṛccaretkṣute caiva tathāspṛśyasthānānāṃ sparśane tathāvyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayamkṣute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇe japamutsṛjetkṛtvā samyagjapeccheṣaṃ yadvā sūryādidarśanamdṛṣṭvācamya caret karma spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyatedarśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇijyotīṃṣi ca prapaśyedvā kuryādvā prāṇasaṃyamamete jyotīṃṣi coktāni vidvadbhirbrāhmaṇastathāśvanī ca darśanaṃ nidrā pralāpo'mī japadviṣaḥpūjāyāṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya saptavāraṃ prakīrtayetprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ śeṣaṃ samāpayetsnātvācamya yathānyāyaṃ kṛtvā nyāsān punarjapetnāpyatarpayato devān nāsatyamabhijalpataḥālasyaṃ bhāvanāśaktiḥ siddhināśāya niścitamtyajed durjanasaṃsparśaṃ sāśaṅkādibhavaṃ tyajetapavitrakaro'śuddhaḥ pralapanna japet kvacitcintāvyākulacitto vā kruddho bhrāntaḥ kṣudhānvitaḥrathyāyāmaśivasthāne japenna timirālayeprasārya na japet pādāvutkaṭāsana eva vāuttiṣṭhati tadā nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vinyaset punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hrasvāḥ pracaraṇīyāḥ syuḥ kuśā dīrghāśca barhiṣaḥsavyaḥ sopagrahaḥ kāryo dakṣiṇaḥ sapavitrakaḥaśūnyaṃ tu karaṃ kuryāt suvarṇarajataiḥ kuśaiḥājyena ca vinā homaḥ phalaṃ dāsyanti naiva tegodhūmā vrīhayo muñjā daśa darbhāḥ savalvajāḥayātayāmāste darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥnuda pāpāni sarvāṇi bhava svastikaro mamahuṃphaṭkāreṇa mantreṇa sakṛcchitvā samuddharetamūlā devakāryeṣu prayojyāśca japādiṣuanantargarbhiṇau sāgrau pādeśe tu pavitrakeekaikaparṇamutsṛjya varṇe varṇe yathākramamtribhistu śāntike kārya pauṣṭike pañcabhistathāsapavitraḥ sadarbho vā karmāṅgācamanaṃ caretyaiḥ kṛtaḥ piṇḍanirvāpaḥ śrāddhaṃ vā pitṛtarpaṇamnīvīmadhyasthitāstyājyā yajñabhūmau sthitāstathāvastrāditoyagrahaṇe na doṣaḥ pivato bhavetsnāne home jape dāne svādhyāye pitṛtarpaṇekuśābhāve tu kāśāḥ syuḥ kāśāḥ kuśasamāḥ smṛtāḥnārdro lunīyādrātrau vā lunīyādvā na sandhyayoḥpralapan vā japedyāvat tāvanniṣphalamucyatenagno dviguṇavastraḥ syānnagnaḥ snigdhapaṭastathāekakacchaḥ kacchaśūnyo nagnaḥ pañcavidhaḥ smṛtaḥproḍhapādo na kurvīt svādhyāyaṃ caiva tarpaṇamkṛtāvasakthiko yastu prauḍhapādaḥ sa ucyateantaraṅgākṣarāṇāṃ ca nyāsapūrvo japaḥ smṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ya uccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥśanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau ca cālayetjihvājapaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kevalaṃ jihvayā japaḥuccaredarthasaṃsmṛtyā sa ukto mānaso japaḥupāṃśuḥ syācchataguṇaḥ sāhasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥmānasaḥ mokṣakāryeṣu dhyāyedeva ca sarvataḥahiṃsayā hi bhūtānāṃ jāyate vā mahāphalamte sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmprasannā vipulān bhogān dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāsvatīmte sarve japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmcaturhastaṃ dvihastaṃ ca sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdu nirmalamvastrāsanaṃ rogaharaṃ vetrajaṃ śrīvivardhanamdharmārthakāmamokṣāptiścailājinakuśottarevyāghrājinaṃ ca kauraṅgamanyairnānāvidhāsanaiḥvarjayedāsanaṃ mantrī dāridryavyādhiduḥkhadamviśedyatirvanasthaśca brahmacārī ca snātakaḥvaṃśāsanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca kevalaṃ kṣitirāsanamtṛṇāsane bhavedrogaḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥkṣityāsanaṃ bhavet pīḍāpāpavisphoṭaduḥkhadamcintā ca prabalā hāniruccaṭo vividho jvaraḥitthaṃ cāṣṭāsanaṃ devi varjayet sarvakarmasutataḥ karma samārabhetkṛtābhiṣeko vidhivanmantraṃ labdhvā gurormukhātbhojanācchādanādyaistu viprān santarpayedyathāārabheta japaṃ paścāt tadanujñāpuraḥsaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mañjayadvitayaṃ bhūyo tarjayadvitayaṃ tathākṣetrapāla baliṃ gṛhṇadvayaṃ pāvakasundarītathaiva parivārāya balimetena cāharetmantropadeśo guruṇā sādhanaṃ ca śubhāvahampuṇye muhūrte nakṣatre tithu snātvā yathāvidhisūryādidevatābhyaśca nivedya vratamācaretniyamavyatirekeṇa sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalamupavāsaṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt tathā saṃkalpayed budhaḥprārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe ca sūtakamnāndīmukhaṃ vivāhādau śrāddhe pākapariṣkriyākāmataḥ pūjite mantre śāntikādau ca kutracitśatatrayamakāmācca prāyaścittavidhau japetuktasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kuryāt puraścaraṇasiddhayejapedekamanāḥ prātaḥkālānmadhyandināvadhiyadi nyūnādhikaṃ kuryād vratabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥnājaptaḥ siddhidānecchurnāhutaḥ phalado bhavetpratyahaṃ sādhakaḥ kuryāt svayaṃ cet siddhimicchatijapadhyānasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ siddhyati mantravityathoktakuṇḍe juhuyādyathāvidhi samāhitaḥdivasātikramāt puṃso mantrasiddhirbhavet nahidināntare'pi prajapedanyathā siddhirodhakṛtādyantayorvidhīyante nāsikāpuṭacāriṇaḥnidhāya maṇḍalasyāntaḥ savyahastagatāṃ ca vācaturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhavabījaṃ gaṇapateḥ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastena srajamādāya cintayan manasā śivāmmantraṃ ca kaṇṭhato dhyātvā pītavarṇaṃ hiraṇmayamājñācakre tataḥ paścād gurormantrasya cātmanaḥtattvasvarūpamekaṃ tadyaccakraṃ pratilambhayetlambhayenmūlamantreṇa ādiṣoḍaśacakrakamcintayan sādhako devi japakarma samārabhettatprānte tripathasthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caturaṃgulamkaṇṭhe trayāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ veṣṭanaṃ vidyate nṛṇāmtatṣaṭcakramiti proktaṃ śuklaṃ kaṇṭhasya madhyagamtatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ syāt saptāṃgulapramāṇataḥdhyeyānāmapi mantrāṇāṃ cintanasya japasya camantrastathaiva niḥsetuḥ kṣaṇāt kṣarati yajvanāmpārśvayoḥ setumādāya japakarma samārabhetmadhyamāyā madhyabhāge varjayitvā tu tarjanīmsthāpayitvā tatra mālāmaṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tadgatamprativāraṃ paṭhenmantraṃ śanairoṣṭhau na cālayetpūrvaṃ japaprayuktana cāṃguṣṭhāgreṇa bhairavaaṃguṣṭhena bhavettasya niṣphalaḥ sa japaḥ sadādevīṃ vicintayan japyaṃ kuryādvāmena na spṛśetna spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭaṃ na kārayetjapakāle sadā vidvān meruṃ naiva vilaṅghayetkaliḥ khaṭakhaṭāśabde dolamāne calanmatiḥhastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vinaśyatipramādāt tarjanīsparśe bhavedāvartanaṃ tyajetna spṛśetaṃ kadācit tu spṛṣṭhe hyāvartanaṃ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhugnagrovonnataḥ śāntaḥ kaṇḍūnmīlanavarjitaḥnadrutaṃ nāpi viśrāntaṃ kramānmantraṃ japet sudhīḥvilambitaṃ ca nātīva tathā spaṣṭapadodbhavamevaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ vipra vinivedyaśca yāgavattvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mamapuṣkaraṃ śikhibījasthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmānvitaṃ bhaveteṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥnivedayed vibhostacca vākkarmamanasānvitamgṛhaṇimaṃ japaṃ nātha mama dīnasya śāśvataagrato nikṣiped viṣṇormūlamantreṇa nāradamūlasyāṣṭaśataṃ japtvā na drutaṃ na vilambitamsiddhirbhavatu me deva tvatprāsādāt tvayi sthitāmūlamantrārghyatoyena varahaste nivedayettadūrdhve pūrvavat snātvā viśeṣeṇa vidhānavitpūjāgnihomaparyantaṃ tataśca japamārabhetupāsya pūrvavat sandhyāṃ devaṃ saṃpūjayet punaḥpayovratī vā niyato japedekāgramānasaḥsatkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśī vāgrajanmanāmetatsaptavidhaṃ proktaṃ pavitraṃ vratabhojanampūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ praśastaṃ syādaśanaṃ mantrasādhaneaśūdrāvahataṃ padbhyāmanuttolyahataṃ ca yattilāścaiva sitā mudgāḥ kandaḥ kemukavarjitaḥāmramāmalakaṃ caiva panasaṃ ca harītakīavaiṣṇavamalabhyaṃ cāpyapraśastaṃ vratāntarelaghumiṣṭahitāśī ca vinītaḥ śāntacetanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalāyakaṃgunīvārā vāstūkaṃ hilamocakākandaṃ saindhavasāmudre gavye ca dadhisarpiṣīpippalī jīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṅgakatintiṇīatailapakvaṃ munayo haviṣyānnaṃ pracakṣatenivedayennaiva tatra hareraikāntikī ratiḥmāṣamudgamasūrādyān kodravāṃścaṇakānapimāṣāḍhakīmasūrāṃśca kodravāṃścaṇakānapialpāśanādasaṅgācca ṣaḍbhirmantraḥ prasiddhyatinīcasaṅgācca laulyācca ṣaḍbhirmantro na siddhyatidevī mantramayaṃ sākṣād dhyāyedātmānamātmanina siddhyati varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapikāṃsyapātraṃ ca tailaṃ ca mantravīryaharāṇi ṣaṭtasmāt sarvaprayatnena mantrī paryuṣitaṃ tyajetphalalopo bhavennūnaṃ mantravīryaṃ hared dhruvampittalaṃ mṛtyudaṃ nūnaṃ kṣudradhānyaṃ ca kodravammasūrī mānahantrī ca parityājyātha sarvadāmantravīryaṃ haratyāśu yadyapi syānmaheśvaraḥtilatailaṃ mantrapūtaṃ pāvanaṃ devadurlabhamvarjayejjapavelāyāṃ bhojyaṃ naiva sadā budhaiḥpācayedvaidikairmantraiḥ punarmūlena mantravitarddharātre samutthāya pādaśaucaṃ cared dvijaḥjapaṃ kuryādyathāśakti arpayecca tatheśvaritadvāsaḥ kṣālayennityamanyathā vighnamāvahetmantrite ca śivaṃ dhyāyan prākśirasko niśi svapetdarbhaśayyāṃ gato rātrau dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: laghvekabhug dakṣiṇapārśvaśāyī svapnaṃ parīkṣet yathopadeśamiṣṭāniṣṭaṃ samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvataśubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubhamsvapnamāṇavamantro'yaṃ śambhunā parikīrtitaḥvāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥkriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvaraviśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥapāvakaṃ yatsvasthānāmakhyātānāṃ hi darśanamapāvakaṃ mānasaṃ ca yathārthaphalamucyatemāse pākaḥ śarvarīturyayāme sadyaḥ pāko yo visargaṣu dṛṣṭaḥguruṃ prasādasumukhaṃ nirmalaṃ candramaṇḍalamprasannaṃ tatra jānīyāt siddhiṃ svapnanidarśanehomaśca jvalite vahnau saṃgrāmavijayastathākuñjaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mālyaṃ samudraṃ phalinaṃ drumamevamādīni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyātsamṛddhiṃ tatra jānīyāt tasmin svapnanidarśanebhāskarodayanaṃ caiva prajvalantaṃ hutāśanamnāgāśvavṛṣabhendrāṇāṃ taruśailāgrarohaṇamlābhaḥ siddhataroścaiva devīnāṃ caiva darśanamsvapne tu madirāpānamāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇambhojanaṃ dadhibhaktasya śvetavastrānulepanamratnānyābharaṇādīni svapne dṛṣṭvā prasiddhyatidarpaṇaṃ śaṅkhabhīryyau ca tantrīvādyaṃ ca rocanamsiddhānnamāmamāṃsaṃ ca madyastrīmadirāsavāḥmālyamuktāphale hāraḥ pūrṇaḥ samuditaḥ śaśī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ratnodyadvasupātraṃ ca padmayugmaṃ ca hemajamcaturbhujāṃ sphuradratnanūpurāṃ mukuṭojjvalāmpadmāsanasamāsīnāṃ dūtībhirmaṇḍitāṃ sadāiyaṃ triśaktirdeveśi triṣu lokeṣu durlabhātriśaktirdevatāṅgāni dvirāvṛttyā yajet priyenavahemasphuradbhūmau ratnakuṭṭimamaṇḍapekamalāsanaśobhāḍhyāṃ ratnamañjīramaṇḍitāmanarghyaratnaghaṭitanānāmaṇḍalabhūṣitāmṣaḍbhujāminduvadanāṃ dūtībhiḥ parivāritāmtāmbūlasvarṇapātrībhirbhūṣāpeṭīsupāṇibhiḥyasyā ārādhane viṣṇurabhūllakṣmīpatiḥ svayamvidhvakrūreśvarīyuktaṃ vidyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī priyedevatā mohanī lakṣmīrmahāsāmrājyadāyinīṣaḍbhirādyaiḥ svarairbhitvā ṣaḍaṅgāni pravinyasetśaṅkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgabāṇadharāṃ karaiḥsarvasaubhāgyajananīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi cayasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjanma na vidyateajapā mātṛkā caiva pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥtataḥ so'haṃ śiro devi vasuvarṇayamīritāparajyotirmayī sākṣāddevatā parikīrtitāsvāhā tu hṛdayaṃ so'haṃ śiro haṃsaḥ śikhā bhavetsṛṣṭyānmantreṇa deveśi samagraṇāstrakaṃ bhavetyasyāḥ smaraṇalātreṇa cidānandāyaye tanuḥparaniṣkaladevīyaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇījñānamudrāṅkitā yogipativṛndena sevitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praphullapādapaḥ śālī rocanā kuṃkumaṃ madhuupapanno'pyathācāryo gāyatrī varasaṅgatāsarve svapnāḥ śubhāḥ proktāḥ siddhimokṣaphalapradāḥgarhitā lokavidviṣṭāḥ svapnāste hyaśubhāvahāḥtailābhyaktaṃ naraṃ nagnaṃ śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ sakaṇṭhakamkevalenāthavājyena siṃhamantreṇa śāntayeastrasaṃpuṭitenaiṣāṃ nāmnā svāhānvitena capraṇamya śirasā hṛṣṭastasmai svapnaṃ nivedayetakasmādyadi jāyeta nākhyātavyaṃ gurorvināprakāśanīyaṃ viprendraṃ kasyacit siddhimicchatānikaṭasthāśca tāstasya siddhayo yānti dūrataḥnijaṃ śarīramathavā devatāmayameva hijāyante bahavo vighnā niyamasthasya nāradatṛtīyavatsarādūrdhvaṃ rājānaśca mahībhṛtaḥprasādaḥ kriyatāṃ nātha mamoddharaṇakāraṇamataste muniśārdūla niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumakṣamāḥnānāścaryāṇi hṛdaye mantrasiddhimayāni vaijaḍadhīstu kṣaṇaṃ viprakṣaṇamasti praharṣitaḥkṣaṇaṃ ca madhuraṃ vādyaṃnānāgītasamanvitamutpatantaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāpi paśyatyātmānamātmanāgajagovṛṣanādāṃśca śṛṇuyācca kṣaṇaṃ dvijaḥtārakāṇi vicitrāṇi yogino nabhasi sthitānkṣaṇaṃ kilikilārāvaṃ haṃsavarhiravaṃ tathārātrau ca divasālokaṃ sasūryyaṃ kṣaṇamīkṣatepūrṇendusadṛśaḥ kāntyā gamane vihagopamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svalpāśanenākṛśatā bahunāpi na cīyatejapadhyānagato mantrī na khedamadhigacchatiityevamādibhiścihnarmahāvismayakāribhiḥadhiṣṭhitaṃ niśyadīpaṃ nistamisraṃ gṛhaṃ bhavetyadi siddhiṃ na labhate dvistrirvā punarācaretvedyāmathāyase pātre mṛṇmaye vā nave śubhegomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau susthalarūpakamaṃgulotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥudakprahvaḥ pradeśo vā sthaṇḍilasya sthalaṃ smṛtamtadyoṣitāṃ sa evoktaḥ śūdro yaṃ varṇamāśritaḥtatsubhruvāṃ ca tadbhṛtya śūdrāṇāṃ ca sa eva hitarpayāmīti mantrānte proktādbhirmūrdhni tarpayetabhiṣiñcet svamūrdhānaṃ jalaiḥ kumbhākhyamudrayānānāvidhairbhakṣyabhojyairlehyaiścopyaistathetaraiḥviprārādhanamātreṇa vyaṅgaṃ sāṅgatvamāpnuyātaṅgahīnaṃ bhavedyadyat karma neṣṭārthasādhakamta eva pūrṇatāṃ yānti samastāni bhavanti cetyāni yānyapi karmāṇi hīyante dvijabhojanaiḥguruṃ santoṣayet paścādgohiraṇyāmbarādibhiḥitthaṃ puraścaraṇataḥ prasannā devatā bhavetpareritaṃ vā gāthāṃ vā saṃjapedyadyanarthakṛtbrahmahatyāsamaṃ teṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitammantraṃ gurumukhāt prāptamekaṃ syāt sarvasiddhidamdūraṅgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastuyadapūrvaṃ yakṣyamantaḥ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu

sanskrit: yasmānna ṛte kiñcana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastuyena yajñastāyate saptahotā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastuyasmiṃścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastuhṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yadajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastuiṣṭāniṣṭe samācakṣva mama svapnasya śāśvatavāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥkriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvaraviśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥgrahaṇe'rkasya cendorvā śuciḥ pūrvamapoṣitaḥsparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥdevaṃ dhyātvā japenmantramayutānāṃ catuṣṭayamtataḥ siddho bhavenmantraḥ * * * * * * * *anulomavilomena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatekramotkramāt śatāvṛttyā māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥsiddhāḥ syurnaiva sandeho yasmātsarvaṃ tadudbhavamkramotkramāt sahasraṃ tu māsāt siddho bhavenmanuḥpuraścaraṇakṛtyena vinaivāsau prasīdatitattadvarṇoktasaṃkhyābhirguṭikāḥ mantrasiddhidāḥtatpūjā ca tathā siddhidāyakāstu na saṃśayaḥkakkolajātimāṃsīmurācoragranthirocanāpatrāḥsoḍumbarakāśmarikāsthirābjadarapuṣpikāmayūraśikhāḥrohiṇaṭuṇṭukabṛhatī pāṭalacitrātulasyapāmārgāḥdūrvā śrīdevīsahe tathaiva lakṣmīsadābhadreguṭikākaṣāyabhasitaprabhedato nikhilasiddhidāyinyaḥkuryādatha tayoraikyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā
