sanskrit: ādyante sakalaṃ nāma tataḥ praṇavamālikhetbhūrje rocanagandhādyaiḥ padmamadhye suśobhanenikṣipenmadhure tattu mṛṇmaye laghubhājanedhārayed deśikaḥ kumbhamagnikuṇḍasamīpataḥmūlamantreṇa mantrajñaḥ sahasraṃ śatameva vāhomaṃ samāpya taṃ kumbhaṃ vinikṣipya jalāśayeetadyo na vijānāti nāsau sādhaka ucyateuttamāya tu śiṣyāya putrāya ca vadedidamdāhanaṃ ca budhaḥ kuryāttataḥ siddho bhavenmanuḥtanmantraṃ yantra ālikhya śilākarpūrakuṅkumaiḥkṣīrājyamadhutoyānāṃ madhye taṃ likhitaṃ kṣipetdrāvito'pi na siddhaścedvodhanaṃ tasya kārayetevaṃ buddho bhavet siddho nocettasya vaśaṃ kuruetaistu likhito mantro bhūrjapatre suśobhaneadharottararūpeṇa padāni parijapya vaividyāmādityadugdhena likhitvākramya cāṅghriṇāpīḍito lajjayāviṣṭaḥ siddhaścennahi poṣayetdhārayellikhitaṃ mantramathavā śoṣaṇaṃ caretbhasmanā dhārayet kaṇṭhe no ceddāhyo'gnibījataḥlikhet pālāśatailena dhārayet kaṇṭhadeśataḥjapahomādikāṅgānāṃ saṃkhyā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatamaśvatthapatranavake mantraṃ yantraṃ ca mālikāmjale nikṣipya dīkṣārthaṃ śīghraṃ gurumathāśrayetmṛtyūnāṃ haraṇaṃ tadvad devatādarśanaṃ tathāparakāyapraveśaśca purapraveśanaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khecarīmelanaṃ caiva tatkathāśravaṇādikamākarṣaṇaṃ surastrīṇāṃ nāgastrīṇāṃ tathaiva caaṇimādīṃśca samprāpya kevalaṃ mokṣamāpnuyātkhyātirvāhanabhūṣādilābhaḥ sucirajīvanamsarvatra sarvalokeṣu camatkārakaraḥ sukhīpāṇḍityaṃ ca kavitvaṃ ca caturvidhamayatnataḥaṣṭāṅgayogābhyasanaṃ bhogecchāparivarjanamityādiguṇasampattirmadhyasiddhestu lakṣaṇamnṛpāṇāmaṅganānāṃ ca vātsalyaṃ lokavaśyatāadhamāḥ siddhayaḥ proktā mantriṇaḥ prathamabhūmikāḥphaliṣyatīti viśvāsastat satsiddhestu lakṣaṇamkāmaṃ vā viṣa bījaṃ vā japatāṃ siddhido manuḥsthānadhyānavihīnānāṃ koṭijāpāt phalaṃ nahikramotkramācchatāvṛttyā tadante kevalaṃ manumniścitaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syādityuktaṃ tantravedibhiḥguroḥ santoṣamātreṇa mantrasiddhirbhaved dhruvamguruṃ vilaṅghya śāstre'smin nādhikāraḥ sureśvarigurorājñāṃ vinā devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyateyasya deve ca mantre ca gurau ca triṣu niścalābhāvanārahitānāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ kṣudracetasāmtadānena vidhānena kartavyaṃ kulasādhānamanyonyaṃ nityatā jñeyā kuladevyāḥ prapūjanevaiśyairdhanaprayoge ca śūdraistu na kadācanadīkṣitāṃ gandhapuṣpādyairbhakṣyaiḥ pāyasasambhavaiḥśūnye gehe samānīya cārghyādikaṃ viśodhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsanaṃ prathamaṃ dadyāt svāgata ca vadet punaḥsnāpayed gandhapuṣpādbhiḥ keśasaṃskāramārabhettataḥ sthānāntare pīṭhamāstīrya pādukāyugambhūṣayitvānulepaṃ ca gandhaṃ mālyaṃ nivedayetcarvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca pañcabhakṣakamdugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaramnārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanamnānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanamṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathāādāvante ca madhye ca japapūjāviśeṣataḥpūrvārjite phalaṃ nāsti kā kathā parajanmanimamāpi krodhasantāpaśamanaṃ vighnanāśanamṣoḍaśaḥ śvāsaḥkuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtamnikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vaneekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavet kalpapādapaḥśavamānīya taddvāri tenaiva parikhanya casa bhavet sarvasiddhiśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇāaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapitāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetśaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥjapedeko'pi vijane kevalaṃ timirālayekṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ samārabhya yāvat kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavetkṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīṃ prāpya navamyantaṃ mahotsavedaśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryānmatsyamāṃsādibhiryutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśīkevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhāḥ bhavanti hitato nagnāṃ striyaṃ nagno gacchet kledayuto'pi cayonikuṇḍe sthiraḥ sarpirmāṃsamatsyāyutaṃ tathātarpaṇasya daśāṃśena cābhiṣicya jaganmayīmādyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca carvaṇaṃ ca nivedayetprajaptavyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhayemukte śukre ca deveśi punarmantraṃ japet sudhīḥsarvathā naiva kartavyamanyathā sidhirodhakṛtstrīgaṇeṣu sadā bhāvyamabhāve svastriyāmapitaddhastāpacitaṃ bhojyaṃ devatābhyo nivedayetdivyairapi ca kartavyaṃ paśubhirnaca pāmaraiḥdīkṣitāṃ vastrabhūṣādyairbhojyaiḥ pāyasasaṃbhavaiḥdugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ saśarkaramnārikelaṃ kapitthaṃ ca nāgaraṅgaṃ sudarśanamnānāvanyaphalaṃ caiva nānāgandhavilepanamṭaṅkaṇaṃ lodhrakaṃ caiva jalajaṃ vanajaṃ tathāśūnye gehe samānīya cārghyodakaviśodhitambrāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā ca kulabhūṣaṇāviśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥarghyaṃ pādyaṃ ca pānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ jalaṃ tataḥdhūpayitvā tataḥ keśān kauśeyaṃ ca nivedayetdattvā tatra samānīya nānālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥtāṃ tāṃ śakti samāvāhya mūrdhniṃ tāsāṃ samānayetcarvyaṃ coṣyaṃ lehyapeyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāsāṃ savyeṣu karṇeṣu tatastotraṃ samācaretkṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha mekṛpayā hara me vighnaṃ mantrasiddhiṃ prayaccha meeke bahuvidhe devi viśvarūpe namo'stu tevidagdhāṃ vā samālokya tasya vighnaṃ na jāyatedīkṣākāle nityapūjāsamaye nārcayedyadiyadi vrīḍāparā sā tu bhojane tadgṛhādvahiḥācamya mukhavāsādi tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayetvisṛjya pradakṣiṇīkṛtya varaṃ prārthya sukhī bhavetagrajāṃ mātulānīṃ vā mātaraṃ tatsapatnikāmsarvābhāve hyekatarā pūjanīyā prayatnataḥsarva eva surāḥ pūjyāḥ satyaṃ brahmaśivādayaḥsarvā eva parādevyaḥ pūjitāḥ kulabhairavaprāpnoti paramāṃ siddhiṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇānirbhayeṇeva śucinā bhūtvā sarvārthasiddhidambhairaveṇa purā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidamtadbāhye ca punarvastraṃ mūlenāṅgavilepanamiṣṭadevaṃ guruṃ natvā yātrā praharamadhyataḥakṣubdho bhuktabhojyastu bhuktvā sādhanamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaumavāre tamisrāyāṃ sādhayet siddhimuttamāmniśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥbhadre puṣkarasaṃyoge tasyāṃ vīravarottamaḥtretāyāṃ pūjayed devīṃ ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥpūjanīyā kalau devī kevalairāsavaiśca taiḥgauḍī tu yā kṣatriyeṇa mādhvī vaiśyena tatra vaisarvā śūdrasya saṃproktā yatra vā taddhavirbhavetbauddhe pāśupate sāṃkhye māntre kālāmukhe tathāvinālipiśatābhyāṃ ca pūjanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetniṣphalaṃ tadbhaved devi bhasmamanyeva yathā hutamalipānaṃ tathā devi somavadbhogamokṣadamnārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmre dadyāttathā madhuevaṃ pradānamātreṇa hīnāyurbrāhmaṇo bhavetbrāhmaṇastāmrapātre tu madhu madyaṃ prakalpayetsvagātrarudhiraṃ dattvā svātmahatyāmavāpnuyātvarṇāśramocitaṃ dharmamavicāryāparyanti yenirṇītavedaśāstrārtho varadāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibettat kathaṃ tat prakurvanti saptakoṭimunīśvarāḥvīro'pyatra vṛthāpānād devatāśāpamāpnuyātpaśupānavidhau pītvā vīro'pi narakaṃ vrajetyo'smin śāstre pravarteta taṃ tvaṃ pīḍayase dhruvamsa mahāpātakī devi sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥna siddhayaḥ kulabhraṃśastat sarva narakāya casa siddhimiha nāpnoti paratra ca parāṃ gatimna tasya sadgatiḥ kvāpi tapastīrthavratādiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetmādhvī muktikarī jñeyā surākhyā trividhā priyetālajā stambhane śastā khārjūrī ripunāśinīmādhūkākhyā jñānakarī dāridryaripuhāriṇīkṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ madyaṃ valkalasambhavamdravyaṃ taduttamaṃ devi devatāprītikārakamtadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa śatakratuphalaṃ labhetmāṃsasaṃdarśanādau tu surādarśanavat phalamkathayasya mahādeva sarvasiddhipradaṃ mahatsarvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt sarvadevanamaskṛtambrahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dikpālānāṃ ca bhāminisvataḥ siddhipradaṃ devi sarveṣāmālayaṃ mahatmahābalo mahābuddhirmahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥteṣāṃ kṛte mahādevi kathitaṃ nīlasādhanamkṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa yathāvidhi ca sādhayettadardhābhyantare samyak pūjopakaraṇaṃ balim)nānāphalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ svasvakalpoktasādhanamsamānaguṇasampannaiḥ sādhako vītabhīḥ svayambhītaścet sādhakastatra caturdikṣu ca sādhakāḥprakṣālitāṃ citābhūmiṃ gatvā sādhakasattamaḥastrāntamūlamantreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ yāgabhūmiṣuyoginīrmātṛkāścaiva vāmapādapuraḥsarampiśācā yakṣasiddhāśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥsiddhidāstā bhavantvadya tathā ca mama rakṣakāḥśmaśānādhipatiṃ paścādbhairavaṃ kālabhairavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmaiva devatā bījaśaktī a-ū krameṇa tusvaradvandvasya madhye tu kṣiptvā tyaktvā catuṣṭayamyasya vijñānamātreṇa parabrahmaiva deśikaḥmohabaddho na jānāti mokṣastasya na vidyateucchvāsaniḥśvāsatayā tadā bandhakṣayo bhavettasmāt prāṇastu haṃsākhya ātmākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥṣaṣṭināḍyā ahorātraṃ japasaṃkhyājapāmanoḥjapate pratyahaṃ prāṇī spandānandamayīṃ parāmvinā japena deveśi japo bhavati mantriṇaḥśrīguroḥ kṛpayā devi labhate nānyathā priyegaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇubhyo harāya parameśvariṣaṭśatāni sahasrāṇi ṣaḍeva ca tathā punaḥpunaḥ sahasraṃ gurave krameṇa tu nivedayetsahajaṃ parameśāni nyāsaṃ kuru vicakṣaṇedevatā paramādistu haṃso haṃ bījamucyatenāda sthānaṃ tathā śveto varṇastu parameśvarimokṣārthe viniyogaḥ syādevaṃ jānīhi pārvatisūryaṃ somaṃ tathā devi nirañjanamataḥ paramkavacāntān pravinyasya tato'nantapadaṃ smaretsvāhāntenaiva nayanamavyaktapadapūrvakaḥasya haṃsasya deveśi nigamāgamapakṣakaubindutrayaṃ śikhā netre mukhe nādaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥayaṃ paramahaṃsastu sarvavyāpī prakāśavānsaṃhārarūpī haṃso'yaṃ vivekaṃ darśayatyapiyāsāṃ vijñānamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādyādibhiśca mantrajño baliṃ paścānnivedayetimamante sāmiṣānnaṃ bali gṛhna tataḥ paramkuru siddhiṃ me tato'nte prayaccha svāhayānvitammāyānte bhairavaṃ paścādbhayānaka tataḥ paramhūmante ca mahākālāt paścāt pūrvavaduddharetśabdā (vā)nte kālaśabdānte bhairaveti padaṃ tataḥcitāmadhye tato dadyād balitrayamanuttamamgṛhāṇemaṃ baliṃ mātardehi siddhimanuttamāmśabdā(vā)nte bhūtanāthānte śmaśānādhipa ityapihūṃ sarvagaṇanāthānte dhipa caiva tathā punaḥtārādyena baliṃ dattvā pañcagavyena sundaribhūrje vā vaṭapatre vā tatra pīṭhamanuṃ nyasetvīrārcanena deveśi loṣṭān dikṣu parikṣipetkālike ghoradaṃṣṭre ca pracaṇḍe caṇḍanāyikeparabījaṃ (vīraṃ) mahāvighnaṃ chedayeti yugaṃ tataḥanena mantritāṃlloṣṭān daśadikṣu vinikṣipetyadi pramādāddeveśi sādhako bhayavihvalaḥarkendusitavāṭyālatūlanirmitavartikamhate tasmin mahādīpe vighnaiśca paribhūyatetattatkalpavidhānena bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ caretkramādvyutkramayogena tārāṣāḍhā prakīrtitāṣoḍhā vā tārakaṃ vāpi vinyasya prajapettataḥbaliṃ dadyāt tadā devi no cedante bhavedbaliḥnimīlya cakṣuṣī paścāddevīṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japettataḥ paraṃ tu mantrajño gajāntakasahasrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadyasahyaṃ bhayaṃ karṇe netre vastreṇa bandhayetjayadūrgākhyamanunā cārghyaṃ tenaiva sarṣapānpitṝṇāṃ svargadātā tvaṃ martyānāmabhayakṣamaḥiti kṣiptvā tilān devi caturbhāge śivāditaḥdevaṃ tatrāpi sampūjya prajapenmanumuttamambhayeti (yādi) svapnavajjñeyaṃ pare'hni śeṣāmācaretkarpūraṃ padmarāgaṃ ca kesaraṃ haricandanamjihvāgrarudhiraṃ vīraḥ śmaśāne ca samāhitaḥnīlāṃ nīlapatākāṃ ca lalajjihvāṃ karālikāmviyadastrānvitaṃ devi vāmākṣicandrabhūṣitammūlamantraṃ tu mantrajño japet sārdhaṃ śatatrayambaliṃ bhuktvā varaṃ dehi rudhiraṃ gahane vanekāliketi samākhyātā jīvānāṃ hitakāmyayāviyadagniyutaṃ devi balamindrasamāyutamtataḥ patāke hūṃphaṭ syāt pūrvakūṭamanurmataḥiti nīlapatākeyaṃ yojyā vā nīlasādhanepadmarāgaṃ kesaraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ viśeṣataḥbhramatītastato vīrastaṃ vilokya japenmanumtadā svayaṃ bhairavo'sau svayaṃ viśvambharo bhavettadbhasmatilakaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vīreśvaro bhavetsādhayecca tathā siddhisādhanasthānamāśrayetvīrārcanākṛte bhūmau māyāmoho na vidyateśmaśānādhipatīnāṃ tu pūrvavadbalimāharetsudarśanenātmarakṣāmubhābhyāṃ vā prakalpayetghoraghoratarasyānte tanurūpapadaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kahadvandvaṃ vamadvandvaṃ tato bandhayugaṃ punaḥekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramayo manuḥvarmāstrānto mahāmantraḥ sudarśanasya kīrtitaḥjayadūrgākhyamanunā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipetyaṣṭividdhaṃ śūlaviddhaṃ khaḍgaviddhaṃ payomṛtamtaruṇaṃ sundaraṃ śūraṃ bālaṃ naṣṭaṃ samūjjvalamsvecchāmṛtaṃ dvivarṣaṃ ca baddhastrīgodvijaṃ tathāevaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ tyatkvā pūrvoktānyatamaṃ śavamcāṇḍālaṃ cābhibhūtaṃ tu śīghrasiddhiphalapradampraṇavaṃ kūrmabījaṃ ca mṛtakāya namo'stu phaṭre vīra paramānanda śivānanda kuleśvaravīro'haṃ tvāṃ prapadyāmi uttiṣṭha caṇḍikārcanetāraṃ śaktirmṛtakāya namo'nte mantramuccaretdhūpena dhūpitaṃ kṛtvā gandhādinābhiṣicya(lipya) cagatvā śavasya sānidhyaṃ dhārayet kaṭideśataḥpunaḥ prakṣālitaṃ kṛtvā japasthānaṃ samānayetelālavaṅgakarpūrajātīkhadirasārakaiḥsthāpayitvā tasya pṛṣṭhaṃ candanena vilepayetmadhye padmaṃ caturdvāraṃ dalāṣṭakasamanvitamdvādaśāṃgulamānāni yajñakāṣṭhāni dikṣu caviṣamindrāya saṃlikhya surādhipataye tataḥvighnanivāraṇaṃ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prayaccha ṭhadvayamsvasvanāmādikaṃ dattvā pūrvavadbalimāharetśavādhiṣṭhātṛdevebhyo baliṃ dadyāt sureśvaripūjādravyaṃ sannidhau ca dūre cottarasādhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phaḍityanena mantreṇa tatrāśvārohaṇaṃ viśetdṛḍhaṃ nibaddhya juṭikāṃ kṛtasaṃkalpasādhakaḥvīrārcanena saṃmantrya dikṣu loṣṭāni nikṣipetśavāsye vidhivaddevi devatāpyāyanaṃ caretvaśe me bhava deveśa mamāmukapadaṃ tataḥmūlaṃ samuccaran mantrī śavapādadvayaṃ punaḥbhīmabhīma mahābhāva bhavyalocana bhāvukaiti pādatale tasya trikoṇaṃ cakramullikhetupaviśya punastasya bāhū vistārya pārśvayoḥoṣṭhau tu sampūṭau kṛtvā sthiracittaḥ sthirendriyaḥśmaśāne proktasaṃkhyābhirjapaṃ kuryāt kuleśvariyadyardharātraparyantaṃ japte kiñcinna lakṣyatekṛtvopaviśya tatraiva japaṃ kuryādananyadhīḥyatprārthayasi deveśa naraṃ vā kuñjarādikamityukte saṃskṛtenaiva nirbhayastu punarjapettadā satyavaśaṃ kāryaṃ varaṃ ca prārthayet tataḥtadā punarjaped dhīmān ekāgramānasaṃ smaranyantrāntareṇa boddhavyaṃ naro vā devayonayaḥāgatya vighnaṃ carate māyayā ramyavigrahāprabhātasamayo jātastvatpitā krośate gṛhekadācit kenacit śāsti tadā kiṃ te kariṣyatimṛtapitṛgaṇāstatra paradeśanivāsinaḥstrīputrasevakāścaiva gṛhītvānīyate paraiḥnijakāntāṅgasaṃsparśavastramābharaṇādikamyadi na kṣubhyate tatra tadā kiṃ vā na labhyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrūṃ (huṃ huṃ) gṛhṇeti śabdaṃ vai trivārānte varaṃ labhettadā vīrapatestasya kiṃ bhūtena na sidhyatiasaṃskṛtatarā devi pāpayukte na saṃśayaḥsaiva devīna saṃdehaḥ sa devo bhairavaḥ svayamna varaṃ varayet tatra na kiñcicca vadet tataḥna cet svayaṃ laukikoktyā varaṃ grāhyaṃ nirākulamśabdo vā jāyate samyak mṛ (ṛ) taṃ vāpi na labhyatedevatākṛtayo devi bhairavākṛtabuddhayaḥbhairavo vaṭukādyāśca kulaśāstraparāyaṇāḥputro bhūtvā haredvidyāṃ nārī bhūtvā vimohayetsatye kṛtaṃ varaṃ labdhvā santyajecca japādikamśavaṃ prakṣālya saṃsthāpya mocayet pādabandhanamśavaṃ jale vā garte vā nikṣipya snānamācaretagrime divase rātrau yeṣāṃ devānāṃ yajamāno'hamatha yairyācitaścāśvanarakuṅjaraśūkarānyavakṣodamayaṃ vāpi śālikṣodamayaṃ ca vāpare'hni nityamācarya pañcagavyaṃ pibet tataḥpañcapañcavihīnān vā kramāccaiva daśāvadhiḥyadi na syādviprabhojyaṃ tadā nirdhanatāṃ vrajettrirātraṃ vātha ṣaḍrātraṃ gopayet kulasādhanamgītaṃ śrutvā ca badhiro niścakṣurnṛtyadarśanātpañcadaśadināntā hi dehe devasya saṃsthitiḥdevagobrāhmaṇādīiṃśca pratyahaṃ saṃspṛśecchuciḥtataḥ snāyāt tu tīrthādau prāpte ṣoḍaśavāsareevaṃ śatatrayādūrdhva devatāṃ tarpayejjalaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityanena vidhānena siddhiṃ prāpnoti niścitamasāṅgaṃ sāṅgamevāpi niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca vāśavābhāve śmaśāne vā kāryā vīrasya sādhanādaśāhakramayogena bhraṣṭo bhavati sādhakaḥkulānmantraṃ gṛhītvā tu yāvat siddhiḥ prajāyatebrāhmaṇaṃ gomayaṃ kṛtvā sādhayedvīrasādhanamtāvatkālaṃ vasedghore yāvadābhūtasaṃplavamkṣudrāḥ prayogakartṛṇāṃ praśastāḥ sarvasiddidāḥna kasyacit pravaktavyaṃ mayā prītyā tavoditamnadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ nābhimātre'bhbhasi sthitaḥhomayettaddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena tarpayetaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapitāvajjaptvā nirātaṅkaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetśaratkāle caturthyādinavamyantaṃ viśeṣataḥekākī vijane japyāt kevalaṃ vā śivālayeanyatra gurumārgasya laṅghanaṃ naiva kārayetpraviśya mantrī vidhivattāḥ samabhyarcya yatnataḥkevalaṃ kāmadevo'sau japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatammantrasiddhirbhavetsadyo latādarśanapūjanātākṛṣṭāyāḥ kulāgāre bhāvena mantramuttamamvidhāya tatra saṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tasyai nivedya catāṃ visṛjya namaskṛtya svayaṃ japtvā sukhaṃ punaḥudayāntaṃ divā japtvā sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavetkuje vā śanivāre vā naramuṇḍaṃ samāhṛtamnikṣipya bhūmau hastārdhamānataḥ kānane vane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekākī prajapenmantraṃ sa bhavetkalpapādapaḥśavamānīya tadvāre tenaiva parikhanya tamsa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryā vicāraṇāniśāyāṃ mṛtahaṭṭe ca unmattānandabhairavaḥkapālakhaḍgahastaśca japenmātṛkāya yadigurumānīya saṃsthāpya devavatpūjanaṃ guroḥtatsutaṃ tatsutāṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tathaiva casahasrāre guroḥ pādapadmaṃ dhyātvā prajapya capuraścaraṇarūpeṇa saṃsiddhyai yatatāṃ naraḥkṛte naimittike vipra nityasya pūrṇatā bhavetsamudragodakāhāro japellakṣaṃ samāhitaḥkoṭijanmodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti niścitamparvatāgre yajeddevaṃ śākamūlaphalāśanaḥdharmārthakāmamokṣāśca karasthāśca bhavanti hiśrīpuṣpairjuhuyāt tadvadvaiśākhe māsi dugdhapaḥdevāḥ sarve namasyanti bhaktyā taṃ puruṣarṣabhamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kṛtvā pūjānte bhaktitatparaḥyadyat kāmayate mantrī anāyāsena labhyatetarpayannakhilān kāmāṁllabhenmokṣaṃ ca vindatiyaśase dharmavṛddhyai ca brahmacārivrate sthitaḥtathā raktāśvamāreṇa acalāṃ bhaktimāpnuyātbrāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ śeṣajanmanāmeteṣāṃ māsamātraṃ tu kṛtvā kāmyāni sādhayetsarvatantrānusāreṇa prayogaphalasiddhidammāraṇāntāni śaṃsanti ṣaṭkarmāṇi manīṣiṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśyaṃ janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidheyatvamudīritamsnigdhānāṃ dveṣajananaṃ mitho vidveṣaṇaṃ matamprāṇināṃ prāṇaharaṇaṃ māraṇaṃ samudāhṛtamratirvāṇī ramā lakṣmīrdurgā kālī yathākramamīśacandrendranir-ṛtivāyvagnīnāṃ diśo matāḥṛtavaḥ syurvasantādyā ahorātraṃ dine dinehemantaḥ śāntike prokto vasanto vaśyakarmaṇiprāvṛḍuccāṭane jñeyā śaranmāraṇakarmaṇivajraṃ bhadrakamityāhurāsanāni manīṣiṇaḥmusalāśanikhaḍgākhyāḥ śāntikādiṣu karmasustambhane pṛthivī śastā vidveṣe vyoma kīrtitamtattadbhūtodaye samyak tattanmaṇḍalasaṃyutamśītāṃśusalilakṣoṇīvyaumavāyuhavirbhujāmgrathanaṃ ca vidarbhaśca sampuṭo rodhanaṃ tathāmantrārṇāntaritān kuryānnāmavarṇān yathāvidhimantrārṇadvandvamadhyasthaṃ sādhyanāmākṣara likhetādāvante ca mantraḥ syānnāmno'sau saṃpuṭo mataḥnāmna ādyantamadhyeṣu mantraḥ syādrodhanaṃ matammantrasyānte bhavennāma yogaḥ proccāṭane mataḥsitaraktapītamiśrakṛṣṇadhūmrāḥ prakīrtitāḥyantrāṇāṃ lekhanadravyaṃ candanaṃ rocanā niśāśyenāgniloṇapiṇḍāni dhattūrakarasastathādevatākālamudrādīn samyag jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥsthāpayenmanunā tena prāṇān sarvatra deśikaḥmṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥaṅkuśenāhṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharettasyāṃ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyasetdaleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ paramyādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaretevamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaretekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayettantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena saṃyataḥevamekādaśāvṛtīḥ kuryāt sarveṣu karmasumohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇiākṛṣya sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdiprāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamānvarṇavṛtaṃ dharāḍhyamvaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivānapigrathitaṃ tatsamākhyātaṃ vaśyākṛṣṭikaraṃ paramviparītaṃ punaścānte mantraṃ tatsampuṭaṃ bhavetardhamardhaṃ tadādyante mantraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥabhicāreṣu sarveṣu yojayenmāraṇe'pi vāetat samastamityuktaṃ śatrūccāṭanakārakamvidarbhitaṃ tatsamproktaṃ duṣṭaghnaṃ vaśyalakṣaṇamākrāntaṃ tadvijānīyātsadyaḥ sarvārthasādhanamsakṛtpūrvaṃ vadenmantramante caiva tathā punaḥanyonyaprītiyuktānāṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ paramsādhyanāma sakṛnmadhye garbhasthaṃ sampravakṣatehetinausainyadhīgarbhastambhanaṃ ca gatestathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakṛtsādhyaṃ bhavenmadhye tadvidyātsarvato vṛtamsarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mṛtānāmamṛtapradamevameva tridhā kuryādbhavedyuktividarbhitamekaikaṃ sādhyavarṇam tu kṛtvā mantravidarbhitamvidarbhagrathitaṃ nāma mantralakṣaṇamuttamamevamete prayogāḥ syuḥ siddha mantrasya siddhidāḥhuṃphaṭsvāhāvaṣaṭvauṣaṇnamaḥ pallavasaṃjñakāḥśiraḥ pallavasaṃyukto mantro bhavati siddhidaḥevaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakramaṃ śṛṇusādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma likhitvā cintayet tataḥtyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti athānyatkathyate priyeātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tadā saubhāgyasundaraḥyasya nāmnā yutaḥ samyag sa bhaved dāsa eva hiyoni mudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetgorocanā kuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanampuṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇamaṅganā vā kṣaṇādeva dāsīvāsya bhavetpriyecintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥsundūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇātcitāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hiarkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu lekhanyārkasya saṃlikhetgomūtre sthāpayet tacca bhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇātaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mohayedbhuvanatrayamsurūpāṃ pratimāṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣāḍhyāṃ paricintayetjanmanāmamahāvidyāmaṃkuśāntarvidarbhitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcabāṇeśvarī devī kumārī pañca kīrtitāḥtāreṇa parayā devī sampuṭīkṛtya mantravitpārijāteśvarī vāṇī devatā parikīrtitākīlakaṃ parameśāni mahāsārasvatapradamhaṃsārūḍhāṃ lasanmuktādhavalāṃ śubhravāsasamvidyāṃ vīṇāṃ sudhākumbhamakṣamālāṃ ca bibhratīmtripureśīmantramadhye bāṇāḥ proktā maheśvarikāmeśvarīva bījādi devatā ceyamīśvarīudyaddivākarābhāsāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāmikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvirājitabhujadvayāmpūrvoktapañcakāmaistu pañcakāmeśvarī bhavetdevateyaṃ kāmadā ca bījaśaktī tu kīlakamaṅgāni pūrvavat kāmabāṇanyāsadvayaṃ bhavetpāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikāmkāmeśvarīṃ bhagavatīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamāmkāmaśaktidvayāntastu vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī bhavetādyante kīlakaṃ madhyaṃ mahāvaśyakarī bhavetsphuradratnadukūlāḍhyāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāmdadhatīṃ cintayennityaṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkarīmbhavāni bhavaśāntyai tvāṃ bhāvayāmyamṛteśvarīmśrīkāmayugalaṃ proktvā hṛdante bhagavatyapicaturvarṇaṃ vahnijāyātārādyo manurīritaḥannapūrṇeśvarī devī devatā parikīrtitāṣaḍdīrghamāyayā kuryāt ṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvaricandracūḍāmannadānaniratāṃ ratnabhūṣitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyāśābhimukho bhūtvā śrīvidyānyāsavigrahaḥyojayettāṃ kāmagehe candrasūryakalātmaketrailokyasundarī nāma kṣaṇādāyāti mohitācakraṃ prapūjayetsamyak vidyāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca dhārayetśrīkhaṇḍāgarukastūrīkarpūraiśca sakuṃkumaiḥtenājarāmaratvaṃ tu sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥcakraṃ vilikhya sādhyārṇasādhakārṇavidarbhitamkāmakūṭena deveśi sandarbhya pṛthagakṣaramsvarṇamadhyagataṃ dhāryaṃ śikhāyāṃ yatra kutracitte sarve vaśyamāyānti sannipātādayo jvarāḥcatuṣpathe madhyadeśe dikṣu pūrvāditaḥ kramātsphurattejomayīṃ pṛthvīṃ prajvalantīṃ carācaramtena kandarpasubhago loke bhavati niścayāttathā viṣaṃ ca harati dṛṣṭyāveśaṃ karoti cakarotyākarṣaṇaṃ dūrādyojanānāṃ śatādapiyadā tadaiva loko'yaṃ vaśyo bhavati nānyathāsvanāmadarbhitaṃ kuryād deśaṃ vā puṭabhedanamdhārayedvā tato mantrī puraṃ kṣobhayatīkṣaṇātkastūryalaktasahitā ekīkṛtya tu saṃlikhetgrahajaṃ vyādhijaṃ caiva ripujaṃ siṃhajaṃ tathārocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ tu madhyagāṃ saṃlikhed budhaḥtaccakraṃ dhārayet tasmāt saptāhādvijvaro bhavetsādhyanāma vilikhyaitat pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃkṣipetanena vidhinā nīlīrasena vilikhet tataḥmahiṣāśvapurīṣeṇa gomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyanāma likhenmadhye kākapakṣeṇa sañcayetśatrūnuccāṭayedāśu haṭhoccāṭo'yamīritaḥlākṣārasairlikheccakraṃ caturvarṇān vaśaṃ nayetsaubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti snānapānānna saṃśayaḥsindūralikhitaṃ cakramuttare lokavaśyakṛtmantriṇo devatā vaśyāḥ kiṃ punaryoṣitaḥ priyesādhyasya mantrahāniḥ syānmāraṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥstambhaṃ vidveṣaṇaṃ vyādhimuccāṭaṃ kurute naraḥdagdhvā tadvahnimadhysthaṃ sarvaśatrūn vināśayetvidveṣaṇaṃ bhaveccakre tenaiva parameśvarisarvasādhyaṃ samārabhya madhyāntaṃ mātṛkāṃ likhetsādhakaḥ khecarī devi jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥṣaṇmāsakramayogena sākṣādrudra ivāparaḥkhaḍgaṃ vetālasaubhāgyaṃ yakṣiṇīṃ ceṭakādikamcaturdaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pratyaṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥśrīcakraṃ pūjayet tadvat surapūjyastu sādhakaḥkāmo bhūtvā svargabhūsthapātālatalayoṣitāmtadvat kāmeśvarīśastrairdevyātmā bhuvanatrayeetat kāmakalādhyānaṃ kathitaṃ bījabhedataḥśvetābhāṃ śvetavastrāḍhyāṃ śvetapuṣpaiḥ samarcayetatha kāmakalā nāma sāmarthya śṛṇu pārvatimahākāmaśca pūrvoktāḥ pañcakāmāḥ krameṇa tutatpuṭasthaṃ mīnaketuṃ mahākāmeśamastakammūlādisṛṣṭisaṃhārabisatantusvarūpiṇītrikūṭā tripurā devi sarvasiddhipradā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakrametat samāśrītya satāṃ siddhipradāḥ sadāyatrānena vidhānena sādhakena prapūjyatejvalatkāmāgnisaṃtāpapratāpottaptamānasāḥmantrasaṃmūḍhahṛdayāḥ sphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāḥjapte lakṣaikamātre tu kṣubhyante bhūtale'ṅganāḥsaṃkṣubhyante tataḥ sarvāḥ pātāle nāgakanyakāḥtataḥ svarganivāsinyo vidravanti surāṅganāḥsaṃkṣobhayati deveśi trailokyaṃ sacarāramnāmnā likhati saṃyuktā jvalantīṃ cintayet tataḥbhayalajjāvinirmuktā sā'pyāyāti vimohitāsarvamātmānamaruṇaṃ sādhyamapyaruṇīkṛtamvallabhaḥ sarvalokasya sādhakaḥ parameśvariyasya nāmnaiva saṃyuktaṃ sa bhaved dāsavadvaśīviracya yonimudrāṃ ca tāmākarṣayati kṣaṇātsiddhakanyāṃ nāgakanyāṃ devakanyāṃ ca khecarīmmadanodbhavavikṣobhasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāmrocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ ca samabhāgaṃ ca candanamtato yamīkṣate vakti spṛśate cintayatyalamtathā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gandhaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ maheśvarisadya ākṛṣyate sā tu vimūḍhahṛdayā satīlikhedrocanayaikānte pratimāmavanītaletadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇḍalayojitāmsarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnamālikhya madanākṣarambaddhvā tu kṣobhiṇīmudrāṃ vidyāmaṣṭottaraṃ japettato vicalitā pāṅgāmanaṅgaśarapīḍitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sakticakrojjvaladraśmikalanā kavalīkṛtāmākṛṣṭahṛdayāṃ naṣṭadhairyāmuḍḍīna jīvitāmnavānurāgasaṃdhānaveṣamānahṛdambujāmvimūḍhāmiva vikṣubdhāmiva śrāntāmiva drutāmvihastāmiva saṃkīrṇāmivākulitamānasāmbhramanmantrāniloddhūtapatrākārāṃ nabhastaleathavā mātṛkāṃ sarvāṃ likhitvā cakrabāhyataḥtathaiva hi maheśāni svasaṃjñākramayogataḥevaṃ devi vidhānena rocanāgarukuṃkumaiḥsādhyanāmnā svanāmnā tu cakrasyāntarvidarbhitammadhyaṅgatena bījena mahākāmakalātmanābahirapi likhedeva veṣṭayenmātṛkākṣaraiḥśikhāyāmathavā vastre dhārayedyatra tatra vāsammohayati rājānaṃ vājinaṃ duṣṭakuñjaramśatrūn vajraśataṃ śastraṃ vetālaṃ rākṣasaṃ tathātena mantreṇa sandarbhya purāṇāṃ nāma sundarimahān kolāhalastatra tato lokasya jāyateetanmadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanāmṣaṇmāsadhyānayogena jāyate'timanoharaḥdṛṣṭyā saṃkṣobhayennārīṃ dṛṣṭyaivāpaharedviṣamdṛṣṭyā cāturthikādīṃśca nāśayedviṣamajvarānkaroti mahadākarṣaṃ sudūrādapi yoṣitāmdiganukramayogena tadā sarva jagadvaśerocanāgarukāśmīrairmadhye sandarbhayet puramsvanāmasahitaṃ devi yadi bhūmau nidhāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śikhāyāmathavā vastra yatra tatra sthitaṃ ca vāarkakṣīraṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca dhattūrakarasaṃ tathāekīkṛtya cakrametallikhyate yasya saṃjñayāyakṣarākṣasavetālabhūtapretapiśācakātbhayaṃ na vidyate tasya paramanrābhicārajamna śaktā hiṃsituṃ samyagromaikamapi sarvadāadhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṅkumāṅkitāmpītadravyeṇa saṃlikhya dhāraye(dindradiggatāṃ)mahānīlīrasenāpi nāma saṃyojya pūrvavatekaṃ nīlapaṭaṃ samyak nīlasūtreṇa veṣṭayetmahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ gomūtreṇāṅkitaṃ likhetyuktvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣeṇa saṃlikhetlambamānaṃ tadākāśe paramuccāṭanaṃ bhavetlikhitvā dhārayeccakraṃ cāturvaṇyaṃ vaśaṃ nayetsaubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya snānapānādibhirbhavetsaptāhāt kṣobhayetsatyaṃ jvalamānāṃ vicintya tāmśamīdūrvāsahāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥlikhitvā pītavarṇaṃ tu cakrametadyadārcayetsindūrareṇulikhitaṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥgaurikeṇatadālikhya pūjayet paścimāmukhaḥdakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayettadvad digantarāleṣu pūjitaṃ parameśvarirocanālikhitaṃ devi dugdhamadhye vaśaṅkaramtaila madhyagataṃ cakraṃ vidveṣaṇakaraṃ paramathavā devadeveśi yadekānte catuṣpathe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvaripūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa yaḥpūjayitvā maheśāni tadvadekatarau giraumahābhūtadine vāpi śmaśāne yadi pūjayetpādukākhaḍgavetālasiddhadravyamahodayānyatkiñcit siddhisantānaṃ vidyate bhuvanatrayedhavalāmbarasamvīto dhavalāmbaramadhyagaḥdhavalaireva naivedyairdadhikṣīraudanādibhiḥsampūjya parameśāni dhyāyedvāgīśvarīṃ parāmbrahmagranthi vinirbhidya jihvāgre bīja rūpiṇīmśaṭho'pi yaḥ padaṃ spaṣṭamakṣaraṃ vaktumakṣamaḥso'pi sañjāyate vāgmī vācaspatirivāparaḥsattarkapadavākyārthaśabdālaṅkārasāravitsukumāratarasphārarītyalaṅkārapūrvakaiḥvedavedāṅgavedāntasiddhāntajñānapāragaḥprāṇarasavādādigāruḍānekamantravitvicitracitrakarmādiśilpānekavicakṣaṇaḥsarvabhāṣārutajñānī samastalipikarmakṛtsarvavāṅmayavettā ca sarvajño devi jāyatetatastu śṛṇu deveśi kāmarājasya sādhanamudayādityabimbābhā samujjvalavapuḥ priyesamastabhuvanābhogakavalīkṛtajīvitākrameṇa tu tato'naṅgaparyantaṃ prollasantyapitato bhavati deveśi sarvaśṛṅgāramānināmtaddṛṣṭipathagā nārī surī vāpyathavāsurī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pracaṇḍatarabhūpālakanyakā siddhakanyakāklinnā pracalitāpāṅgā vimūḍhā madavihvalācalajjalendusadṛśī bālārkakiraṇāruṇāsaiva sindūravarṇābhā hṛdaye cintitā satīniyojitāthavā mūrdhni varṣantī raktabindubhiḥathānyaṃ sampravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabhamkāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmodarapuṭīkṛtamkāmena kāmitaṃ kṛtvā kāmasthaṃ kṣobhayed dhruvamśaktibījasvarūpā tu sṛṣṭvā saṃharate yadātato bhavati deveśi vainateya ivāparaḥdāhināmamṛtāsāradhīradhārādharopamaḥduṣṭavyādhigrahānīkaḍākinīrūpikāgaṇaiḥathavā yena vidyeyaṃ paripūrṇā vicintyatekevalaiva maheśāni padmarāgasamaprabhāmanasā saṃsmaratyasyā yadi nāmāpi sādhakaḥyadaiva jñāyate vidyā mahātripurasundarīsarvāsāṃ sarvasaṃsthānāṃ yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥyadā tu parameśāni paripūrṇāṃ prapūjayetcatuḥṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasāmādau sambandhini pade madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥkaraśuddhyādividyānāmekaikaṃ parameśvaritaddhyānairmadano bhūtvā pāśāṅkuśadhanuḥśaraiḥtathaiva śāktairdeveśi tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥtatra śāktā mahāvajraprastārajanitāḥ śarāḥādyantago mahāpāśaḥ poruṣeyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: turīyamaruṇāvargād dvitīyamapi pārvatiatīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ śubhāmcintayettu tato devi yojanaistu sahasraśaḥrājakanyāpyadṛśyā ca bhayalajjāvivarjitācakramadhyagato bhūtvā sādhakaścintayedyadāsādhyamapyaruṇībhūtaṃ cintayet parameśvarisarvasaundaryasubhagaḥ sarvalokavaśaṃkaraḥcakraṃ prapūjayed yasya nāmarūpavidarbhitamcakramadhyagataṃ kuryānnāma yasyāstu yoṣitaḥhaṭhādānayate śīghraṃ yakṣiṇīṃ rājakanyakāmvidyādharīṃ divyarūpāmṛṣikanyāṃ ripustriyamkāmavāṇavibhinnāntaḥkaraṇāṃ lolacakṣuṣamkṣobhayet svargabhūrlokapātālatalayoṣitaḥatha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayetsamamaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayetekaṃ gorocanāyāśca tāni piṣṭvā himāmbhasāyān spṛśet spṛśyate yairvā vaśyāḥ syustasya te'cirātcaturbhāgā jaṭāmāṃsī tāvatī rocanā matāagarurnavabhāgaḥ syāditi bhāgakrameṇa tuvidhāya tilakaṃ bhāle kuryādbhūmipatīna narānsiṃhavyāghrān mahāsarpān bhūtavetālarākṣasānye prayogāstu kathitāḥ siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥyāvadātmamahāvahnau manaḥpūrṇāhutiṃ hunetpāśāṅkuśau tadīyau tu rāgadveṣātmakau smṛtauvaśyapratītijanikāḥ śaktayaśca krameṇa yāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālāddāmābhibhūtāni navacakrāṇyanukramātvihvāsahasta pūṣpaistu pūjayetsarvasiddhayesamutpannakulajñānā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥdevatāgurubhaktāśca niyatāścārcanapriyāḥgurūpadeśasaṃyuktāḥ pūjayeyuḥ kuleśvarīmpaiśunyatādivimukhaḥ sumukhastarpayecchivāmkeśasaṃkhyā smṛtā yāvattāvattiṣṭhānta rauravepīṭhasthānāni cāgatya mahāpadmavanaṃ vrajetciccandramaṇḍale śaktisāmarasyasukhodayaḥmadhupo māṃsasambhoktā tvitare madyapāyinaḥpare śive layeccittaṃ palāśīti nigadyatematsyāśī sa bhaveddevi śeṣāstu prāṇighātakāḥannaṃ nānāvidhaṃ caitadetānagnau juhoti yaḥparāśaktyātmamithunasaṃyogānandanirbharaḥaprabuddhā parāśaktiḥ prabuddhaḥ kaulikasya yāityādipañcamudrāṇāṃ vāsanāṃ kulanāyikepustake likhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ jñātvā karoti yaḥlipyate nātra sandeho narake nivasatyasaughṛtapūrṇairhuned devi vāgīśatvaṃ prajāyatejapāpuṣpairājyayuktaiḥ karavīraistathāvidhaiḥkarpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ devi miśraṃ mṛgamadena hisaubhāgyena vilāsena sāmarthyenāpi suvrateprāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimāmrājanāgendradevānāṃ purandhrīrvaśamānayetlākṣāhomāllabhedrājyaṃ dāridryabhayapīḍitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dūrasthitānāṃ deveśi guruṇā proktamārgataḥrudhirāktena chāgasya māṃsena niśi homataḥpararāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ svavaśaṃ nayetkhecaro jāyate rātrau kṛtvā homaṃ catuṣpatheāyurdhanamahārogyasamṛddhirjāyate nṛṇāmdadhimākṣikahomena saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyātkamalairaruṇairhomaḥ samyak sampattidāyakaḥnīlotpalairmahāduṣṭā vaśamāyānti nānyathāśvetaistu homātkamalairlakṣmīṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyātpūrṇabadarahomena vaśīkuryānmahīsurānnāraṅgaphalahomena vaiśyā vaśtā bhavanti hidrākṣāphalaiḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau lakṣahomānna saṃśayaḥvaśyāḥ syurdaśasaṃkhyākā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥvaśyā viṃśatisaṃkhyākā ityājñā pārameśvarīlakṣamātreṇa mantrajño rājāpara iva priyecatuḥ samudraparyantā medinīṃ vaśamānayetvaśyā bhavanti deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇārājikālavaṇābhyāṃ tu duṣṭalokān vaśaṃ nayetguggulasya ca homena sarvaduḥkhāni nāśayetraktacandanahomena vaśyā hi puruṣāḥ striyaḥkastūrihomato devi rājāno rājamantriṇaḥtilataṇḍulahomena śāntirbhavati mandiretrailokyaṃ vaśamāyāti dhānyasiddhimavāpnuyātsopaskaraiśca vaṭakairupasargān vināśayetjapāpuṣpairjagadvaśyaṃ bāṇapuṣpaiśca mohanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudratāṇḍavasānandāṃ dvibhujāṃ parameśvarīmvāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca sargavān bhṛguruttameśrībījaṃ tārakaṃ caiva namo bhagavatīti casarvarājavaśaṃ cānte kari sarvamukhāntakampuruṣānte vaśaṃ coktvā karyante sarvaduṣṭataḥśailaje vaśamālikhya kariśabdaṃ tato vadetsaptatiśca trayo varṇā mātaṅgīvigrahāḥ priyeṛṣirmataṅgo bhagavān gāyatrī chanda ucyatekāmabījaṃ vāgbhavaṃ ca bījaśaktī ca kīlakamādyabījatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakamkvaṇadvīṇālasannādaślāghāndolitakuṇḍalāmkadambapuṣpadāmāḍhyāṃ vīṇāvādanatatparāmyasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa pavano'yaṃ sthiro bhavetnādena bhūṣitaṃ bījaṃ pārthivaṃ coccarettataḥvārtāliyugmaṃ vārāhi punaretaddvayaṃ likhetandhe cāndhini saptārṇaṃ hṛdantena bhavetpriyemohe mohini hṛccāpi stambhe stambhini hṛttataḥsānāmantaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvavāgiti citta caśīghraṃ vaśyaṃ kurudvandvaṃ vāgbhavaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥcaturdaśottaraśataṃ mantravarṇā bhavanti himātṛkāvannyasedvaktre padāni daśa mantravitpadārṇānyatha vinyasya pārśvayorekamuttamamtataḥ ṣaḍaṅgavinyāsaṃ kuryād dehaviśuddhayevārāhiyugalaṃ devi śiromantra udāhṛtaḥkavacaṃ ca tataḥ saptavarṇairnetraṃ nyaset kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśāṅgadhūpahomena saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhetśrīphalairatulā lakṣmīḥ patrairvā suravanditevaśyā bhavanti deveśi nārikelajalena vāyena martyo'pi bhuvane prakhyāto devatāsamaḥprokteṣu navakuṇḍeṣu tatakarmasu coditeśuklapratipadārambhātpūrṇāntaṃ kamalairhunetmadhuratrayasaṃsiktaiḥ puṣpairapyaruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥteṣveva divaseṣvabjaiḥ sitaistaddhavanād ghṛtaiḥtathaivotpalahomena śriyamāpnoti puṣkalāmketakairhavanātteṣu dineṣu śriyamāpnuyāttaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ kuṃkumakṣodāplutaistaddinahomataḥtaiścandanāktairhavanāttaddineṣu yathāvidhitairevendudravāktaistu homātkandarpasannibhaḥkṛṣṇapratipadārambhād darśāntaṃ juhuyācca taiḥteṣveva divaseṣvagno guḍaiḥ kṣaudrāplutairhunetdrākṣābhirdugdhasiktābhistaddinairhavanānnaraḥkharjūrīphalahomena trimadhvaktena taddinaiḥkadalīphalahomena tathā taddivaseṣu canārikelaphalakṣodaiḥ sitākṣaudrasamanvitaḥtairikṣuvārisaṃsiktairhavanāttaddineṣu vaisarvaiśca taistrimadhvaktairhavanācchriyamāpnuyātmahiṣīkṣīrasaṃsiktairhomādiṣṭamavāpnuyātnārikelaphalakṣodakṣīrāktairapi tairhunednityaśo havanād dugdhakṣaudrasarpiḥ samanvitaiḥgobhūhiraṇyavāsobhiḥ samṛddho jīvati kṣitau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abdādannasamṛddhiḥ syād ghṛtāktairvā madhuplutaiḥsampannaśasyāṃ pṛthivīmavāpnoti suniścitamtairiṣṭabhūmṛṇmilitairhavanāttāṃ mahīṃ labhetśriyaṃ sakalakalyāṇanilayāṃ labhate'bdataḥjuhuyādabdamātreṇa labhate gehamuttamamguḍānvitairvā juhuyātśriyā suciramedhatehavanāallabhate lakṣmīmabdādatimanoharāmtaddinairindirāḍhyaḥ syādvidyāhavanavaibhavātghṛtakṣīrasitākṣaudraguḍāpūpasamanvitamśālibhistaṇḍulairmudgairmāṣairgauretaraistilaiḥkṣaudrasarpistilairdugdhakerondekṣurasāplutaiḥmaghādiṣu tathā homaṃ navabhiḥ syānnavasnapimāṣānnaiśca haridrānnairguḍānnaiḥ pāyasairapitathā mūlādinavake navabhirjuhuyāttathāśālīcaṇakamudgotthairmāṣapiṣṭatilodbhavaiḥārogyamāyuḥ saubhāgyaṃ mānyatāṃ ca labhed dhruvamtathāmṛtākhyayogeṣu juhuyādrogaśāntayeuccayogeṣu juhuyādaruṇairutpalairapiparvatākhye hunedyoge yaddravyaistadddhi parvatamathānyamadbhutaṃ homamākarṇaya vadāmi tepāyasairghṛtasiktaistu sitāmiśraistu vidyayātattatprokteṣu kāleṣu grahārtiḥ syānna tatkuledūrvāmṛtātilairnityaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ sukhī bhavetna tasya kutracitkaścitkadācitkleśasambhavaḥsaurabhāḍhyaiḥ prasūnaiśca pūjayedvāpi taddine
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadi syāttasya rogādipīḍā bhavati niścitamvidyāṃ japetsahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā pūjayecchivāmtasmādukteṣu kāleṣu tathā kurvan sukhī bhavetmāntrikatvaṃ bhavelloke śokahāsāspadaṃ bhavethavanādabdamātreṇa vāgmī syātkuṇṭhavāgapimaṇḍalāttasya patraiśca samidbhirapi mūlataḥmūlaiśca lakṣmīsaṃsiddhyai mā tadanvayagā bhavetindirāṃ labhate ramyāṃ sarvalokacamatkṛtāmāḍhyaḥ syādaprajāḥ putrānavāpnoti guṇānvitānlabheta sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ bhuvaṃ bhoktā ca jāyateśataguḥ sādhakastadvattrimadhvaktairlabhettrayamtagarotthairapi tathā lājaiśca kuṭajairapiambarāṇi vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi ca taddinaiḥkesaraiśca kadambaiśca kundairvicakilairapijuhuyātprathamārambhe pañcamyantaṃ madhuplutaiḥtaireva kṣīramilitairhomātsvarṇamavāpnuyātprasūnaiḥ karṇikārotthaiḥ kṣaudrāktairhavanāddinaiḥkahlārai raktakumudairutpalaiḥ kamaladvayaiḥhavanāllabhate lakṣmīṃ sabhūbhūṣaṇavāhanāmketakīkusumaiḥ kṣaudraplutairhomācca taddinaiḥsitaiḥ prasūnaiḥ kṣīrāktairhomādāpnoti taddinaiḥhunenmaruvakaiḥ kṣaudraplutairvāñchitasiddhayeyadvarṇāni prasūnāni juhuyādvidyayā priyemaricaiḥ sarṣapaistailaplutairhomānniśātu vaipāṭalīkundamandāraśephālikusumodbhavaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: havanādvaśayetsarvavanitāḥ kṣaudrasaṃplutaiḥte rājyalakṣmīṃ labhate ghṛtāktairhavanānniśianairghṛtāplutairnityaṃ havanādannavān bhavetmadhyarātre tu lavaṇaiḥ suśliṣṭaparicūrṇitaiḥtathā dadhyanvitairloṇairhomād dveṣyaṃ vaśaṃ nayetājyaistu kevalairhomād dinairuktairdhanī bhavetsnāto'nuliptaḥ sragvī ca sitagandhasragambaraḥsavatsāyāḥ sitāyā goḥ payasi dviguṇe pacetsitadugdhaghṛtopetaṃ kṛtvā vaisikthakaṃ mahatśriyaṃ me devi dehīti proktvā kāṣṭhojjvale'nalemaunī tu gamayedabdāt śriyaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalāmna kadāpi ramā muñcatyadbhutā mantraśaktayaḥnivedayecca pūjāyāmabdādāḍhyatamo bhavettaddinānnaṃ tu kahlāraprasūne nikṣipettataḥkāle tāvaddinairlakṣmīṃ bhūṣā(myā)ḍhyāṃ labhate dhruvamnidhāyādāya maunena hunedagnau bhṛgordinenṛpamānyāṃ sarvahṛdyāṃ nānābhogānvitāṃ śubhāmnidhāya vikace padme karṇikāyāṃ tatastu tatkarṇikārasya puṣpāṇi tathā campakajānyapinirātaṅkāmahāryyāṃ ca rājacaurāpahārakaiḥkevalaṃ navanītena sitopetena homataḥbandhūkaiḥ kiṃśukaiścūtaistrimadhvaktairhutakriyādadhyannahomādannāḍhyaḥ sādhakaḥ syāt trimāsataḥvilikhya navanītena sametaṃ juhuyānniśitathā palāśaparṇeṣu vilikhya daradairhunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candanaiḥ pānase patre vilikhya juhuyāttathāhutairavāpnoti nijavāñchitaṃ proktakālataḥtairhutaistadavāpnoti taddinaistadvidhānataḥsitairālikhya ca sveṣṭaṃ patre padmasamudbhavenāsādhyamasti bhuvane vidyāhomairudīritaiḥidānīṃ sthūlahomaṃ tu kathayāmyarimardanamvidhānairdveṣanidhanaroganigrahacāṭanamtadātmakagrahāṇāṃ ca sthitimaṣṭakavargakamanyathā krūrakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ nāśayanti hikuryāt taddevatābhaktimāstikyaṃ vartanaṃ gurumvidadhyādanyathā śakti naiṣphalyaṃ vātmanāśanamsthāne kuryādaniṣṭāni tadvināśāya sādhakaḥkulīrasiṃhamatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā sthitānakrakumbhāvuttarato mīna īśe tu susthitamkāle tu pañca pañcasyurghaṭikāḥ kramayogataḥmeṣādirāśigo yāti tathānyairgrahamaṇḍalaiḥmūrddhāṃdicaraṇāntaṃ tu tān dvādaśasu lakṣayetśubhāśubhāni karmāṇi phalantyevaṃ kṛte dhruvamjñātvā vidadhyātputtalyāḥ prayogaṃ sarvatastathābhrūśaṅkhamūrdhamadhyeṣu tatra bhrūśaṅkhamadhyataḥsavyakaṇṭhe stanataṭe hṛdi nābhau ca guhyakeaṅgau sandhau jānuguhye nābhau ceti sitetareviṣanāḍyāṃ viṣasthāne vedhayetkaṇṭhakena tubadarādisamutthairvā tathāyaḥ sārasūcibhiḥvyādhinā pīḍitaṃ kālādavidheyaṃ bhaved dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puttalīkaraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nigrahasiddhayemaṅgalo gurumandārkiguravoṃ'śakarāśipāḥetāvatyaśca puttalyastvaṃśakakramayogataḥṣoḍaśa dvādaśa tathā mānamaṃgulisaṃkhyayādvitīye navake'nyeṣāmadhyardhāḥ syustrayodaśacandrārkayorekavidhaḥ proktasaṃkhyākramastathācitāmṛdbhasmalavaṇaṃ śuṇṭhīpippalikāyutamgairikaṃ ceti kathitaṃ puttalīdravyamīśvarivairidehajaromādyairupetaiḥ puttalīkriyāśīrṣe trayāt kaṭerūrdhvaṃ trayāt pādadvayaṃ tathāvidhāya tantre sarvatra prayogānācarettataḥnāśayoge ca dinajamṛtyau krakacayogakeraktasthūṇe kaṇṭakākhye sthūṇe pañcārkasaṃjñakenigrahāya nirīkṣyaiva kuryāt siddhimavāpnuyātvidadhyāt puttalīḥ samyak catasraḥ proktayogataḥsādhyanakṣatravṛkṣeṇāpyuktalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥviṣṭamṛttarujāḥ khātvā sthāpayet sikthamambareevaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt karma samīritamvairiyonyasṛjā kṛtvā catvare juhuyāt tathāśmaśāne nirjane deśe vidadhyādabhicārakamtatrābhito nṛpo rakṣāṃ kārayedātmasiddhyesvarāṣṭrasandhau kurvīta na kurvīta svamaṇḍaletadrāṣṭraṃ pīḍayantyeva śanakairvairibhūbhṛtaḥhaimīdalarasāktaistu homācchatrūn vināśayetripurugro'pi rogārtaḥ prayāti yamasādanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatpatrāmbuplutairmāsādarātirbhrāntimāpnuyātvitastimātraisvailāktaihaivanādvairiṇo mṛtiḥhomādarātestīvreṇa jvareṇa syātmṛtirdhruvamarātīnāmathānyonyakalahānnidhanaṃ bhavetvairijanmarkṣavṛkṣāgnau maṇḍalāttanmṛtirjvarātsarṣapāruskaraghṛtasaṃsiktairjuhuyānniśiraktasraggandhapuṣpāktairhomācchatrūn vināśayethavanādvairiṇo dāhajvaraprāptistribhirdinaiḥhavanāttattarūdbhūtasamidhā havanādapidrumakuḍyanipātena nirghātenāpi khaḍgataḥyakṣarākṣasagandharvapiśācairbrahmarākṣasaiḥnimbapatraiśca kārpāsabījaistatkāṣṭhakāṇḍajaiḥnīcayoge hunedvahnau ripuvṛkṣasamedhiteuccāṭitaḥ prayātyeva mantraśaktyābhitāḍitaḥarāterdantino vāhā rogairnaśyanti niścitamprāguktakaṇṭakādyaistu yadaṅgaṃ vidhayecchanaiḥardhapraharake śīrṣe prahare vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥgranthibhirvā kaṇṭakādikṣatavṛddhividāraṇaiḥgardabhīmehasalile saṃsthāpya kvāthayecchanaiḥmadhūcchiṣṭena tāṃ kṛtvā tāpayenniśi tāṃ śanaiḥtāṃ tatkaṇṭakaviddhāṅgīṃ khanet pitṛgṛhe niśiprāguktaireva taddravyairaśeṣaiḥ puttalīṃ tathāsamiddhe'gnau tatsamidbhistailāktairjuhuyānniśipralapan śanakairdaihaṃ tyajan yāti yamālayamnavamyaṅgāradivase mātṛgehe'grapīṭhake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtādyaiḥ śirasi svīye nirdhātavadalakṣitampiṣṭvā sādhyarkṣavṛkṣasya śakalairapi saṃyutamtadvakṣo'ntarnidhāyārināma tālasya patragatsahasravāraṃ sādhyasya vadharkṣe'ṣṭamarāśigegṛhītvā jīvahastena tāṃ japannikṣipecchucautaddine tāpatṛṣṇādivihvalena jvareṇa saḥprayāti nidhanaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayogabalataḥ śivevajrīkṣīreṇa vāliptāṃ baddhāṃ prāgvadadhomukhīmjuhuyāttatsamidbhistu tatkṣirāktairniśāntarāyadyasti tasya rakṣecchā tāṃ taḍāgodare khanettathā yadi na kurvīta ciraṃ rogātmako bhavetcaṇḍikāyatane khātvā tadyoniṃ purato balimsvagehe culyadhaḥ khātvā taduparyagnivardhanāttāṃ tathā kḷptarūpāṃ tu rurujaṅghāsthisaṃyutāmrāśau tadaṣṭame māsātprayātyuccāṭito'nyataḥbiḍālamūṣikācarmanaddhaṃ sādhyākhyayā yutammātṛgehe nadīpūrtyāṃ vidveṣaḥ syāddvayoḥ sadātadvidyājapasiddhāstāḥ khanedarigṛhe punaḥevaṃ nikaṭavartīnāmabhicāra udīritaḥvadāmi te śṛṇu prājñe sudūrasthasya vairiṇaḥyenārirnikaṭasthāttu prāgeva nidhānaṃ vrajettāḥ prāgvadiritakṣīradvayāsiktāḥ sasaṃjñakāḥekamekāṃ hunerdvairidiṅmukhastā aśeṣataḥkathaṃ vā māntrikabalī nihantuṃ śakyatāṃ vrajettairmāntrikaistasya pūrvaṃ vidveṣaṃ kārayettataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāgyādikaṃ mahārakṣākaraṃ māntrikasaṃgatamtanme kathaya deveśa yadyupāyastu vidyateabhicāramarātīnāmāśu nāśakaraṃ paramtairavicchinnarūpaṃ tu homayedyāmadikkramātarātinidhanaṃ kuryādevamuktavidhānataḥpuṣpaṃ samagraṃ juhuyātkamalaṃ cāpi puṣkalamśatasaṃkhyā rājikāḥ syustilāśca śatasaṃkhyayā(cullakārdhaṃ dadhikṣīramannaṃ grāsamitaṃ bhavetmanaḥ priyaiśca khaṇḍaiśca phalaṃ bhavati niścayāt)nārikelasya khaṇḍaṃ hi sthūlaṃ kuryānmanaḥ priyamdrākṣāphalaṃ samagraṃ syānnāraṅgaṃ khārjūraṃ tathāguñjāsamaṃ tu karpūraṃ kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ tathāmanaḥ priyāhutīḥ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryātsulocaneyathecchayā varārohe śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayet(uktāni pañcagavyāni tatsamāni manīṣibhiḥdadhi prasṛtimātraṃ syāllājāḥ syurmuṣṭisammitāḥguḍaḥ palārdhamānaḥ syāccharkarāpi tathā matāekaikaṃ patrapuṣpāṇi tathāpūpāni kalpayetmātuliṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhākṛtamvidhākṛtaṃ bilvaphalaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tridhāphalānyanyānyakhaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṃgulāḥbrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgā māṣā yavā apigodhūmā raktakamalā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥśuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ maricānyapi triṃśatiḥcandanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṃkumāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvau śāṇau ghaṭakaḥ kolo badaraṃ drakṣaṇaśca saḥpicubiṃḍālapadakaṃ tinduko'kṣaśca taddvayamkandānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ latānāmaṃguladvayamviśīrṇā dvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sthūlāḥ kṛśā dvidhāviśīrṇāyuḥkṣayaṃ kuryād dvidalā vyādhisambhavamsthūlābhiharate lakṣmīṃ kṛśāyāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥdveṣaṃ prakurute dīrghā prāṇaghnyo nistvacaḥ smṛtāḥārdratvacā samacchedā tarjanyaṃgulivartulāśrote smārte ca tantrokte samidhaḥ parikīrtitāḥavakrāścāpyaśuṣkāśca satvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥprādeśamātrā vālābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā apibāhyamadhyagataṃ vāpi madhyaṃ vā cakramarcayettadagre saṃsthito mantrī tato'nantaphalaṃ labhetjapārambhaṃ sudhīḥ kuryānmahāpātakahā bhavetnigadaḥ parameśāni spaṣṭaṃvācā nigadyatemānasastu varārohe cintanāntararūpavānupāṃśūcāritaikena tulaṃ bhavati śailajemānasoccāraṇāttulyamekena parameśvarilakṣamātraṃ japedyastu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyatemahāpātakamukhyāni nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥmahāpātakakoṭīstu nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥkubera iva deveśi pañcalakṣānna saṃśayaḥsaptalakṣajapānmantrī khecarīmelako bhavetaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhināṃ nāyako bhavati priyenavalakṣapramāṇaṃ hi japettripurasundarīm

sanskrit: indranīlamahātejaḥprakāśāṃ viśvamātaramanarghyaratnaghaṭitamukuṭaśrīvirājitāmhalena muśalenāpi varadenābhayena canitambinīmutpalābhāṃ kaṭhoraghanasatkucāmkāmeśvarī mahābhedā bahavaḥ santi pārvatitripureśīṃ samuccārya tārānte hṛtpadaṃ tataḥsarvasattvavaśaṃ proktvā kari sarvajagatpadamviparītāṃ samālikhya vidyā ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā (?)kāmeśvarīvadṛṣyādi dhyānayantrārcanādikamvāgbhavaṃ bhagaśabdānte bhuge vāgbhavameva cabhagaklinne vāgbhavaṃ ca vāgbhavādau bhagāvahebhaganyante pātanīti vāgbhavaṃ bhagasarva cavāgbhavaṃ bhagarūpe tadbhaganitye ca vāgbhavamrūpe sarvabhagānīti me hyānaya ca vāgbhavambhagaṃ drāvaya cālikhya bhagāmoghe bhageti cavāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagajaṃ likhetvāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagamoṃ likhetvāgbhavaṃ ca bhagablūṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ bhagaheṃ likhetbhagaklinne ca sarvāṇi bhagānyatha ca me likhetbhagāntare bhagānte'tha harablemātmakamālikhetṅe'ntāmuccārya vidyeyaṃ trailokyavaśakāriṇīvarṇānāṃ bhagamāleyaṃ nityā sā phalasiddhidādevateyaṃ tu bījaṃ tu harablemātmakaṃ priyeṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥkadambavanamadhyasthāmudyatsūryasamadyutim

sanskrit: sarvairvandyaḥ sadā svasthaḥ sarvasaubhāgyavān bhavetbhavabandhaṃ nāśayantī saṃsmṛtā pāpahāriṇīduḥkhadaurbhāgyadāridryabhayaghnī pūjitā bhavetpṛthagbījatrayasyāhaṃ sādhanaṃ kathayāmi temuktāphalasphuradbhūṣābhūṣaṇaḥ śubhramālyadhṛkpūjayet śubhakusumairnaivedyamapi cojjvalamghṛtagolakasampannanānāśubhrānnapūritammanaḥ saṃkalpaśuddho vā sādhayenmokṣavāṅmayamkarpūradhavalāṃ śubhrapuṣpābharaṇabhūṣitāmmuktāphalāmalamaṇijapamālālasatkarāmevaṃ dhyāyenmaheśāni sarvavidyādharo bhavettasmājjyotirmayīṃ dhyāyejjihvāgre'mṛtarūpiṇīmatha kāmakalāsaktaḥ sādhakaḥ parameśvariraktavastrāvṛtaḥ samyaṅmadhye kāmakalātmakammūlādibrahmarandhrāntāṃ sphuraddīpasvarūpiṇīmikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣuvarābhayalasatkarāmcintayet parameśāni trailokyaṃ mohayet kṣaṇātkandarpa iva deveśi yoṣitāṃ mānahārakaḥcalajjalendusaṅkāśāṃ taruṇāruṇavigrahāmkiṃ punarmānuṣīṃ devi trailokyamapi mohayetākarṣayettadā śīghraṃ rambhāṃ vāpi tilottamāmtasyā mūrdhni smared bījaṃ sravatpīyūṣavarṣiṇīmkṣaṇamātreṇa deveśi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetmohayanti jagatsarvaṃ prayogaṃ śṛṇu pārvatividarbhyādyena kāmena manmathāntargataṃ kuru
