sanskrit: makaradhvajasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvametadvarānanetrailokyamohano nāma prayogo'yam prakīrtitaḥsṛṣṭisaṃhāraparyantaṃ śarīraṃ cintayet paramhemaprabhābhāsamānāṃ vidyunnikarasuprabhāmjñānamudrāṃ ca dadhatīṃ sākṣādamṛtarūpiṇīmtasya saṃsmaraṇād devi nīlakaṇṭhatvamāgataḥvainateyasamo mantrī viṣabhārasahasranutcāturthikajvarān sarvānapasmārāṃśca nāśayetcintitā sādhakasyāśu trailokyavaśakāriṇīpadmarāgamaṇisvacchā cintitā suravanditetannāma saṃsmaran mantrī yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥputravān devadeveśi mantrī dhyānānna saṃśayaḥcatuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasāmādau sambodhanapadaṃ madhye bījāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥpāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇairmādanairmohayet priyetathaiva śaktibandhaiśca śastraistanmayavigrahaḥetāmārādhya deveśi kāmyasaubhāgyasundaraḥtrailokyamohano bhūtvā sthitikartābhavat sadācandrasūryau varārohe sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakauyasya vijñānamātreṇa kartā hartā sadāśivaḥpūjyate tatra sakalaṃ vaśīkuryānna saṃśayaḥyoṣitaḥ sakalāḥ vaśyā jvalatkāmāgnipīḍitāḥtaddarśanena deveśi jāyante sarvayoṣitaḥatīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ tanmadhye pratimāṃ varāmadṛṣṭapūrvā deveśi śrutamātrāpi durlabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyāti sādhakaṃ samyaṅmantramūḍhā satī priyeudyatsūryasahasrābhamātmānamaruṇaṃ tathāanena kramayogena svayaṃ kandarparūpavānsarvaraktopacāraiśca mudrāsahita (sannaddha) vigrahaḥsa bhaved dāsavad devi dhanāḍhyo vāpi bhūpatiḥadṛṣṭāyā maheśāni yonimudrādharo budhaḥnāgakanyāmapsarasaṃ khecarīṃ vā surāṅganāmmadanodbhavasantāpasphurajjaghanamaṇḍalāmmahākāmakalādhyānayogāttu suravanditeatha bhāgadvayaṃ devi candanaṃ mardayet samamaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā mantrayitvā vaśaṃ nayetmantriṇā parameśāni tatsarva tasya vaśyagamdugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ cūrṇamātraṃ vastraṃ karpūrameva caphalaṃ vā vastu yadyat tu sakalaṃ parameśvarisa vaśyo jāyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāhaṭhākarṣaṇametat te kathitaṃ nānyathā bhavetcāruśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmtadbhālakaṇṭhahṛnnābhi tattanmaṇḍala(janmabhūmiṣu)yojitamsarvasandhiṣu dehasya madanākṣaramālikhettadāśābhimukhī bhūtvā svayaṃ devīsvarūpakaḥniyojya madanāgāre candrasūryakalātmakeananyamanasaṃ premabhramamāṇāṃ madālasāmbhūjapatre svarṇapatre raupyapatre'tha tāmrajetathaiva mātṛkāyuktāṃ svamājñā cakramaṇḍitāmaenaiva vidhānena rocanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidarbhitaṃ svanāmnā tu yasmin kasminnapi sthitamvaśīkuryānmaheśāni pādākrāntaṃ na saṃśayaḥekamevamavaṣṭabhya sādhyanāmākṣarāṇi hihemamadhyagataṃ kuryācchikhāyāṃ vāmake bhujerājendramapi deveśi dāsabhūtaṃ karoti hivyāghrāḥ kesariṇī matā vaśyāstasya bhavanti himadhye catuṣpathe vāpi caturdikṣu nidhāpayettathaiva sarvaduṣṭānāṃ purasthānāṃ ca jāyatejvalantīṃ sarvarājendramaṇḍitāṃ sāgarāmbarāmkaṭākṣakṣepamātreṇa nāyastasya vaśāḥ priyedṛṣṭyākarṣayate devi trailokyaṃ sacarācarambhūtapretapiśācāṃśca jvarāṃścāturthikādikānetat sindūrasubhagaṃ rātrau sampūjitaṃ priyeyadā dikṣu vidikṣvevaṃ samyag devi prapūjyatevaśamānayate śīghraṃ saputrapaśubāndhavāntanmadhye nagaraṃ deśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ khaṇḍameva cabhūmimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetyatra kutra sthitaṃ bhadre kṣobhayennagaraṃ mahatrocanākuṃkumaiścaiva lākṣālaktakasaṃyutamcakrametatsamālikhya yasya namnā maheśvaricauragrahajalāriṣṭaṃ śākinīḍākinībhavamnityaṃ samarcayed devi kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayetadhastānnāmasaṃyuktāṃ rocanākuṃkumānvitampītadravyaiḥ samālikhya pītapuṣpaiḥ samarcayetsahasravadano devi mūko bhavati tatkṣaṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāyate devadeveśi mahānīlīrasena tuvahnau dagdhvā maheśāni mārayedvairiṇaṃ priyegomūtreṇa ca saṃlikhya nāma sandarbhya pūrvavatkṛtvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣasya madhyagam)mahānīlīrocanābhyāṃ dugdhalākṣārasādibhiḥanenaiva vidhānena sthāpayettīramadhyagamsaubhāgyaṃ jāyate tena pānīyena na saṃśayaḥsaptāhātkṣobhayet satyaṃ jvalamānaṃ vicintayetśivāṃ sampūjayed devi sugandhaiḥ kusumaiḥ priyeśamīdūrvāṃkurāśvatthapallavairathavārkajaiḥpūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā pītadravyaiḥ samarcayetuttarābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhetpaścimābhimukho bhūtvā candanena samālikhetvallabho jāyate tāsāṃ dāsīmiva vaśaṃ nayetyasya nāmāṅkitaṃ tatra mantrahāniḥ prajāyatepūrvavat parameśāni krameṇa paritoṣitamrocanālikhitaṃ cakraṃ kṣīramadhye ksipedbudhaḥgomūtramadhyagaṃ samyak śatrūccāṭakaraṃ paramjvalajjavalanamadhyasthaṃ śatrunāśakaraṃ bhavetsarvabāhyata ārabhya yāvanmadhyaṃ maheśvaripūjayedrātrisamaye kulācārakrameṇa tugirāvekatarastadvadarcayet kulamārgataḥśmaśāne pūjayeccakraṃ mahābhūtadine tu yaḥkhaḍgasiddhiṃ ca vetālasiddhiṃ ca guṭikāṃ labhetsamahāvīrasiddhiṃ tu yakṣiṇīceṭakodbhavām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptadaśaḥ svāsaḥpādukāsanaviṇmūtramaithunāni vivarjayetsiddhaṃ siddhādhivāsāṃśca śrīpūrvaṃ samudīrayet)virūpāṃ muktakeśīṃ ca kāmārtāṃ ca na nindayetnālokayet paradravyaṃ paradārāṃśca varjayet )naiva prasārayet pādau naitānapi ca laṅghayetasūyāmātmasammānaṃ paranindāṃ ca varjayetpurāṇāgamaśāstrāṇi kalpāṃścāpi na dūṣayetśūrpaṃ sammārjanīṃ daṇḍaṃ dhvajaṃ vaiḍūryamāyudhambhogayogyāni cānyāni yāgadravyāṇi yāni cadivyoktāni padārthāni bhūtāviṣṭāni yāni vaiyā goṣṭhīrlokavidviṣṭā yā ca svairavisarpiṇīpratigrahaṃ na gṛhṇīyādātmabhogavidhitsayādhārayedārjavaṃ satyaṃ sauśīlyaṃ samatāṃ ghṛtimstambhadīpamanuṣyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathāetatsparśa tyajed dūre kharaśvājarajastathāsaṃspṛśedyadi mūḍhātmā śriyaṃ hanti harerapina guruṃ sādhakaṃ caiva liṅgacchāyāṃ na laṅghayetsambhave navavastraśca malayūkāvivarjitaḥvṛthā cchinatti yaḥ keśāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakamkacānāṃ vapanaṃ kuryād vṛthā na vikaco bhavetprayoktavyaḥ svamantraśca āpadyapi na cācaretkṛpayā parayā kuryādanātheṣu asaṃsadibhāvayeddaivataṃ viṣṇuṃ guruṃ vipraśarīragamjñeyo viśvāśrayo viṣṇurātmā jñeyaśca viṣṇuvat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra tatra na vastavyaṃ prayāyātsaṃsmaran harimnāpi taiḥ saha vaktavyaṃ vastavvaṃ vā kadācanana nindyā brāhmaṇā devā viṣṇurdhenustathaiva cagururvā vaiṣṇavaścāpi puruṣaḥ pūrvadīkṣitaḥna tena mantro vaktavyo mudrā vā samayā apimantraguptiśca kartavyā satataṃ mantrasiddhayepañcejyā tīrthasevā ca svādhyāyo gurusevanambrahmacārī dīkṣitaścet trisandhyaṃ devamarcayetbhaikṣyaṃ samprārthayet sākṣād dhyāyed devaṃ nirantaramna japo nārcanaṃ naiva dhyānaṃ nāpi vidhikramaḥsannyāsināṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ mānasaḥ kathitaḥ kramaḥubhau tau narake ghore pacyedābhūtasamplavamdayā dānaṃ mahārhaṃ ca yena devaḥ prasīdativarṇināṃ ca vanasthānāṃ ko vadedanapekṣitamsarvabhūtahite yuktaḥ samayācārapālakaḥmantrāṇāṃ sādhanadvāre śivabhāvanatatparaḥanyamantrārcana śraddhāmanyamantraprapūjanamstrīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca varjayedbhaktimān sadāstrīṣu dveṣo na kartavyo viśeṣāta pūjanaṃ striyāḥpeyaṃ carvya tathā coṣyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ lehyaṃ tathā sukhamkulajāṃ yuvatīṃ vīkṣya namaskuryāt samāhitaḥkutsitāṃ vā mahāduṣṭāṃ namaskṛtyā vibhāvayetkumārīpūjanād devi sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyatekṛtārthastena jāyeta svargo vā mokṣa eva vāvismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śāstramohitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśuddhacittastatsiddhiṃ labhate cāpavargajāmbhairavī yadi sañjātaḥ siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥdevyai niveditaṃ yadyattat sarvaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥnaivedyanindakaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛtyante yoginīgaṇāḥsvaprītyai āhṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajedbalidānaṃ vinā devyā hiṃsā sarvatra varjayetmāmanādṛtya puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ syāt pratyavāyataḥyairevāpyāyanaṃ dravyaiḥ siddhistaireva coditākiṃ na paśyati loko'yaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarānpañcamudrā niṣeveta cānyathā narakaṃ vrajettadaṅgaromasaṃkhyābhirjāyante bhūtayoniṣudūṣakaiḥ samayabhraṣṭairna kuryād dravyasaṃgatimpaśubhikṣudrakarmasthairna kuryād dravyasaṅgatimkulopadeśahīnaiśca na kuryād dravyasaṅgatimpadavākyapramāṇajñāḥ śrutismṛtyarthavedinaḥsvakule'pi prasūtā ye vṛddhācārapravartinaḥstrīputramitrabandhūnāṃ snigdhānāmapi pārvatiadṛṣṭapuruṣāṇāṃ ca deśāntaranivāsināmkulīnaṃ nāvamanyeta pūjayet taṃ vicakṣaṇaḥsvapātrasthitaśeṣaṃ ca na dadyādbhairavāya caāsanaṃ bhojanaṃ pātramupānacchayanāni cakulapūjāntarāyaṃ tu yaḥ karoti hi durmatiḥtasmāt sarva prayatnena kulapūjārato bhavetārādhanāsamarthaścet dadyādarcanasādhanamsamyak śatakratūn kṛtvā yatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dattvā ṣoḍaśadānāni yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥsārdhatrikoṭitīrṣeṣu snātvā yatphalamāpnuyātbahunoktena kiṃ devi yathāśaktyā dadāti yaḥyathaivāntaścarā rājñaḥ priyāḥ syurna bahiścarāḥsamarpayanti te bhaktyā tvāvābhyāṃ piśitāsavamanadhītopyaśāstrajño gurubhakto dṛḍhavrataḥyadi bhāgyavaśād devi kuladṛṣṭiḥ prajāyatebhagadantāṃ bhagākṣīṃ ca bhagakarṇāṃ bhagatvacāmsampūjya tābhyo gandhādyairmānasairgurumeva cabālāṃ vā yauvanonmatāṃ vṛddhā vā sundarīṃ tathātāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāṃ ca kauṭilyamapriyaṃ tathāstriyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇāḥ striyaścaiva vibhūṣaṇamjapasthāne mahāśaṅkhaṃ niveśyordhva japaṃ caretbhakṣaṃstāmbūlamanyāni bhakṣyadravyaṃ yathārucina jape kālaniyamo caryādiṣu baliṣvapibhairavī cchinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī matāetā eva mahāvidyā daśa vidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥnavā prayāsabāhulyaṃ samayāsamayādikamśuddhiṃ na cācaredatra nirvikalpamanāścaretyācayedamṛtaṃ kaulaṃ tadabhāve kulaṃ bhavetnamaskṛtya ca gṛhṇīyādanyathā narakaṃ vrajetgamayed devatāpūjājapayāgastavādināsarvadeśe sarvapīṭhe kartavyo nātra saṃśayaḥśaktirindro raviḥ śaktiḥ śaktiścandro grahā druvaḥpūjanaṃ mānasaṃ divyaṃ mānasaṃ tarpaṇādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na viśeṣo divā rātrau na sandhyāyāṃ divāniśammahāniśi śucau deśe baliṃ mantreṇa dāpayettaddine sarvathā kāryā śāsanānmama suvratesā mahārātriruddiṣṭā tadgataṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavettadā vādī svasiddhāntahataḥ kṣititalaṃ vrajetkavitāṃ labhate so'pi amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchaticāmaraṃ ravibimbaṃ ca tilapuṣpaṃ saroruhammukhaprasādaṃ sumukhaṃ sulocanaṃ suhāsyakamlabhate ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaramśūnyāgāre nadītīre niḥśaṅko viharet sadātaddrūmodbhavapuṣpeṇa pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥbrahmatarormahāpadme devīṃ dhyātvā yathāvidhiḥmahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭitaḥ sādhakottamaḥtithikrameṇa saṃkhyābhirlatābhirveṣṭito yadiaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ dviguṇaṃ yadi dṛśyateyena hīnā na sidhyanti janmakoṭisahasraśaḥtadā caret tu sarvatra vaiṣṇavācāratatparaḥparvate vipine vāpi nirjane śūnyamaṇḍapekṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā manuṃ japtvā natvā gacchedyathāsukhamkṣemaṅkarīṃ tathā vīkṣya jambukīṃ yamadūtikāmkṛśodari mahācaṇḍe muktakeśi balipriyeśmaśānaṃ ca śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇamanuvrajanghoradaṃṣṭre karālāsye phiṭiśabdapraṇādinibhāgyodayasamutpanne namaste varavarṇinihastyaśvarathaśastrāṇi phalakān vīrapūruṣān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśāṃkuśau pustakaṃ ca taulikīnakhalekhanīmvahnijāyā ca vidyeyaṃ rudravarṇā mahotkaṭādvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgānivinyaseddeśikottamaḥsvidyatvaktrāṃ mahāghūrṇalocanāṃ ratnabhūṣitāmdadhatīṃ saṃsmarennityāṃ padmāsanavirājitāmbherākāraṃ samuccāryāṃkuśābhyāṃ taṃ ca veṣṭayetanugrahendubindvāḍhyaṃ tārasvāhodarasthitaḥdevateyaṃ parāśaktistṛtīyaṃ bījamucyateṣaḍdīrghasvarabhedena bījenaiva ṣaḍaṅgakamnīlakaṇṭhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca nānābharaṇabhūṣitāmpāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca cchurikāṃ varādābhayeparāṃ vilikhya vahnyante vāsinyai nama ityapiādyante bījaśaktī ca kīlakaṃ madhya eva cadhyāyettāṃ ca suvarṇābhāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāmdadhatīṃ ratnamukuṭāṃ trailokyatimirāpahāmnityaklinnāṃ samālikhya mukhe tāraṃ samālikhetgāyatraṃ chanda ākhyātaṃ devatā parameśvarīcatuṣkeṇa ca yugmena yugmena yugalena cajapākusumasaṅkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitāmpāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitāmbhuvaneśīṃ samuccārya śivadūtyai namo likhetādyante bījaśaktī ca madhye kīlakamucyatedūrvānibhāṃ trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhasamāsanāmtāraṃ parānte kavacaṃ khecachekṣaḥ samālikhettvaritā ravivarṇeyaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇamya jayadurgāṃ vā sarvavighnairna lipyatebhaktebhyo varade devi mahiṣaghni namo'stu tedṛṣṭvā ca bhairavīṃ devīṃ praṇamedvimṛśan manumnamāmi varade devi muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitesarvavighnaharaṃ devi namaste haravallabheśaktimantraṃ puraskṛtya tasya siddhirna jāyateyoginīpūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanamtathā kulatithau durgā pūjitā varadāyinībhaumaśukrau kulākhyau tu budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥviṣamāścākulāḥ sarvāḥ śeṣāśca tithayaḥ kulāḥkulāni samayugmāni śeṣamānyakulāni cakulākhye jayino nityaṃ sāmyaṃ caiva kulākulemāṃsapradhānaṃ naivedyaṃ sandhyākāle nivedayetpaśurūpadharāyāti parivāragaṇaiḥ sahatadaiva maṅgalaṃ tasya nānyathā kulabhūṣaṇamnityaśrāddhaṃ tathā sandhyāvandanaṃ pitṛtarpaṇampaśurūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ yo nārcayati nirjanejapapūjāvidhānāni yatkiñcit sukṛtāni caekayā bhujyate yatra śivayā deva bhairavapaśuśaktiḥ pakṣiśaktirnavaśaktiryathākramāttena sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mahatśubhāśubhāni karmāṇi vicintya balimāharetśubhāśubhaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ brūhi gṛhṇa baliṃ tavayadi na bhujyate vatsa tadā naiva śubhaṃ bhavetevaṃ jñātvā mahādeva śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kiṃvā pakṣipataṅgādidarśane naiva kārayetniśchidramaṇḍape vāpi kartavyaṃ naca sannidhaukulaṃ kulapatiṃ caiva kulamālāṃ kulākulamprakāśāt kāryahāniḥ syāt prakāśānnidhanādikamprakāśānmṛtyulābhaḥ syānna prakāśyaṃ kadācanadarśayedvaiṣṇavīṃ mudrāṃ viṣṇunyāsaṃ tathā stavamgopanādyadi vyaktiḥ syānna guptirabhidhīyatevaraṃ pūjā na kartavyā vyaktirnaiva kadācanachāgalaṃparasenyasya stambhanāya viśeṣataḥparavādimukhastambhe māhiṣaṃ śasyate palamśaśotthaṃ vaśyakarmādāvāvikaṃ kṛṣṭikārakamuccāṭe coṣṭrajaṃ śastaṃ kharotthaṃ prītināśanamāyuḥ kīrtidhanārogyaputraśrījayakāntidammahāmāṃsāṣṭakamidaṃ devatāprītikārakamsarvamāṃsa surāyuktaṃ dadyād devyai viśeṣataḥtasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa svayaṃ brahmatvamāpnuyāttatsāraṃ tu samālokya tathānyanmantrasaṃgrahamna kasyāpi varārohe proktavāṃstridaśeṣvapina tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapibrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstathānye pitṛdevatāḥvidhivat sukṛtī kṛtvā dūtīyāgaṃ tu pārvatiyeṣāṃ vaṃśe prajāyeta dūtīyāgo maheśvarikāyena manasā vācā sarvathā na prakāśayetkuryāt prayatnataścaiva dūtikāyajanaṃ priyesarvatīrthamayaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevamayo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni camerumandaratulyāni suvarṇānyarpitāni vaitasmāt sarvaprayatnena dūtīyāgaṃ samācaretyadanuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvamācaritaṃ bhavetatha dūtīṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇāni ca sundaripaṭvī suśīlā priyavāg guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratārūpayauvanasampannā niścalā mantratatparānātikubjā ca hrasvā ca cārusarvāṅgasaṃyutāpūrṇagaṇḍakapolā ca raktoṣṭhī ca sudantikāsubāhuvallīsaṃyuktā vṛttapīnapayodharāsaralāṃgulikāyuktā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāpūjanīyā prayatne pañcaviṃśativārṣikāpūjitāścedvarārohe tarpaṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavettā yadā rajasā yuktāstataḥ pūjyā mahāphalāḥtatra dveṣaparo mūrkho dāridryaṃ samavāpnuyāttāmbūlāpūritamukho dhūpāmodasugandhitaḥraktavastraparīdhāno lākṣāraktagṛhaṃ gataḥpañcīkaraṇasaṃketaiḥ pūjayet kulanāyikāmrajakī rañjakī caiva sairandhrī ca suvāsinīviśeṣavaidagdhyayutāḥ sarvā eva kulāṅganāḥsaṃgopanaratāḥ prāyastaruṇyaḥ sarvasiddhidāḥsadāparigṛhītāṃ vā yadvā saṅketamāgatāmviliptāṃ raktagandhena raktāmbaravibhūṣitāmsadānuṣṭhānaniratāṃ sāttvikīṃ bhaktisaṃyutāmcāturyaudāryadākṣiṇyakaraṇādiguṇādhikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sudhūpadhūpitāṃ tanvīṃ dūtīkarmasu yojayedbrāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopālakanyakāevaṃ bhūtāṃ yajettāṃ tu prasūnatūlikopariliṅgayonirato mantrī rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetsvaśaktyā ayutaṃ puṇyaṃ paraśaktiprapūjanerajakyāḥ kṣurikī śreṣṭhā kṣurikyāścarmakāriṇītato'dhikāntyasambhūtā caṇḍālī ca tato'dhikāpukkasyā akṣatā śreṣṭhā tato'tisundarī smṛtātatparā parameśāni tanmanāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāvidagdhā tvaprasūtā ca dhairyasvātantryasaṃyutāātmīyāśca parāścaiva śaktimātrraṃ maheśvarivividhaiḥ phalatāmbūlairvastrālaṅkārahemabhiḥsambhogavāsanāṃ dhṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchaktipūjanamparamānandarūpeṇa deha bhāvavivarjitaḥtadājñā tu prakartavyā tadā śreyaḥ pravartatekṛte tatropahāsādi kuṣṭhī bhavati nānyathāvyaṅgā vā vikṛtāṅgī ca kāṇākṣī badhirā tathāadīkṣitā bhaktihīnā gurusevāvivarjitāvṛddhāturā vakramukhī krodhadurgandhakaśmalādīrghadantā ca lamboṣṭhī śuṣkastananitambinimahāsthūlātirogārtā pralambitapayodharākaniṣṭhā kroḍadantā ca sadā svārthasamanvitāśvetāṃṅginī raudrabimbā cchāgayoniḥ piśācikāetallakṣaṇasampannāḥ śaktīryatnena varjayetajñānāllobhato mohād datte pūjā tu niṣphalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātaṅgīpūjanaṃ tatra kathaṃ muktipradāyakamrajasvalā ca mātaṅgī sā dūtī sarvamaṅgalātava vākyamabhūt brahmannetadvada pitāmahaasmin sarvajña kalpo'sau mātaṅgī munipuṅgavaḥtena prītā mahādevī devānāṃ hitakāriṇītacchrutvā dvijavaryastāṃ yayāce dharmasādhanamapatyatāṃ samāsādya matkulālambanaṃ kuruśyāmalāṃ cāruvadanāṃ vīṇāśukasamanvitāmdhārayantīṃ viśālākṣīṃ śaṅkhatāṭaṅkaśobhinīmmātaṅgīti tadā devī vikhyātā varadāyanītripurājjetukāmena yonipūjā tadā kṛtāyadā dṛṣṭarajā bhūtvā tāṃ vavre śaṅkaraḥ priyāmpraṇavena tadā śambhustayā sārdhaṃ rataṃ bhajansarvasaubhāgyajananaṃ mālāmantramabhūt tadāmātaṅgīmantramatyarthaṃ manmathapratipādakammātaṅgīcāntyavarṇasthā tadāsā antyajābhavatsā devī sarvavarṇānāṃ varaṃ dattvā niruttaramna doṣaḥ sarvavarṇānāmiti dattvā varaṃ tadādevīmuddiśya mokṣārthaṃ kṛtaṃ yad doṣavarjitamantaryāgamidaṃ jñeyaṃ bahiryāgaṃ ca vaidikamcakrasaṅketasamayaṃ sarvaṃ tubhyam prakāśitamtyaja śaṅkāṃ mahābhāga satyametanmayoditamyonipūjāṃ vinā pūjā kṛtāpi hyakṛtā bhavetāyurārogyavibhavānamitāṃllabhate naraḥputrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātaṅgīmanmathopetā sarvakāmārthasiddhayesā devī śaktihīnā tu na dadāti manorathamkaulikānvayasambhūtāṃ dīkṣitāṃ krodhavarjitāmtriṃśatsaṃvatsarādhaḥsthāṃ ṣoḍaśābdādhikāmapiyonimadhyagatāṃ devīṃ kālarātrimanusmaretsakṛjjapena saṃsiddhirdvistrirvā nātra saṃśayaḥathavā gṛhiṇī pūjyā pūtā puṣpavatīṣṭadātāsāṃ bhojyaṃ prakartavyamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥdūtyaśca bhaginī putrī pautrī naptrī tathā snuṣāarcane prathitā veśyā mantrayuktā manoharārajasvalā yadā cāsīt sarvotkṛṣṭā iti smṛtābhayalajjādisarvāṇi parityajyātha dūtikāmācāryānucarī raktā manasā sukhadāyinīcumbanāliṅgane caiva nakhadantakṣatāni cadūtī yasya susaṃjñātā saphalaṃ tasya jīvitamsarvadā sukhamāpnoti sarvaiśvaryaṃ ca labhyatecumbane paramaiśvaryaṃ nakhadantakṣatairyaśaḥna dadyāccumbanaṃ yastu daridro jāyate dhruvamvinā dantakṣataṃ devi loke bhavati ninditaḥdvitīyena ca lakṣmīḥ syāt tṛtīye pārvatī bhavetāliṅganairharedrogān dhanadhānyādi cumbanaiḥsāyujyaṃ saṅgamena syāt satyameva na saṃśayaḥsurūpāṃ ca suveśāṃ ca taruṇīṃ sundarīṃ tathāudāravaṃśasambhūtāṃ pūjāgrahaṇaharṣitāmtatkāle kāryasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: surūpāṃ taruṇīṃ veśyāṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaretsurūpāṃ taruṇīṃ dāsīṃ yonipūjāṃ samācaretmātaṅginyāḥ surūpāyāḥ suguṇāyāstathaiva cayasyā aṅge devatāsti tasyā yoniṃ prapūjayetsurūpāyastaruṇyāśca yoginyā yonipūjanemadaghūrṇitanetrāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjanevidhavāyāḥ surūpāyāstaruṇyā yonipūjaneparaṃ tu nirbhayo bhūtvā sarvametat samācarettasyāstu pūjane sarvakāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvambhagamālinimantreṇa kuryāt prārthanāpūrvakamṣoḍaśairupacāraistu pūjā sarvatra śasyatevaśyākarṣaṇakārmāṇi manasā yadyadīpsitamaspṛśyāyāstaruṇyāstu pūjā dveṣārthamīritātāṃstān prayogān kurvīta kāryasiddhirbhaved dhruvammeghākarṣe bhayāvāptau sarvaśatrunivarhaṇebrahmarandhrasphuradbhinnamuktālekhāvirājitāmviśuddhamuktāvajrāḍhyacandralekhākirīṭinīmsūrya bhāsvanmahāratnakuṇḍalālaṃkṛtāṃ parāmgraiveyāṅgadapratrālīsphuratkāntivirājitāmśrīkhaṇḍavallīsadṛśabāhuballīvirājitāmpravālalatikākārapāṇipallavaśobhitāmraktotpaladalākārapādapallavaśobhitāmvāmena pāṇinaikena pustakaṃ cāpareṇatuakṣamālāṃ ca varadaṃ dakṣapāṇidvayena tukṣīrakundendudhavalāṃ prasannāṃ saṃsmaret priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyātvā tatra parāṃ parāparakalāṃ tanmadhyagāṃ cintayetuttamaṃ rajobījāni madhyamaṃ kevalaṃ rajaḥvidhāya mātṛkānyāsaṃ kulāṅge'pi pravinyasetbalādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaretnamaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadetvahnijāyāṃ samucārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvaritrikoṇeṣu ca sampūjya vasantaṃ madanaṃ priyedurgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīmpādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥmanoharā manorāmā madanonmādinī tathārañjanī caiva deveśi ṣoḍaśī priyadarśanātataḥ somakalāḥ pūjyāḥ śivādyāścaraṇāvadhiśuddhiḥ saumyā marīciśca śailajā aṃśumālinītathā tuṣṭyamṛte caiva kalāḥ somasya ṣoḍaśaathaivaṃ ca vidhānena ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥarcayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivaṃ tadanantaramyajettatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmeśasaṃjñakaiḥvajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīmtadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva cadharmādharmahavirdīpta ātmāgnau manasā srucāsvāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥdharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyahamkulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyād durlabhaṃ naraḥyatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tatkṣaṇādeva siddhyatibījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japan nikṣipya sundari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavetyuvatīṃ vā madonmattāṃ suveṣāṃ cāruhāsinīmsādhakaḥ śreyase tanvīṃ vame saṃsthāpayed budhaḥprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā yathāvidhiathāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradamsnāyācca vimale tīrthe puṣkare hṛdayāśritesā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhisthaiḥ pratīyatetenāmṛtena divyena tarpayet paradevatāmkalāsāreṇa sampūrya tarpayet tena khecarīmkriyate tatparatvena hṛnmantreṇa tataḥ paramkriyate tatparatvena śiromantreṇa deśikaiḥkriyate nijadehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥsarvato varmamantreṇa kriyate dehasaṃvṛtiḥtato'streṇa ca mantrajñaḥ karotyastra caturdiśaḥhṛdayādimayaṃ tejaḥ syādetanmantrasaṃjñitamavidyāyāḥ svatantraṃ yatparaṃ dhāma samīritamjyotistattvamayaṃ dhyāyet kulākulaniyojanātsadā samarasaṃ dhyeyaṃ dhyānaṃ tatkulayogināmnyāsastanmayatābuddhiḥ so'haṃbhāvena cintayetamohakamakarmatvamadveṣākṣobhakau tataḥahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥityaṣṭasaptabhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayet paradevatāmgrathitā kuṇḍalīśaktiḥ kalānte merusaṃsthitiḥparamātmasvarūpaṃ ca tathā jñānātmarūpakamnābhauvibhāvya tanmadhye juhuyāt sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānapradīpite nityamakṣavṛttirjuhomyahaṃ svāhāsuṣumnāvartmanā nityamakṣavṛtīrjuhomyahaṃ svāhādharmādharmakalāsnehapūrṇāmagnau juhomyahaṃ svāhāvasudhādiśivāvasānamna tasya puṇyapāpāni jīvanmukto bhaved dhruvamatastvāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi tasmādyajñe vadho'vadhaḥābudhyasva paśotvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivo'si hicaṇḍikāprītidānena dāturāpadvināśayagaurīrūpaṃ samāsādya mama kalyāṇado bhavapaśave ca namastubhyaṃ namaste balirūpiṇechedabhedodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣamasva paśurūpadhṛtparipūrṇaphalaṃ naiva saphalaṃ pūjanādbhavetkumārī bhojitā yena trailokyaṃ tena bhojitamannaṃ tu mīnanayane kulācalasamaṃ bhavetvivāharahitāḥ syuśceduttarottarasiddhidāḥsuvāsinyo mahāprauḍhāḥ saṃśayaṃ tyaja suvratekṛte yasmin mahālakṣmīracireṇa prasīdatipūjādine samāhūya kumārīmādyadevatāmarcayed hemapātreṇa vāripuṣpākṣataiḥ samamupaveśya kumārīṃ tāṃ svāṅge nyāsaṃ samācaretatha dhyāyet kumārīṃ tāṃ malālakṣmīsvarūpiṇīmsakaṅkaṇāṃgulīyāni karṇālaṅkaraṇe śubhepūjayet puṣpamālābhirdivyairdhūpaiḥ sudhūpayetbhojayedbhaktibhāvena pāyasaṃ śarkarāghṛtamphalekṣu svādu cānyacca dadyāt tasyai punaḥ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavaca strīśaktibīje kīlakaṃ ca prakīrtitamkṣaḥstrīyugmaṃ ca kavacaṃ strīṃhūmātmayugaṃ tathāśyāmāṅgīṃ raktasatpāṇicaraṇāmbujaśobhitāmsvarṇāṃśukāṃ svarṇabhūṣāṃ vaisyāhidvandvamekhalāmdadhatīṃ śikhipicchānāṃ valayāṅgadaśobhitāmdvijanāgasphuratkarṇabhūṣāṃ mattāruṇekṣaṇāmkairātīṃ śikhipatrāḍhyaniketanavirājitāmbālākhyā tripureśānī pūrvasiṃhāsane sthitātripureśīṃ samuccāryaṃ nityākhyāṃ bhairavīṃ tathātāraṃ hṛtpadamābhāṣya kāmeśvarīparaṃ tataḥbhagavatyatha nīlānte patāke ca bhagāntikeparamānte tathā guhye hrīṅkāratritayaṃ likhetāveśaya tathā lekhyaṃ kavacāstrāgnivallabhāindranīlasphurannīlapatākāṃ kamale sthitāmdadhatīṃ parameśānīṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamāmśivacandrakhapāntāgnirudrasvaravibhūṣitambījaṃ hṛnmadhyavarṇāstu bījaśaktī tu kīlakamekavaktrāṃ daśabhujāṃ sarpayajñopavītinīmasthicarmāviśeṣāṃ tāṃ vahnikūṭasamaprabhāmraṇe smaraṇamātreṇa bhaktebhyo vijayapradāmpāśamagnimabhītiṃ ca dadhānāṃ vijayāṃ smaretjīvaṃ varuṇatārāḍhyaṃ sarvānte maṅgalāpadamvidyābhāgatrayeṇaiva dvirāvṛttyā ṣaḍaṅgakamsuprasannāṃ śaśimukhīṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitāmvaradābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ smaret saubhāgyavardhinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadyādācamanaṃ tasyai tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayetpradakṣiṇanamaskārān kṛtvā mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥanena vidhinā bhaktyā kumārīpūjayāpnuyātkumārīpūjanaṃ kṛtvā taṃ taṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayamtatpūjanena rājendra trailokyaṃ syād supūjitamtasmāt pūjaya bhūpāla kumārīryatamānasaḥekavaṃśasamudbhūtāṃ kanyāṃ samyak prapūjayetgranthisphuṭitaśīrṇāṅgīṃ raktapūyavraṇāṅkitāmsaṃtyajedrogiṇīṃ kanyāṃdāsīgarbhasamudbhavāmlābhārthe vaiśyasaṃbhūtāṃ sutārthe śūdravaṃśajāmprītā devyaḥ sadā naḥ śubhabalividhinā pāntu vīrendravandyāḥmahāsetuṃ viśuddhaṃ tu sahasrāre tu coddharetsvādhiṣṭhāne kāmarājaṃ rākiṇīṃ mūrdhniṃ saṃsthitāmviśuddhāntaṃ smared devi visatantutanīyasīmicchākriyāsvamaniśaṃ sveṣṭadevīṃ svarūpiṇīkīdṛśo vā mahāseturnirvāṇaṃ nātha kīdṛśamvinā yena maheśāni niṣphalaṃ parameśvaripañcākṣarī kālikāyāḥ kullikā parikathyatechinnāyāstu maheśāni kullikāṣṭākṣarī bhavetsaṃpatpradāyāḥ prathamaṃ bhairavyāḥ kullikā matāvāgbhavaṃ prathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmarājaṃ tataḥ parambhagavatīpadaṃ dadyādante ṭhadvayamuddharetlajjāstramantake dadyāttārā nīlasarasvatītāraṃ kūrcaṃ samuddhṛtya paścādaṃkuśamuddharetajñātvā kullikāmenāṃ japate yo'dhamaḥ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛthā ca tajjapaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥathātaḥ sampravakṣyāmi tacchṛṇuṣva priyaṃvadeviprāṇāṃ praṇavaḥ setuḥ kṣattriyāṇāṃ tathaiva cajaptvā tvidaṃ tu deveśi sundaryā bhuvaneśvarīanyeṣāṃ tu vadhūbījaṃ mahāseturvarānanedhane dhaneśatulyo'sau vāci vāgī'svaropamaḥjayakāraṃ bhavettasya sarvakāle na saṃśayaḥpraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya mātṛkādyaṃ samuccaretevaṃ nirvāṇamīśāni yo na jānāti pāmaraḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena yadyaduktaṃ maheśvariṛṣiśchando devatā ca tadbījaṃ śaktikīlakeevaṃ yadi japenmantrī mantrarājamanuttamamsākṣāt sa eva jagatāmadhiśo nātra saṃśayaḥsa eva nṛtyate bhūmau vicarecca yathāsukhamvacanaṃ padmapadmāntare cayādyān sabindūn saptārṇānuddhṛtya viyadoyutamamuṣya śabdamuddhṛtya prāṇā iha itīrayetamuṣya jīva iha ca sthita ityuddharet tataḥsarvendriyāṇi ca tataḥ punaḥ pañcadaśārṇakānprāṇā ihāgatya sukhaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhantu ca dviṭhaḥcaturdaśottarairvarṇaimantraḥ sarvārtha siddhidaḥchandāsi ṛgyajuḥ sāmānyāhurāgamapāragāḥpāśo bījaṃ śaktireva śaktiḥ kīlakamaṃkuśamśrīkaṇṭhaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ kavarga bindusaṃyutamsabindvananto hṛnmantraḥ sūkṣmaṃ binduyutaṃ vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rasagandhātmane tvante trimūrtīśaṃ sabīndukamṭavarga ca tathoddhṛtya śrotratvakcakṣurityathajhiṇṭīśa bindusaṃyuktaṃ tavargaṃ tādṛśa vadetvarmāṇubinduyuk sadyaḥ pavargo bindusaṃyutaḥanugraho binduyukto netramantra udāhṛtaḥuktvā manobuddhyahaṅkārāntacitātmane padamevaṃ ṣaḍaṅgamanavastārabījatrayādikāḥnāmitaḥ pādayugmāntaṃ kaṇṭhadānābhimastakāttato hṛtpadmamadhye tu dhyātvā vasudalāmbujamnair-ṛtyottarayāmyeṣu karṇikāyāṃ daleṣu caekaikaśo lavarjyāni tato devīṃ hṛdi smaretdevīmjuhuyād taddaśāṃśaṃ ca carubhirdhṛtasaṃyutaiḥarcayet ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśvaramdaleṣu mātaraḥ pūjyāstadbāhye lokanāyakāḥiti saṃsādhito mantraḥ ṣaṭkarmaphalado bhavetsājyena caruṇā paścāt tarpaṇādi samācaretmṛtā vaivasvatā bhūyo jīvahā prāṇahā punaḥkṣetrapratiharītyetāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥaṃkuśena hṛtasyāpi sādhyasyāsūn samāharettasyāḥ prāṇātmakaṃ yantraṃ sakīṭaṃ hṛdaye nyasetdaleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāmataḥ paramyādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaretevamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaretekaikāṃ sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayed
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tantucchedaṃ prakurvīta vahnibījena sarvataḥevamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasumohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇiākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdiprāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamānvarṇavṛtaṃ dharāsthamvaśayet sakalān devān kiṃ punaḥ pārthivāñjanānpuṣpai raktotpalairvāpi mūlena ca navāhutīḥyādihaṃsāntavarṇotthāḥ prāṇadūtyo nava smṛtāḥākarṣiṇī ca grasanā bhramadā visphuliṅginītattadvarṇādinā nāmnā tāsāṃ caiva hunet kramātgatvā sādhyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā pāśabījena sundariprāṇāmākṛṣya sādhyasya cānayantīṃ sadā smaretdaleṣu vāyuvahnīndravaruṇānāṃ sureśvariyādīn haṃsasamāyuktān bhṛṅgākārānanusmaretevamātmahṛdambhoje bhṛṅgīrūpān dhiyā smaretekaikān sādhyahṛtpadmād bhṛṅgānekaikamānayettantucchedaṃ prakūrvīta vahnibījena pārvatievamekādaśāvṛtti kuryāt sarveṣu karmasumohavidveṣayordhūmrān kṛṣṇān māraṇakarmaṇiākṛṣṭān sādhyahṛtprāṇān sthāpayedātmano hṛdiprāṇān sādhyasya maṇḍūkānātmanastu bhujaṅgamānitthaṃ prayogakuśalo manunānena sundarivāyvagniśakravaruṇaśivarākṣasasomagāndaleṣu bindusaṃyuktān kṣakāraṃ karṇikāntare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhyanāmasamopetaṃ vilikhedgirisaṃbhavekrūrakarmasu samproktadravyairaṣṭaviṣādibhiḥdvādaśāṃgulamānena spaṣṭāṅgīmatimañjulāmlikhitaṃ śavavastre ca sakīṭaṃ varavarṇinichitvā tāñjuhuyādrātrau sādhyaṃ smṛtvā citānalegṛhadhūmastrikaṭukaṃ viṣāṣṭakamudāhṛtamśaive ca gāṇapatye ca ṣaṇṇavatyaḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥśākte tu saptatiḥ proktāḥ śaivyaśceti ca kecanadūtyo nava daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥīśvaraḥ śuddhavidyā ca māyā vidyā kalā tathāahaṅkāraśca buddhiśca manaḥśrotratvacastataḥupastha śabdausparśaśca raso gandho viyanmarutkāntirmanoramā caiva tataścaiva manoharāśaṃkhinī śoṣiṇī caiva vaśaṃkarī ca śiñjinīpūṣā ceddhā sumanasā ratiḥ prītirdhṛtistathāśaśinī cāṅgirācchāyā tataḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalāamṛtādyā daśa prāṇā yādayo nava varṇakāḥatha vakṣye vaiṣṇavākhyāḥ kalāḥ śṛṇu varānanehṛtpadmaṃ sūryasomāgnivāsudevāhvayāstataḥśraddhādayo'tra vijñeyāḥ saurāḥ śṛṇu vadāmi tesparśo rūpaṃ raso gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvak cakṣureva caupasthaśca mano garvo buddhirdhīḥ prakṛtistataḥātmavidyāśivāścaite pratilomakramāt punaḥśraddhādayastataḥ proktāḥ kalāḥ sarvāḥ samīritāḥkuryādāvāhanaṃ mantrī pratimādau śubhe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalānāṃ hāsavṛddhyendoḥ kṛṣṇaśuklaprabhedataḥgurutaḥ śāstrataḥ samyagjñātvā kūrvīta deśikaḥdivyairmanobhavairdravyairgandhapuṣpaiḥ sragādibhiḥgrāmyāraṇyādisaṃbhūtairyāgadravyairmanoramaiḥjātamātrāṇi puṣpāṇi ghrātānyeva nisargataḥprāṇibhiśca dvirephādyaiścoṣyante ca na saṃśayaḥśivārthaṃ puṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavet sa tu hiṃsakaḥsarvaduḥkhapiśācebhyo mukto bhavati nānyathāpūjopakaraṇaiḥ kuryurdadyurdhānāni cārhaṇamsaṃskārānna nivartante vidyātikramadoṣataḥsadādhikāraḥ sarveṣāṃ mahāpātakināmapiprāpnoti candravadane dānahomādibhirvināpūjayedvidhinānena kaḥ kuryādetadanvahamnāraṇyavāsināṃ śaktirna te santi kalau yugetasmādaparihāryatvādanyathā cānupāyataḥtāścābhigamanā copādānejyādhyāyayogakāḥsammārjanopalepādisaṃskāro devamandiretataścāpi bhavedanyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ punaḥmantrārthabhāvanāpūrvaṃ japo mantrasya kīrtanamgurudevātmanāmaikyabhāvanā yoga ucyatesāyujyamapi pañcānāṃ phalānyevaṃ viduḥ kramātutthāya dakṣiṇāṅgena vāmapādaṃ nyasedbhuvisañcintayanti dharmārthoṃ yāma utthāya paścimerātrivāsaḥ parityajya vāsasī paridhāya camārjayitvopalipyātha bhaktiyuktastu śaktibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā nyāsaṃ vidhānataḥarghyapādye nivedyātha dadyādvai dantadhāvanamkarāsyaproñchanāyātha dadyādvāso'malaṃ śubhamkarpūrābhaṃ smaret tatra śrīguruṃ devarūpiṇamvāme niṣaṇātiraktakāntiṃ vāmena līlākamalaṃ kareṇanāmabhistasya saṃketasaṃsiddhairgurukīrtanaiḥstuvīta stutibhiḥ prīta ācārya sarvasiddhayedṛṣṭaṃ tattena bhāvena dhyāyannāhnikamācaretjapaṃ homaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ nityaṃ kurvīta sādhakaḥgurudevatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayecca nirākulaḥiṣṭadevasya bhūmeśca tasyāṃ śvāsānusārataḥtata udvāsayed devān mantreṇānena deśikaḥuttiṣṭhantvṛṣayodevā gandharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥkṛtvā malacyutiṃ tatra vāsasā kaṃ praveṣṭya caśaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāśāstraṃ vidhinācamanaṃ tataḥpañcāpāne mṛttikāḥ syurekaikāntaramṛttikāḥpādayostisṛbhiḥ śuddhirjaṅghāśuddhistu pañcabhiḥsvadehe svedadoṣaghna brāhmaṇaḥ karmasiddhayeprāvṛṇmuktāvathaitasmādekamṛdapanodanametasmādapi caikaikāṃ mṛttikāṃ parilopayetpathi śaucaṃ vidhātavyaṃ deśakālānurodhataḥtadardhamāture proktamāturasyārdhamadhvanipriyāyeti hṛdanto'yaṃ sa manurdantaśuddhayemohane khādiraṃ proktaṃ stambhane cūtapallavamayaṃ kramo mahādevi trilokeṣu na vidyate
