sanskrit: yena bhakto'bhiṣiktastu yāgahomārhatāṃ vrajetgṛhītvāstreṇa saṃcintya yāyājjalaniketanammṛdaṃ kṛtvā dvidhā tatra ekabhāgopagaṃ tataḥlaukikaṃ gauṇaṃ madhyena bhāgenaikena yatnataḥvinyasyāṅge ṣaḍaṅgāni prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaramātmarakṣāṃ tataḥ kuryādvārikṣepeṇa cāstrataḥunmajjya kumbhamudrāṃ ca baddhvā siñcet svamūrdhanisa tīrtha phalamāpnoti tīrthe daśaguṇaṃ phalammṛdamastreṇa cādāya tena tāmabhimantrya camūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ vilipya ca tayā vapuḥnimajjya tūṣṇīmutthāya nābhimātrajale sthitaḥvinyasya ca ṣaḍaṅgāni kalpayettīrthamagrataḥsṛṇīmantreṇa mantrajño bhittvā cāṃkuśamudrayāmūlamantreṇa saṃyojya kalpite tīrthamaṇḍaledhyātvā tanmanunābhyarcya gaṅgāmantreṇa mantrayetjalasthaṃ vyoma ṣaṭdīrghasvarabhinnaṃ sabindukamambālike mahāmālinyehyehi bhagavantyathaśivajaṭādhirūḍhe ca gaṅge gaṅgāmbike dviṭhaḥkavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha saṃrakṣyāstreṇa mantrayetsamāvāhya jale dhyātvā tatpadadvayanirgatamtridhā devīṃ samuttīrya jalād dhaute suvāsasītoyābhāve tu yatkāryaṃ dūrge kāle tu śītaleprāptāpadyatha viprendra niśābhāge tathā munesthānaṃ daśa diśaḥ prāgvat saṃśodhyopaviśettataḥmūlamantrāditaḥ kuryāt sarvamantragaṇena vai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prabhāsādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ snātakasya tudhyānasnānamatho vakṣye dvābhyāmapi paraṃ ca yattatpādodakajāṃ dhārāṃ nipatantīṃ svamūrdhanitayā saṃkṣālayet sarvamantardehagataṃ malamidaṃ snānaṃ varaṃ mantrāt snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ smṛtamsnānapūrvāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā yataḥ sabhyāstu nāradakūrvīta mānasaṃ snānaṃ sarvatra vihitaṃ ca yattadabhāvādadhaḥ śāṭīyogapaṭṭakasaṃyutamparidhāyottarīyaṃ ca na kuryāt keśadhūnanamūrdhvaṃ tyajet snānavastraṃ gṛhasnāto yadā bhavetniṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu prātaḥsandhyāṃ samācaretvaiśyapuṇḍramardhacandraṃ śūdrāṇāṃ vartulākṛtidhārayet sarvadā śūlaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāribhiḥdhṛtaṃ tacchūladharaṇād bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥbhakṣaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtitamtatsarvaṃ bhavati bhasma yathāgnitejasā vanamvaivāhāgnyudbhavaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ śuci sugandhi cana līnaṃ nātikaṭhinaṃ na durgandhi nacoṣitamkhaṇḍīkṛtya śivāgnau tu nikṣipenmūlamantrataḥādāya vāsasāloḍya bhasmādhāre vinikṣipetudvāsane kṛte yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāyatevāmena pātre saṃśoṣya aghoreṇa vinirdahetitthaṃ tu saṃskṛtaṃ bhasma agnirityādimantrataḥpraṇavādyaiścaturthīhṛdantairnāmabhirīśakaiḥtripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ kuryānmūrdhni pañcākṣareṇa ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parigṛhyāgnirityādimantrairbhasmābhimantrayettisro rekhā bhavantyeṣu sthāneṣu munipuṅgavamadhyamānāmikāṃgulyo madhye tu pratilomataḥtisṛṇāmapi rekhāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ nava devatāḥṛgvedaśca kriyāśktiḥ prātaḥ savanameva caukāro dakṣiṇāgniśca nabhaḥ sattvaṃ yajustathāmaheśvaraśca rekhāyā dvitīyāyāśca devatāḥjñānaśaktiḥ sāmavedastṛtīyasavanaṃ tathāetā nityaṃ namaskṛtya tripuṇḍraṃ dhārayecchuciḥmuktikāmairjanaiḥ sevyaṃ punasteṣāṃ na sambhavaḥbrahmacārī gṛhastho vā vanastho yatireva catathānyaiḥ kṣatraviṭśūdrastrīgohatyādipātakaiḥvimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśya punarādāya mantrataḥlalāṭe brahma vijñeyaṃ hṛdaye havyavāhanaḥādityo bāhumadhye ca śaśī ca maṇibandhakemaṇibandhe ca vasavaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe haraḥ smṛtaḥmūlamantreṇa kṛtvā tu dehe kurvīt mārjanamaṅgāni vinyased dehe karanyāsapuraḥsaramabhimantrya ca mūlena saptavāraṃ ca sādhakaḥpratyarṇaṃ prokṣayenmūrdhni kuśairmūlena ca tridhāādāya toyamāmantrya bījairbhūtātmakaistathāsaptakṛtvastato mūlamanreṇa triḥ punaśca tatsamprokṣya mūlamantreṇa dakṣahastena mūrdhanipraviśyāntargataṃ sarvaṃ malaṃ saṃśodhya nirgatamvāmabhāge vajraśilāṃ dhyātvāstreṇa ca tat kṣipet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃkārabījamuccārya namo bhagavatīti cahārakāri ca ke jātavedasīti jvalanti cavahni dvidhā ca kavacamastraṃ cāpi samālikhetravisūryaśarāgāṣṭavedairaraṅgāni vinyasetudyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇābharaṇabhūṣitāmariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭe triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathāyasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa palāyante mahāpadaḥvicitrā devatā bījaṃ kakāraḥ kīlakaṃ ca tuṣaṭdīrghasvarabhedena nyasedaṅgāni deśikaḥvicitratilakā nityaṃ vicitrakusumojjvalāsaptamaḥ śvāsaḥpūrve ca dakṣiṇe paścādudagūrdhvaṃ krameṇa cayayā prakāśyate brahmasaccidānandalakṣaṇamcaturviṃśatyakṣarātmā gāyatrī śirasā sahadīptaṃ viśvadharaṃ svavakṣasi lasacchrīvatsacihnaṃ bhajemāṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍe bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattrinetramcaturmūrtivapuṣkāya bhāsitāṅgāya śambhavehūṃhūṃhūṃdrāṃdrīṃklīṃblūṃsaḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃhrīṃ klinne aiṃkroṃ nityamadadrave hrīṃ vajranityāyai namaḥtato bhagamālinīvidyātripurabhairavī aiṃ vicce klīṃ mahātripurasundaryai namaḥpañcavaktraiḥ śivaproktāḥ pañca cāmnāyadevatāḥīśānākhyaṃ tatpuruṣamaghoraṃ tadanantaramoṃkārādyaiḥ pañcahrasvairvilomāt sayutaṃ viyatśirovadanahṛdguhyapādadeśe yathākramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gāyatryā cātha mūlena dadyādarghyatrayaṃ sudhīḥtridhā japtvā ca gāyatrīmaṣṭāviṃśativārakamsamarpya tajjapaṃ mantrī devamudvāsya maṇḍalātdīkṣitaḥ sandhyā hīno na dīkṣāphalamaśnutevidhāyottarasandhyāyāḥ kriyāṃ kuryādatandritaḥaṣṭottaraśatāvṛttyā tarpayenmūlamantrataḥtatastadaṅgāvaraṇadevatāstarpayet kramātpunaḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ sāṅgāvaraṇakaṃ tataḥekāntaṃ nirjanaṃ yāyānmanojñaṃ doṣavarjitamdigantaraṃ na vīkṣeta (maunī) saṃruddhalocanaḥprāpya hastau ca pādau ca prakṣālyācamya yatnataḥpūjāvedyā bahiḥ sthitvā cuturhastāntare dhiyāpraṇamediṣṭadevaṃ svaṃ dikpālānapi cetasāprāyaścitternāpanudet tadā pāpaṃ smared dhiyāyat syād dṛḍhataraṃ pāpaṃ tad dūre cāvatiṣṭhateyat syādalpataraṃ pāpaṃ tannāśamupagacchatidadyādarghyaṃ dineśāya tatprakāramihocyatesindūreṇa tataḥ paścādupaviśya nijāsaneprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantreṇa mantravittatkalpoktavidhānena pūjayedupacārakaiḥnidhāya tatra sādhāraṃ sajalaṃ tāmrapātrakamsatilān raktapuṣpāṇi dūrvāścāpi pravinyasetabhimantrya ca tatpātraṃ samutthāpya karadvayātjapet tato yathāśakti sūryamantramananyadhīḥsmṛtvā praṇamya visṛjenmaṇḍalānte divākaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvanna pūjayedviṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā sureśvarīmdhanadhānyapaśukṣetraputramitrakalatradamtata utthāya vidhivad dvārapūjāṃ samācarettaddakṣiṇe mahālakṣmīṃ vāme caiva sarasvatīmgaṇapaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhī kramātdhātāraṃ ca vidhātāramūrdhvādikramato yajetpaścimadvāramārabhya dvārapālā amī kramāttato bhṛṅgiriṭiskandāvumācaṇḍeśvarau tataḥnandaḥ sunandacaṇḍo ca pracaṇḍabalasaṃjñakaukramādamī samabhyarcyā vaiṣṇavadvārapālakāḥlambodaraśca vikaṭo vighnarājastataḥ parambrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāetā devyāḥ kramādaṣṭau śaktayo dvārapālikāḥdvāramudghāṭya cāstreṇa mantritān sarṣapākṣatānnārācamudrayā samyagastramantreṇa deśikaḥastramantaṃ samuccārya maṇḍapāntarvinikṣipetpaṭhitvākṣatasidhārthapuṣpāṇi vikiret tataḥuktvāntare sarṣapamakṣatāṃśca puṣpāṇi muñceditipraviśya vighnān trividhān pātālabhvantarikṣagānvighnānutsārayed divyānastratīkṣṇāvalokanātpañcagavyārghyatoyābhyāṃ prokṣayenmaṇḍapāntaramvitānadhūpadīpādi puṣpadāmādiśobhitamnair-ṛtyāmarcayedvāstupuruṣaṃ candanādibhiḥsaṃskuryādāsanasthānaṃ caturbhirvīkṣaṇādibhiḥādhāraśaktimārabhya svāsanaṃ tatra vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatropaviśya vidhivat smared viṣṇuguru mudāpṛthivī devatā proktā viniyogo nijāsanedūrgāṃ kṣetrapatiṃ cāpi vahnyādiṣu samarcayetsvastikāsanamāsīnaḥ padmāsanamathāpi vāsthāpayed dakṣiṇe bhāge pūjā dravyāṇi cātmanaḥprakṣālanāya karayoḥ pātraṃ pṛṣṭhe nidhāpayetdarpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca pādukenārācamudrayā dṛṣṭyā samayā ca vilokayetaspṛśyasparśanaṃ vāpi yadanyāyārjitaṃ ca vātatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti naivedyādyavalokanātsa tu syācchūbhado vāpi niṣkravyādaḥ sukhapradaḥvasāmajjādisambhūtairyajñādāvupayojanenārasiṃhena mantreṇa devatīrthena saṃspṛśetvāmena pāṇinā dhṛtvā vāmapārśvasthitaṃ tadāyadajñānādapeyādisaṃsṛṣṭiriha saṅgatājalāśayaśavasparśāñjanasnānācca saṅgatamnatvā guruṃ gaṇeśānaṃ purataḥ sveṣṭadevatāmmardayitvā karau samyak surabhīkṛtya sādhakaḥvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa caiśānyāṃ duratastyajetvimardanārthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt karaśodhanakarmaṇiprasādena parityāgo diśyaiśānyāṃ viśeṣataḥaṃgulyāgrāṇi śuddhāni puṣpāṇāṃ grahaṇādbhavetnirmanthanāt pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ ghrāṇānnāsāgramuttamamupāntyaḥ sāgnicandreṇa rañjitaḥ śūnyasaṃyutaḥprāntādirvāsudevāntavarṇenāpi ca saṃhataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: (agniḥ sadyo binduyutā romabījamudāhṛtam)ūrdhvordhva mūlamantreṇa digbandhamapi deśikaḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nyāsaṃ kuryādanantarampādato jānuparyantaṃ caturasraṃ savajrakamjānvorānābhi candrārdhanibhaṃ padmena lāñchitamnābhitaḥ kaṇṭhaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ raktavarṇakamkaṇṭhād bhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyostu maṇḍalambhrūmadhyād brahmarandhrāntaṃ vartulaṃ dhvajalāñchitamiti dhyātvā tu bhūtāni svakīye deśikottamaḥaiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ caiva paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikamkṛtvā tatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibhamyogayuktena vidhinā so'haṃmantreṇa sādhakaḥvidhāya prāṇasaṃrodhaṃ vāyubījena vāyunābhasma tadvātamārgeṇa nirgataṃ cintayet sudhīḥsañjāte sakale dehe devatopāsanakṣameātmānaṃ hṛdayāmbhojamānayet paramātmanaḥdevatārādhane yogyamutpannamiti bhāvayetdhyātvaivaṃ brahmarandhrācca hṛdi jīvakalāṃ nyasetyāvanna kurute devi tāvad devārcanaṃ nahiṣaḍaṅgādyakhilanyāsairdehaśuddhiritīritāpaṃktiśchandastu vijñeyaṃ mukhe vinyasya pārvatidhiyāvagantavyatayā sadaiva hṛdi pratiṣṭhā manudevatāyāḥṣivarṇādistu vijñānamatastadvyāpakaṃ ca saḥchādīti dhāturicchāyāṃ dādirdānārthako bhavetvrīḍārthakāddadātīti sampannaṃ devatāpadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayaṃ ca śiro devi śikhā ca kavacaṃ tataḥvaṣaṭ huṃvauṣaḍantaṃ tu phaḍebhiḥ saha vinyasetnatyā hutyā ca vaṣaṭ huṃ vauṣaṭ phaḍebhiraṅgakavidhiḥśikhāyai vaṣaḍityuktaṃ kavacāya humīritamjātiṣaṭkamidaṃ proktaṃ hṛdādyastrāntasaṅgatamkhaḍgāya hṛdayāyeti namoyuktaṃ kanīyasīsukhaḍgāya tato vācyaṃ śirase tadanantaramhuṃkāraṃ praṇavād devi bindulāñchitamastakamvaṣaḍantaṃ pravinyasyet madhyamāmadhyamāṃgulaukavacāya humityetat tarjanyāmapyanāmayāastrarakṣayamāye cāpyastrāya tadanantaramtantre aṣṭādaśaḥ śvāsaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānādyā ṛcaḥ samyagaṃgulīṣu yathākramammūrdhāsyahṛdayāmbhojaguhyapādeṣu vā punaḥtārapañcakamuccārya sarvajñāya hṛdīritamtadante brahmaśirase śiro'ṅgaṃ jvalitāntataḥvajriṇe vajrahastāya svatantrāya tanucchadaḥnetramuktaṃ ślīṃpaśu huṃ phaḍanto'nantaśaktayetataḥ pravinyasedvidvānaṣṭātriṃśatkalāstanauvaktreṣu pañca vinyasedīśānasya kalāḥ kramātīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmaṅgadā tadanantarambrahmeṣṭadā tṛtīyā syācchivo me astu tatparāaṃśumālinyatha parā praṇavādyā namontakāḥcatasro vinyasenmantrī puruṣasya kalāḥ kramātmahādevāya śabdānte dhīmahi syāt tataḥ parampratiṣṭhā kathitā paścāt tṛtīyā syāt pracodayāthṛdgrīvāṃsadvaye nābhau kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasiaghorebhyastamā pūrvamīritā prathamā kalāghorānte syāt kṣamā paścāt tṛtīyā parikīrtitāvyādhistu pañcamī proktā sarvebhyastadanantaramkṣudhā syāt saptamī proktā rudrarūpebhyastṛṣṇikākaṭyāṃ pārśvadvaye caiva vāmadevakalā nyasetsyājjyeṣṭhāya namo rakṣā dvitīyā parikīrtitākālāya nama ityante mālinī parikīrtitānamaḥ saṃyaminī ṣaṣṭhī kathitā tadanantaramnamo vṛddhiraṣṭamī syādbalānte ca sthitā kalāsarvabhūtadamanāya namo'nte bhrāmiṇī kalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: unmanāya namaḥ paścājjvarā proktā trayodaśīpādadostalanāsāsu mūrdhni bāhuyuge nyasetsadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi siddhiḥ syāt prathamā kalābhave dyutistṛtīyā syādabhave tadanantarammedhā syāt pañcamī proktā kalā bhūyo bhavasva māmudbhavāya namaḥ paścāt sudhā syādaṣṭamī kalāaṣṭātriṃśatkalāḥ proktāḥ pañcabrahmapadādikāḥanantacandrabhuvano bindurbinduyugānvitaḥparāprāsādamantrastu sādiruktaḥ kuleśvariardhanārīśvaro devo devatā parikīrtitāmahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsamaṅgaṣoḍhāpuraḥsarammahāṣoḍhāhvayaṃ nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥjagatī chanda ākhyātamardhanārīśvaraḥ prabhuḥviniyogaḥ samākhyātaḥ sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥmahāṣoḍhāhvayo nyāsaḥ sarvanyāsottamottamaḥāyai parāmbādevyai ca namo'stu vyāpakaṃ nyasettritāramūlavidyānte amāṃ-imatalaṃ bhavetguhyādyayoginīmūladevānte'yutaṃ vadetśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā gulphayorvinyasetpriyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā jaṅghayorvinyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā devi jānvoḥ pravinyasetśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktamūrvordeveśi vinyasetśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā guhyadeśe pravinyasetśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā mūlādhāre pravinyasetśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā svādhiṣṭhāne nyaset priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā nābhideśe nyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā hṛdaye vinyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tālumūle nyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā ājñāyāṃ vinyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā lalāṭe vinyaset priyeśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā brahmarandhre nyaset priyenādhipāyai śrīparāmbādevyai hṛd vyāpakaṃ nyasetkeśavo nārāyaṇo mādhavagovindaviṣṇavaḥśrīdharastu hṛṣikeśaḥ padmanābho dāmodaraḥakṣarādyeṣṭadeśāno ugrordhvanayanā tathāaikāriṇī caughavatī sarvakāmāñjanaprabhābhavaḥ śarvaśca rudraśca paśupatiścogra eva caaghorasadyojātau ca vāmadeva itīritāḥdharmapraśamanī paṃktināsā candrārdhadhāriṇījñānānādāṭaṅkaḍhakkādharā ṭhaṅkāraḍāmarībrahmā prajāpatirvedhāḥ parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥhiraṇyagarbha ityuktāḥ kramād brahmādayo'pyamīṣaḍādhārālayā sarvanāyikā hasitānanātritāramūlamantrānte svarādyakṣaraśaktikānsvaskandhapārśvakukṣyūrujānujaṅghāpadeṣu cakabhādyarṇayutān mantrī ṭhaḍāntān śaktisaṃyutāndaśādhāreṣu brahmādīn yādīñ śaktiyutān nyasetāyai parāmbādevyai ca namaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ nyasetbhedaśca praṇavādyekākṣarātmākhilamantrataḥāyai tathaikakūṭeśvaryambādevyai namo vadet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛ ṝṃ ḷmādi vahnyāditrikūṭaṃ pūrvavatparamomaumaṃmaḥpañcalakṣaṃ sūryādi pūrvavatparamghaṃṅaṃcaṃ saptalakṣaṃ gaṇeśādi pūrvavatparamñaṃ ṭaṃṭhaṃ navalakṣaṃ ca brahmādi pūrvavatparamtaṃthaṃdamekādaśalakṣaṃ rudrādi pūrvavatparam(phaṃbaṃbhaṃ trayodaśalakṣaṃ lakṣmyādi pūrvavatparam)laṃvaṃśaṃ pañcadaśalakṣaṃ durgādi pūrvavatparamtritāramūlamantrānte sakalāṃ mātṛkāṃ vadetdevyai hṛdvyāpakaṃ kuryānmantranyāse maheśvarinirodhikāyāmardhendau bindau caiva kalāpadedhruvamaṇḍaladeśe ca vinyaset kulanāyikeāyai devyai parādi syāt pūrvavadvyāpakaṃ nyasettritāramūlamantrānte amāṃ sahasrakoṭi canivṛttyambāpadaṃ devyai nama ityuccaret priyeuṃ ūṃ tapasvividyāṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavaccaretḷṃ ḹṃ muniṃ tathā śāntyatītāṃ śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatoṃ auṃ rakṣaḥkulānte ca gaganāṃ pūrvavat priyekaṃkhaṃ siddhaṃ mahocchuṣmāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaretṅaṃcaṃ tathāpsarojayāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavaduccaretjhaṃ ñaṃ guhyakaśabdānte ajitāṃ pūrvavatparamḍaṃḍhaṃ kinnaravāmāmbā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparamthaṃdaṃ ca pitṛraudryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat parampaṃphaṃ bhaivaraśabdānte kuṇḍalī pūrvavat parammaṃyaṃ ca kṣetraśabdānte kālarātrī ca pūrvavatvaṃśaṃ brahmāpi sarveśvaryambā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haṃlaṃ rudraḥ sarvakartrī śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatparamaṃguṣṭhagulphajaṅghāsu jānūrukaṭipārśvakedakṣabhāgādivāmāntaṃ vinyaset kulanāyikesamastadevatādhiṃ ca pāyai śrī ca parāmbikāmdevatānyāsa evaṃ syānmātṛnyāsastathocyatebhūcarīkulaśabdānte sahitāyaipadaṃ vadetāṃkṣāmante tu brahmāṇyambādevyai ca padaṃ vadetakṣaṃ maṅgalanāthāya aṃkṣamante'sitāṅga cacavargaṃ khecarīmīlāṃ carcikāṃ ca maheśvarīmśeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat proktvā tato vakṣye maheśvarikaumārīṃ piśācamūhāṃ vadedyogeśacaṇḍakauapasmāraṃ harasiddhiṃ krodha ca pūrvavat paramindrāṇīṃ vaṭuka eṃśaṃ kilikilānte kapālinamcāmuṇḍāṃ pretamāvaṃ ca kālarātraśca bhīṣaṇamtritāramūlamantrānte mātṛbhairavaśabdataḥmātṛnyāsaṃ maheśāni aṣṭādhāreṣu vinyasetamṛtārṇavamadhyasthasvarṇadvīpe manoramenavaratnamaye śrīmatsiṃhāsanagatāmbjeardhāmbikāsamāyuktaṃ pravibhaktavibhūṣaṇammandasmitamukhāmbhojaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharampānapātraṃ ca cinmudrāṃ triśūlaṃ pustakaṃ karaiḥmahāṣoḍhoditāśeṣadevatāgaṇasevitampuṃrūpaṃ vā smareddevi strīrūpaṃ vā vicintayetsarvatejomayaṃ dhyāyet sacarācaravigrahamyoniṃ liṅgaṃ ca surabhiṃ hetimudrācatuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smarecchirasi haṃsagaṃ tadabhidhānapūrvaṃ gurummantrī nacātra sandeho nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥdevāḥ sarve namasyanti taṃ namāmi na saṃśayaḥdivyakṣetraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ samantād daśayojanamtatra śrīrvijayo lābhaḥ sanmānaṃ pauruṣaṃ priyesamāsānmṛtyumāpnoti yadi trātā śivaḥ svayamdivyāntarikṣabhūśailajalāraṇyanivāsinaḥbhayagrastena manasā nekṣante sādhakaṃ priyedevāḥ sarve prakūrvanti ṛṣayaśca munīśvarāḥakṣayāṃ labhate siddhiṃ rahasi nyāsamācaretloke nāsti na sandehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥmahāṣoḍhāparijñānaṃ nālpasya tapasaḥ phalamso'haṃ turīyavidyāṃ ca cidānandapadaṃ tataḥprāgvat sarvaṃ samuccārya saccidānandaśabdataḥtataḥ prāgvat samuccāryāhamevāsmīti coccaretsaṃghaṭṭamudrayā mūrdhni vinyased deśikottamaḥahamasmīti brahmāhamasmi so'haṃ samīrayetmahāprakāśaparyante pūrṇānandapadaṃ tataḥprakāśaparipūrṇeti parāparamahāpi cayoginīmūlavidyāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi caparāprāsādabījaṃ ca śrīprāsādapareti ca(3)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ makaradhvajaḥkāmarājadvayaṃ mohayadvayaṃ kāmarājahṛt(4)praṇavāditritāraṃ ca haṃsaḥ svaccheti vai vadetsvāhā hsau hsau vidyeyaṃ śambhavīmūla pūrvikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tmacaitanyānandamayi mahābindupadaṃ vadetpraṇavāditritāraṃ mīmiyaṃ vai kathitā budhaiḥsvacchaprakāśātmike ca māyāṃ kulamahāpadamsamayānte ca vimale śrībījamiyamīśvari(7)tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ haṃsastato nityaprakāśa casiddhe mahābhairavīti ātmānaṃ bodhayadvayamparabodhinī mūlānte vidyā syāt parameśvarikulapañcākṣarīmūlavidyeti paripaṭhyatecaitanyatripurāmūlavidyeyaṃ parameśvariśuddhasūkṣma-nirākāra-nirvikalpapadaṃ tataḥnandaśaktipadaṃ bālātṛtīyaṃ bījamuddharetmūlavidyeti kathitā sarvāgamaviśāradaiḥparamānte haṃsaparamātmane vahnivallabhā(12) tāraṃ tāratrayasyānte'pnāmākhyapadaṃ bhavetvyomātītapadaṃ vyomeśvaryambāpadamuddharet(13) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ vāṇīṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ bījamuddharet(14) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ māyāṃ tato bhagavatīti camahāmātaṅgini vāṇīṃ klinne blūṃstrīṃ likhediyam(15) tāraṃ tāratrayaṃ prāsādaparāṃ khecarīṃ tataḥiyaṃ tu kathitā mūlavidyānuttaraśāṅkarīuddharet parameśāni mahātripurasundarīphreṃbījaṃ ca tato lekhyaṃ pareśvaramanurmataḥkubjike phreṃ viśuddhau tu vicceśvaramahāmanuḥkubjikāyai padaṃ caiva hsaphraṃ vicce tathaiva cahasroṃkṣrāṃkṣrīṃ tathaivakṣrīṃ kiṇidvandvamataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hasaphreṃ hasakṣamalavayarūṃ praṇavameva cakṣamalān vayarūṃ caiva tadbījaṃ vāmanetrayukhrīṃhraṃhrāṃhlāṃ tato vāṇīṃ nitye bhagavatīti cahyehauṃṅañaṇanān me ca kṣrāṃkṣrīṃkṣrūṃkṣrastathaiva cakubjikāyai tataśchrāṃ chraṃchrīṃ ghore ca tataḥ parammahākiṇiyugaṃ vicce saṃvarteśamahāmanuḥrigaṭini padaṃ caiva piṅgaṭini padaṃ tataḥmaṇipūrakacakre tu nyastavyaḥ sādhakottamaiḥrayūṃ namo bhagavati hasphreṃ bījamataḥ paramaghoramukhi chrāṃchrūṃchrīṃ kiṇidvandvaṃ kiṇidvayamṣaḍanvayeśvaraḥ śrīmān paraśambhurajo'vyayaḥdvīpicarmakaṭisphāramuṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥbrahmanābhikajāṃguṣṭho daṃṣṭrāvistṛtalāpanaḥśūlāsīṣuśaktisṛṇivaradhārī mahātanuḥdevāvṛtaḥ pitṛvane krīḍākṛnmānasottareiti dhyātvābhisampūjya mūlavidyādvayaṃ punaḥjayadurgā cchinnamastā samayāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥdevīṃ bhajāmi dhṛtamudgaravairijihvāmcaturbhujāṃ trinayanāṃ bhīṣaṇāṃ candraśekharāmdakṣiṇe cābhayaṃ pāśaṃ vāme bhuvanameva cadhyāyed durgāṃ jayākhyāṃ tridaśaparivṛtāṃ sevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥtatpadmakośamadhye tu maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍarociṣaḥrajaḥsattvatamorekhāyonimaṇḍalamaṇḍitamchinnamastāṃ kare vāme dhārayantīṃ svamastakampibandīṃ raudhirīṃ dharāṃ nijakaṇṭhasamudbhavām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇe ca kare katrīṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāmasthimālādharāṃ devīṃ nāgayajñopavītinīmsadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharāmyonimudrāsamārūḍhāṃ vicitrāsanasaṃsthitāmpūjanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhayemerukailāsabhūsaṃjñā bhedāstasya tridhā bhavetmātṛkāyāstu kailāsaprastārākhyaṃ sureśvarisṛṣṭikramaṃ merucakraṃ kailāsaṃ cārddhamerukamekaikasva tu cakrasya tribhedāstu bhavanti hisṛṣṭikramaṃ tu samayamataṃ syāt sthitisaṃjñakammerucakre tu saṃhārakramapūjā na vidyatesaṃhārapūjā kailāsaprastāre'tra vidhīyatesthitikramo gṛhasthasya saṃhāro vaninoyateḥsauvarṇe rājate tāmre sphāṭike vaidrume tathākṛtvā cakrasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpayet pūjayedapiteṣāṃ madhye sphāṭikaṃ tu sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavetsuvarṇaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkaramtāmre tu racitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matamlohatrayodbhavaṃ yantraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ matamtanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhātāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭhaṃ kuryānmanoharamśāntidaṃ puṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇamtraividhyaṃ śṛṇu cakrasya bhūprastāro'rdhamerukamūrdhvarekho mahāśāntirmartyalokanivāsināmbhūpuraṃ tu samārabhya vaindavāntaṃ maheśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samordhvarekhānavakamūrdhvarekhaṃ prakīrtitamyantrabījasvarūpaṃ te mayā snehāt prakāśitamunnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanamekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaḥ śriyai kīrtyai ca kalpatebhūcakre ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavetcaturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukamcaturasraṃ samārabhya vindvantaṃ samarekhakamphalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācanakulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathāpalapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarccāpīṭhaṃ manoharamtasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayettāmrasya pūrvasaṃkhyaiva māṇikyādau yathecchayāśālibhirvā ṛjunyastaistribhirmānāntaraṃ bhavetvṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥśivaśaktyātmakaṃ jñeyaṃ śrīcakraṃ śivayorvapuḥyoginīsahitāstasya hiṃsāṃ kurvanti bhairavāḥsthaṇḍile nityapūjāyāṃ hastamātraṃ praśasyatenaśyanti sarvavighnāni prāpsyate ca yathepsitamṣaḍguṇaṃ (ṣoḍaśa) rajatasyāpi caitallohatrayaṃ śubhamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhīnāmadhipo jāyate'cirātindranīle ca vaiḍūrye sphaṭike marakate'pi vātāmraṃ tu kāntidaṃ yantraṃ suvarṇaṃ śatrunāśanamkhaṇḍite sphuṭite bhagne bhraṣṭe mānavivarjiteanyamantrārcite caiva patitasparśadūṣitedagdhaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ yantraṃ hṛtaṃ caureṇa vā priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣamātraṃ japedvidyāṃ homatarpaṇapūrvikāmbhagnaṃ karoti yo mūrkho mṛtyustamya dhruvaṃ bhavetsamudre vā kṣipeddevi anyathā duḥkhamāpnuyātśaktyopaviṣṭāṃ śaktiṃ tu vilikhedvistṛtāṃ sakṛtagnīśāsuravāyavyarekhā vistārya yojayetmadhyakoṇacatuṣkasya rekhe ākṛṣya buddhimānsamatrikoṇaśaktyaikyaṃ sukhadaṃ netrayoryathābahiraṣṭadalaṃ padmamakiñjalkaṃ samālikhetsuvṛttaṃ parameśāni tato bhūbimbamālikhetśalākayā suvarṇasya miśrayā ghusṛṇendubhiḥathavā bhūtale devi surekhaṃ kuṃkumena vāetaccakraṃ maheśāni madhye binduvirājitammanukoṇaṃ maheśāni madhyacakramidaṃ priyecatvāriṃśadbhagairyuktaṃ tribhagairapi pārvatinavātmakamidaṃ bhadre navayonyaṅkitaṃ bhavetlakāraḥ pṛthivībījaṃ tatrovāpuramucyatetasmāt ṣoḍaśapatraṃ tu hakāraḥ śiva ucyateīkārastu mahāmāyā bhuvanāni caturdaśaśaktirekā daśasthāne sthitvā sūte jagattrayamrakārāt parameśāni cakraṃ vyāpya vijṛmbhatekalādaśānvito vahnirdaśakoṇapravartakaḥyonirasya tadā cakre vasuyonyaṅkitaṃ bhavettrikoṇarūpā yonistu bindunā baindavaṃ bhavetśrīcakraṃ tu varārohe śrīvidyāvarṇasambhavambhūpradeśe same cāḍhye sindūrarajasā'thavā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛjurekhaṃ netraramyaṃ sandhibhedaṃ samamṛjupaṭṭaṃ viracya śrīkāṣṭhe raktacandanasambhaverocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ ca kastūrīcandanendubhiḥīśādagrestadagrābhyāṃ rekhe ākṛṣya deśikaḥtrikoṇākārarūpeyaṃ tasyā upari saṃlikhetpūrvaśaktyagrabhāge tu mānayaṣṭivadālikhetsaṃdhibhedakrameṇaiva tayoḥ śaktyostataḥ paramvahnimaṇḍalametattu pūrvāgraṃ vīravanditepūrvaśaktīśavahnibhyāṃ koṇābhyāṃ suravanditevāyurākṣasakoṇābhyāṃ rekhāṃ paścimagāṃ tathāyonyagragāṃ pūrvadeśe dakṣiṇottarataḥ kramātkoṇāgragāṃ yojayitvā daśakoṇaṃ tadā bhavetīśānavahnito rekhe pūrvayonyagrayoḥ kramātvāyurākṣasakoṇāgrarekhe vistārya sundariekāgra pūrvakoṇāgracumbinīṃ tu manoharāmdaśakoṇeṣu deveśi tyaktvā koṇacatuṣṭayamdve dakṣiṇe vibhāge tu tathā cottarabhāgakeyoniṃ vahniṃ ca saṃyojya śakrāraṃ jāyate tathāṛjvākṛtiryathā devi jāyate'timanoharābindutrikoṇavasvāraṃ cakrabhedādvarānaneśakrayonyaṅkitaṃ devi bāhyamadhyagataṃ bhavetsarvasāmrājyadaṃ devi sarvopadravanāśanammahāmokṣapradaṃ devi vāgvilāsakaraṃ mahattadyutaṃ kuru padmākṣi vasupatraṃ manoharamcaturasraṃ caturdvārasahitaṃ parameśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakre'smin saviśeṣāstāḥ sādhakaṃ mānayanti himuktāmāṇikyaghaṭitasamujjvala virājitamṣoḍaśāraṃ candrabimbarūpaṃ tu svakalālayamaṣṭapatraṃ maheśāni japākusumasannibhametat trayaṃ varārohe sṛṣṭicakraṃ vasupradamcaturdaśāraṃ deveśi dāḍimīkusumaprabhamdaśāraṃ taptahemābhaṃ sindūrasadṛśaṃ priyedvitīyamapi paṃktyasraṃ japākusumasannibhametat trayaṃ maheśāni sthiticakraṃ sukhapradamaṣṭakoṇaṃ varārohe bālārkakiraṇāruṇamudyatsūryasahasrābhaṃ bandhūkakusumaprabhamtrikoṇaṃ sarvasambhūtikāraṇaṃ bhṛtidaṃ sadāsadāśivamayaṃ cakranāyakaṃ parameśvaripaścimāmnāyasaṃsevyaṃ trayamuttarasevitamcakrapatreṣu deveśi padādhvā tu nigadyatevarṇādhvā mātṛkārūpī kathayāmi tavānaghepārthivaṃ tanmayaṃ viddhi ṣoḍaśāraṃ kalātmakamkādiḍhāntāḥ śakravarṇāḥ śakrakoṇeṣu saṃsthitāḥmakārādikṣakārāntā dvitīye tu daśārakeakathāditrikoṇāntaṃ hakṣayugmaṃ tu madhyamamsaṭtriṃśattattvabharitaṃ cakramūlānurūpataḥsā bālā bhairavīyuktā mahātripurabhairavīmantrādhvā ca samākhyāto niścayena sadā priyetaccaturdhā vibhajyādau caturviṃśāṃgulaṃ kramāttāsāṃ sammārjayed bhāgānagrayorubhayorimān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīve purāṇaṃ śukre tu svaraṃ rāhau śaraṃ punaḥrekhāyugmaṃ śaniṃ sūryāddharāvṛtte niyojayetcandrāt ketuṃ kaveḥ somaṃ budhādrāhuṃ guroḥ kujamaṣṭāṣṭāṃgulamānena bahiścakratrayaṃ likhettatra kramānmadhyayonistiryagrekhāḥ samantataḥsampradāyaviśeṣaṇa kṣamā viśvakalāśrayecakrarājamidaṃ proktaṃ madhye binduvibhūṣitamsindūrarajasā bhūmau likhitvā cakramarcayetpramṛjya tiryaṅmadhyasthaṃ sūtraṃ tiryaṅ nipātayetvidhāya taddvayorantānmadhyasūtrāntataḥ kramātdvyaṣṭāgrataḥ samārambhānnavamaprathamāntarānavamaprathamāgrābhyāṃ turyasaptamakāvadhitataścaturthaṣaṣṭhāntadvayārambhāt tathāṣṭagamcaturmarmānuguṇyena tataḥ pañcamakāntayoḥmārjayenmadhyagaṃ brahmasūtraṃ syāccakramuttamamvidhāya ṣaḍbhirvṛttaiśca caturasraṃ tathāṣṭabhiḥdakṣiṇottarato rekhātrayāt sthānadvayaṃ tathādvidhā kuryācca catvāri padāni parameśvariśaraṇakoṇāḥ pariṇatāḥpañca tāni ca śāktāni māyādīni śivasya tupañcaviṃśatitatvāni tatraivāntarbhavanti tetrirekhāsaṅgamasthānaṃ marmamarmavido viduḥaṣṭāviṃśatimarmāṇi caturviṃśatisandhayaḥsevamānāścakrakidyāṃ devagandharvasevitāmagnāvantarvabhau bhānuragnīṣomamayaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trikoṇaṃ vaindavaṃ saumyamaṣṭakoṇaṃ ca miśrakametat prasādādindrādyā vasavo'ṣṭau marudgaṇāḥpuratrayaṃ ca cakrasya somasūryānalātmakamguhyādguhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ na kutrāpi prakāśitamtanmadhye baindavasthānaṃ tatrāste parameśvarīcakraṃ tripurasurandaryā brahmāṇḍākāramīśvariindriyātmakamevaṃ ca manastattvātmakaṃ tathābaindave jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāriṇījyotīrūpā varākārā yasya dehodbhavāḥ śivekodirarbudameteṣāṃ parā saṃkhyā na vidyateyasyā devyā maheśāni bhāsā sarvaṃ vibhāsatetasyāśca śivaśakteśca cidrupāyāścitiṃ vināteṣāmanantakoṭīnāṃ mayūkhānāṃ maheśvaribrahmāṇḍaṃ vyaśnuvānāste somasūryānalātmanāṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśataṃ candrasya kiraṇāḥ śivedivā sūryastathā rātrau somo vahniśca sandhyayoḥṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ ca triśataṃ dinānyeva tu hāyanaḥprajāpatirlokakartā marīcipramukhān munīnsaṃhāraśca harāyatta utpatirbhavanirmitāniyuktaḥ parameśānyā jagadevaṃ pravartateśrīvidyāraṇyayativiracite śrīvidyārṇavākhye tantre'ṣṭamaḥ śvāsaḥbindumadhye pretabījaṃ vilikhet parameśvaridvāratrayaṃ prakartavyaṃ yathā dvārāṇi bhūpuregranthayastu prakartavyāstriśūlāṣṭakameva capūrvādigranthiṣu tathā pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triśūleṣu mahādevi pūjayedaṣṭa bhairavīḥyoginīḥ pūjayet tāsāṃ mantrāstu parameśvaribhūrlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ(svarlokavāsinībhyastu yoginībhyo namo namaḥ)viphalā jāyate sarvā vāhanādidhanāpahādhūpahīne tathodvegaṃ vastrahīne dhanakṣayamkalaśairbandhunāśaśca bhavedvai girikanyakedakṣiṇārahite sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥpātramantrasamāyuktaṃ sarvadoṣāpahaṃ bhavetmantrāḥ parāṅmukhā yānti āpadaśca pade padeādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo na ca tṛpyanti devatāḥsiddhijanakaṃ muktipradaṃ mauktikamnārikelaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca muktāśuktisamudbhavamnārikelodbhavaṃ devi jñeyaṃ cottamamadhyayammadhyamottamakaṃ haimaṃ tāraṃ madhyamamadhyamamkanyasottamakaṃ bailvaṃ brahmavṛkṣajameva capurā vai nirmitaṃ pātraṃ viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatātasmin sampūjayeccaiva siddhayo'ṣṭau bhavanti hiuddhariṣyatyasandeho gṛhastho bhavati priyedṛṣṭvā pātraṃ nārikelaṃ sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyatiyo dadāti maheśāni rāhugraste divākarealābhe tasya pātrasya pātrasya cānyapātraistu pūjayetnṛtyanti sarvayoginyaḥ prītāḥ siddhiṃ dadanti caratnādīni ca pātrāṇi śubharekhāṅkitāni caarghyaṃ datvā tu raupyeṇa āyū rājyaṃ sutāṃllabhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvālābhe tu māheyaṃ svahastaghaṭitaṃ yadisarvatra svarṇavat tāmramarghyapātre tato'dhikambalihomakriyārthaṃ hi vinā pātraṃ na siddhyatimadhyamaṃ tu tribhāgonaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamnābhivivararūpāṇi puṇḍarīkākṛtīni catattadbhūtasamānābhamaṇḍalābhāni kalpayetyādṛśaṃ pātrarūpaṃ syādādhāraṃ tādṛgānayetśāntike pauṣṭike caiva rājataṃ kārayet priyestambhakāryeṣu sarveṣu viśeṣeṇa tu mṛnmayamtatpātreṇa varārohe devatāṃ yastu tarpayettathā mantrārṇanakṣatravṛkṣotthaṃ pātramuttamamtathaiva mantrasiddhiḥ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇāmantrarkṣayonisambhūtapātraṃ caivottamottamamparābhicāraśamanaṃ svamantrāṇāṃ ca siddhidampātrāṇi śrīgurumukhājjñātvārcanavidhau kṣipetkāṣṭhapātraṃ vijānīyānmantrārādhanakarmaṇigurupātraṃ bhogapātraṃ balipātramanukramātaṅgaṃ vīraṃ tathā guhyaṃ yoginīpātrameva caprokṣaṇīsahitāni syurnava pātrāṇi suvratepātrāṇyaṣṭādaśaitāni devyāḥ prītikarāṇi caādyapaṃkteradhaḥsthāpyau vidhivat parameśvarisāmānyaḥ sarvadevānāmarghyo'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥanyeṣāṃ devi devānāṃ sāmānyaṃ cācyadīśvariarghyapātraṃ tu vāyavye nair-ṛtyāṃ pādyapātrakammadhye tu madhuparkaḥ syādityetatpātralakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahā siddhārthakā dūrvā kuṃkumaṃ rocanā niśāsiddhārthaḥ kuṃkumaṃ dūrvā kuṣṭhaṃ lāmañjakaṃ śaśīamūnyācamanīyasya dravyāṇi pravadanti ṣaṭdaghyabhāve payaḥ kāryaṃ maghvabhāve tathā guḍaḥaṣṭagandhaṃ samāloḍya snānāmbhaḥ sādhu sādhayetpṛthak pātrāṇi pañca syurekaṃ pañcāmṛtasya casaptamaṃ koṣṭhyatoyasya cāṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ tathāetāni daśa pātrāṇi saure śaive ca vaiṣṇavearghyādipañcapātrāṇi tridhā saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥpañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ pañcadhārghyādipañcakamsāmānyāvaraṇaṃ devi sāmānyārghyeṇa sundariśaktīnāṃ śaktipātreṇa gurūṇāṃ gurupātrataḥyoginīpātratoyena tarpayet kulanāyikebhairavasya ca pātreṇa bhairavāṃstarpayedbudhaḥbalipātreṇa deveśi balyutsarjanamācaretrājarājeśvarasyāpi baliṃ tenaiva kārayetguhyapātrāmṛtenaiva tarpayed guhyayoginīḥūrdhvāmnāyakramaṃ caiva śrīvidyāvṛndapūjanamantaryāgaṃ cātmapūjāṃ cāntarhavanameva cadūtīyāge prayoktavyaṃ dūtīpātracatuṣṭayampañca vā ṣaṭ ca saptāṣṭau nava vā sthāpayedbudhaḥapavitraṃ karodbhraṣṭaṃ paśuspṛṣṭaṃ vivarjayetna kuryāt pātrasāṃkaryaṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥraśmicakraṃ ca deveśi nānyapātreṇa tarpayetpātraṃ yanna bhavet tatra prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣetrādhipasya pātreṇa kṣetrapālabalirbhavetmadhyadevyā baliṃ devi śrīpātreṇa visarjayetbalyādhārāṇi pātrāṇi śṛṇu vakṣye samāsataḥtrīṇi vai kurukullāyā vaṭukādeścatuṣṭyamrājarājeśvarasyaikamekaṃ devyāstataḥ paramityaṣṭādaśa pātrāṇi sarvavighnaharāṇi capūjādravyasya racanadravyārthaṃ caikapātrakammanoharāṇi pātrāṇi sthāpayet pūjayedapiekaṃ prasthajalāgrāhi ekaṃ tarpaṇapātrakamtadeva ravipūjāyāṃ sāmānyārghyaṃ bhavet priyedukūlavastrasaṃvītaṃ bṛhadādhārasaṃyutamsvavāmāgrāt tataḥ sthāpyaṃ devyā dakṣiṇabhāgataḥpañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ pañcabhaṅgadalānvitamsthāpayedavraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ varuṇaṃ tatra vinyasetgajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamahradagokulātsnānārthaṃ vinyaset tatra yajamānaśca dharmavitāyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥkāñcanaṃ ghṛtagodhūmān dūrvārocanayā sahaviśeṣārghyādipātreṣu śrīpātreṣu viśeṣataḥskando bhānurmātṛgaṇā dikpālāśca navagrahāḥṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ kumbhaṃ vistāronnatiśālinamarghyasya trīṇi pātrāṇi pādyasyāpi trayaṃ bhavetdaśavarṣasahasrāṇi durgāloke mahīyatetilā siddhārthakāścaiva aṣṭāṅgārghyaḥ prakīrtitaḥdevyai tadā mahārāja agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raupyapātreṇa dattvā vai viṣṇuyāgaphalaṃ labhetdattvā sauvarṇapātreṇa labhedbahuḥ suvarṇakampañcāyatanapūjāyāṃ daśa pātrāṇi vai kṣipetbalipātrāṇi pañca syuḥ rudhirasyaikapātrakamekaṃ pakvasya māṃsasya --------------------------------sthāpanīyāni yatnena yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥyoginīnāṃ samarcāyāṃ pañcāśanmithunārcanegurumaṇḍalapūjāyāṃ dineśānāṃ tathaiva caakṣarauṣadhipūjāyāṃ japamālāprapūjanearghyādipañcapātrāṇi sampādyāni pṛthak pṛthakcarusthālīdvayaṃ caiva praṇītā prokṣaṇī tathāmukhyānyetāni pātrāṇi -------------------------------vṛttena veṣṭitaṃ bāhye caturasreṇa caiva higandhalipte svavāmāgre vidadhyānmatsyamudrayāaṅgāni caturasrasya koṇeṣu puratastathāmūlena kṣālitaṃ śaṅkhādhāraṃ saṃsthāpayāmivahnyante maṇḍalāyeti tathā dharmapradeti cavahnerdaśa kalāstatra prādakṣiṇyena pūjayettasmād vidhivadādhāraṃ kalpayet kulanāyikeathavā vartulākāraṃ kuryād devi manoharamsuśrīḥ svarūpā kapilā havyakavyavahe tathāśaṅkhamānaṃ tu prādeśaṃ caturaṃgulamucchritamahamarthapradāyeti vadeta dvādaśetyapianena śaṅkhamabhyarcya kalāḥ sūryasya pūjayetsuṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vilomāṃ pūjayettatra pūjako manunāmunātoyaiḥ sugandhipuṣpāḍhyai pūjayettaṃ yathāvidhiṣoḍaśānte kalāśabdamātmane nama ityathaśaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadāsomamaṇḍalamadhyasthāḥ -----------------------------------saṃyojya netramantreṇa puṣpaṃ nyasya śikhāṇunāamṛtīkṛtya vidhivat sudhābījena sādhakaḥaṅganyāsena cāstreṇa kalayecca diśo daśaavaṣṭabhya (guṇṭhya) taduddipya mudrayā yonirūpayāṣaḍaṅgāni ca sampūjya mantrayenmūlamantrataḥmadhuparkaṃ ca saṃsthāpya trikoṇeṣu yathākramamtadāpyate yadā tena madhuparkaḥ sadā smṛtaḥkiñcidarghyāmbu saṃgṛhya prokṣaṇyambhasi nikṣipetdūrvā ceti kramādarghyadravyāṣṭakamudīritamājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrakedāpayet prokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ praṇavena cajātīkakkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakamsarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinīmaṇḍale sthāpayet kumbhaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathāāyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥnarmade sindhukāveri jale'smin sannidhiṃ kurumūle tasya sthito brahmā madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvaṇaḥkacodbhavāṃ | brahmahatyāṃ tena te nāśayāmyahamamābījamaye devi śukraśāpādvimucyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tena satyena me devi brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatucarukaṃ ca manohari śarkarādyaiśca pūritametāni pañcadravyāṇi tridhā saṃśodhayettataḥsaṃvitprayogaḥ kartavyaḥ pūjādau sādhakottamaiḥbhairavāṇāṃ ca tṛptyarthaṃ pavitrā bhava sarvadārājaputravaśaṅkāri śatrukaṇṭhatriśūliniānandādyāhutiṃ matvā samyajjñānaṃ prayaccha metrailokyavijaye mātaḥ samādhiphaladā bhavasatakraṃ vaṭakaṃ vāpi saṃgṛhya ca vicakṣaṇaḥsauvīreṇāthavā kuryādetatkarma na lopayetādhāya pūjayeddevīmanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetlaśunaṃ ca maheśāni dvitīyapratinidhau smṛtamkareṇācchādya dakṣeṇa kumārīṃ tripureśvarīmsamaṣṭividyayā devi bhogapātre'bhimantraṇamṣaḍaṅgayuvatīmantrairaṅgapātraṃ sakṛtsakṛtguhyapātraṃ tu kuṇḍanyā bījena parameśvariātmāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa cātmapātraṃ maheśvarikūmāryaiva maheśāni dūtīpātracatuṣṭayamdaśadhā japapūjābhyāmarghyaṃ saṃsādhyapūjayetnikṣipettena pūjāyāṃ devyāḥ saṃmīlanena caanyāni siddhadravyāṇi pratyahaṃ śodhayedbudhaḥmalayotthaṃ mahādevi svayambhūkusumaṃ tathāpṛthakpṛthak saptavāraṃ hastaṃ dattvābhimantrayetviṣṇuryoniṃ trayeṇaiva tribhiṣṭvāditrayeṇa caśroṇāmeketi caikena śukraśāpaṃ vimocayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sutaḥrakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam | druṇā sadhasthamāsadatvarivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ | parṣi rādho maghonāmabhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā | abhi vājamuta śravaḥāsiñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu tegarbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajāagne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥviśvedevāḥ punīta māṃ jātavedaḥ punīhi mānavamaḥ śvāsaḥbalādvā yatnato vāpi abhiṣekaṃ samācaretnamaḥśabdaṃ samuccāryaṃ imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadetvahnijāyāṃ samuccārya śuddhimantraḥ sureśvarikuṇḍagolodbhavaṃ dravyaṃ svayambhūkusumaṃ tathāsudhayā cārghyadānena yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥkevalaiḥ pañcamairvāpi siddho bhavati sādhakaḥkālāgnirudramādhāraśaktiṃ kūrmamanantakampadmaṃ ca karṇikāṃ caiva maṇḍalaṃ samarcayetanaiśvaryamavairāgyamadharmamapi pūjayetgandhapuṣpākṣatādīni dattvā tatra nidhāpayetpūjayecca tatastasyāṃ pañca kāmān samāhitaḥarcayitvā caturdikṣu pūjayet kulanāyakamblūmātmakaṃ tato dattvā ādhāraśaktimuddharetmahāpretāsanaṃ madhye bālāṃ ca pūjayettataḥtrikoṇeṣu tu sampūjya basantaṃ madanaṃ priyedurgāṃ bhruvostathā lakṣmīṃ rasanāyāṃ sarasvatīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādāntaṃ pūjayet sarvāḥ kalā vai kāmasomayoḥekā tu vāhikā cāndrī saurī cānyā tu vāhikāambu sravati cāndrī sā puṣpaṃ sravati bhānavīvāgbhavādyairnamoyuktaiḥ pūjayet suprasannadhīḥbhagamālāmanuṃ procya tritārānantaraṃ tathāsarvāṇīti bhagānīti vaśamānaya me tataḥihāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīvanyāso maheśvariiṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetmūlamantraṃ tataḥ oṃ namo śivāya tataḥ paramtāraṃ ca śāntyatītāṃ ca tadaṅge tadanantaramvajreśvarīṃ kālikāṃ ca tathā dikcaravāsinīmtadanujñāṃ tato labdhvā dattvā tāmbūlameva cadharmādharmahavirdīpte ātmāgnau manasā srucāsvāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantra ārambhe parikīrtitaḥprakāśākāśahastābhyāmavalambyonmanīsrucāsvāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ śukratyāge prakīrtitaḥsītkāro mantrarūpaṃ ca vacanaṃ stavanaṃ bhavetnakhadantakṣatādīni puṣpāṇi vividhāni cadarśanasparśane yonervikāraṃ (so) liṅgagharṣaṇamkulāmṛtaṃ prayatnena gṛhṇīyāddurlabhaṃ naraḥyatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tat kṣaṇādeva siddhyatibījāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma japannikṣipya sundariśrīvidyākramamabhyarcya parabrahmamayo bhavetsavikalpastu satataṃ pāpabhāgjāyate naraḥata eva varārohe nirvikalpaḥ sadā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadarghyeṇa samārādhya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayetdevi padaṃ śukraśāpaṃ pramocaya padadvayamsvāhāpadaṃ tato devi śukraśuddhirbhavet priyearghyadravyaiśca deveśi yonau devīṃ prapūjayetvidhāya vanditāṃ tāṃ ca taducchiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ caretghoraṃ ca narakaṃ yāti kulamārgāt pateddhruvamānandaṃ kārayedvīrastattvaṃ nirbhrāntitaḥ pibettataḥ padmanibhāṃ devīṃ bālārkakiraṇāruṇāmpadmarāgapratikāśāṃ kuṃkumodarasaṃnibhāmkālālikulasaṃkāśakuṭilālakapallavāmkiñcidardhendukuṭilalalāṭamṛdupaṭṭikāmānandamuditollolalīlāndolitalocanāmsugaṇḍamaṇḍalābhogajitendvamṛtamaṇḍalāmtāmravidrumavimbābharaktoṣṭhīmamṛtopapāmratnadvi(dī)pasamudbhāsijihvāṃ madhurabhāṣiṇīmanaupamyaguṇopetacibukoddeśaśobhitāmmaṇikaṅkaṇakeyurabhārakhinnaiḥ praśobhitāmkarāmbujanakhajyotirvitānitanabhastalāmtrivalīvalayāyuktamadhyadeśasuśobhitāmanargharatnaghaṭitakāñcīyuktanitambinīmkadalīlalitastambhasukumārorumīśvarīmgūḍhagulphapadadvandvaprapadājitakacchapāmbrahmaviṣṇuśiroratnanirghṛṣṭacaraṇāmbujāmśītāṃśuśatasaṅkāśakāntisantānahāsinīmraktavastraparīdhānāṃ pāśāṃkuśakarodyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca pañcabāṇadhanurdharāmmahāmṛgamadoddāmakuṃkumāruṇavigrahāmjagadāhlādajananīṃ jagadrañjanakāriṇīmsarvamantramayīṃ devīṃ sarvasaubhāgyasundarīmevaṃ dhyāyet pareśānīṃ mahātripurasundarīmtattatsthāneṣu devyaṅge gandhāmbhobhyaktapuṣpakaiḥlayāṅgametat saṃproktaṃ devatābhāvasiddhidambhogāṅgaṃ tatsamuddiṣṭaṃ devatāprītikārakamtrivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritātrivāraṃ prokṣayedevaṃ devaśuddhiritīritākartavyā siddhimicchadbhirdevatāprītikāriṇīsvacchādarśe yathā yantre tathaiva pratibimbitāḥsamaṣṭipūjā sā proktā vyaṣṭipūjā tathocyateśrīsundaryaṅgalīnāstāḥ santu sarvasukhāvahāḥbimbībhūtā vibhāvyaivaṃ tattatsthāneṣu deśikaḥsarvasaubhāgyajanīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi capradarśayedyonimudrāṃ tataḥ saṃprāthayed budhaḥanujñāṃ dehi deveśi parivārārcanāya mevahneḥ samastāvaraṇadevatā raśmirūpiṇaḥmanuścandraḥ kuberaśca lopāmudrā ca kāmarāṭdūrvāsāśca tathā śakraḥ unmanī varuṇastathāīśānaśca ratiścaiva tathā nārāyaṇastathāetairupāsitā vidyā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptikāḥpūjanīyāḥ prayatnena tāratrayapuṭāḥ kramātpūjayāmi namaścoktvā yajet pañcopacārakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cintanīyāḥ prayatnena sarvasaubhāgyadā budhaiḥanena kramayogena vidyāvṛndaṃ prapūjayetnivedayenmahādevyai tarpaṇādi samācaretvibhāvya ca mahātryasraṃ dakṣapūrvottarakramātpratipattithimārabhya paurṇamāsyantamadrijekṛṣṇapakṣe vicitrādikāmeśvaryantameva hikāmeśvaryādikā nityā vicitrāntāḥ kramādyajettattadvidyāṃ samuccārya tāratritayasaṃpuṭāmnamaḥpadaṃ mahādevi sarvatrāyaṃ kramaḥ smṛtaḥnityaklinnā mahānityā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinītvaritā ca mahādevi tato vai kulasundarījvālāmālinyatha tataścitrā tripurasundarīpāśāṃkuśau dhanurbāṇān pustakaṃ cākṣamālikāmevaṃ kāmeśvarīṃ dhyāyed vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradāmnānābhūṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ trailokyākarṣaṇakṣamāmvaradaṃ cābhayaṃ caiva dadhatī viśvamātaramraktāṃ raktāṅgavasanāṃ candracūḍāṃ trilocanāmpāśāṃkuśau kapālaṃ ca mahābhītiharaṃ tathācandrakoṭipratīkāśāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravamindranīlasphuratkāntiṃ śikhivāhanaśobhitāmdadhatīṃ cintayed devīṃ bheruṇḍāṃ viṣanāśinīmpāśāṃkuśau svastikaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca varadābhayejapākusumasaṃkāśāṃ raktāṃśukavirājitāmpāśāṃkuśau kapālasthasudhāpānavighūrṇitāmdūrvāvarṇā trinetrāṃ ca mahāsiṃhāsanāsanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadhatīṃ cintayennityāṃ śivadūtīṃ parāṃ śivāmvṛṣalāhisumañjirāṃ phaṭāratnavibhūṣitāmtanumadhyāṃ pīnavṛttakucayugmāṃ varābhayeguñjāruṇāṃ nṛpāhīndrakeyūrāṃ ratnabhūṣitāmnīlakuñcitadhamillavarapuṣpāṃ kapālinīmsphuratsiṃhāsanaprauḍhāṃ saṃsmaret tvaritāṃ budhaḥratnamaṇḍapamadhye tu mahākalpavanāntareanargharatnaghaṭitamukuṭāṃ ratnakuṇḍalāmhīramuktālasadbhūṣāṃ śuklakṣaumavirājitāmśubhāṅgarāgasubhagāṃ karpuraśakalojjvalāmvaradānaratāṃ divyāṃ mahāsārasvatapradāmśubhravastrāsanāṃ ramyāṃ candrakundasamadyutimanantamuktābharaṇāṃ sravantīmamṛtadravamudyadvidyullatākāntisvarṇāṃśukavirājitānariśaṅkhau khaḍgakheṭau triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathāśubhrāṅgī jñānadā nityāṃ vicitravasanāṃ sadāvaradābhayaśobhāḍhyāṃ nānāśastradharāṃ kvacitpāśāṃkuśau śarāṃścāpaṃ dhārayantīṃ śivāṃ śriyeprāṅmadhyayonyantarāle gurupaṃktitrayaṃ yajetaṃguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ ca gurūn samyak pratarpayetgurūn sampujayeddevi paramādigurūṃstathāguruśaktīryajed devi tataḥ śrīgurupādukāḥathādiśivanāthaśca jñānāmbā ca sadāśivaḥraudrī viṣṇustathā jyeṣṭhā brahmā vāmā parābhidhāḥsanātanaścāpi sanatkukārastu tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmadevastathā vyāsaḥ śukaḥ siddhaughasaṃjñakāḥbhāskaraśca mahādevi tatastasmānmahāśivaḥete sāmānyaguravaḥ śrīnāthādīn yajettataḥparaśaktiśca kauleśaḥ śukladevī kuleśvaraḥbhogaḥ klinnastu samayaḥ sahajo vedasaṃkhyakāḥvimalo madanaścaiva bhuvano līla eva cakāmarājākhyavidyāyā guravo'tra prakīrtitāḥgurubhyo nama ityuktvā pādukābhyo namo vadetparameṣṭhina ācāryāstato nijagurūn yajetdivyaughaśca mahaughaśca sarvākhyastadanantaramlopāmudrā prabhā māyā divyaścitrastathaiva camahodayaśca siddhaughāścidānandastathaiva cakamalaśca paraścaiva manohara iti kramātlopāmudrākhyavidyāyā guravaśca nijāstataḥkāmeśvarī ca mokṣaścāpyamṛtaḥ puruṣastataḥsiddhaugha uttamaścaite catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥparamākhyaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃjñaśca siddhakaḥśrīvidyāmātraguravastato nijagurukramātjñānamudrāsudhāpūrṇakapālāḍhyakaradvayāḥetān pañcopacāraistu yajet saṅghaṭṭamudrayāvasukoṇe tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥdakṣiṇāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca bhoginīṃ dakṣiṇe yajetuttarāmnāyeśvarīṃ ca kālikāmuttare yajetvarābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ śubhāḥāmnāyaṃ tu prapūjyātha samyagāyatanaṃ yajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brāhmyadarśanagāyatrīṃ pūrvāyatanadevatāmsauradarśanasūryaṃ ca paścimāyatanādhipamūrdhvāyatanaśaivākhyadarśaneśaṃ śivaṃ yajetśaktiṃ yajedbinducakre devatāḥ paricintayetpañcopacārairārādhya liṅgamudrāṃ pradarśayetbahirdaśāre pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥvārāhīti maheśāni pañcaratnaṃ prakīrtitammahāratneśvarīvṛndamaṇḍitāsanasaṃsthitāityuccārya yajettatra yonimudrāṃ pradarśayetpañcaratnaṃ prapūjyātha pañca kalpalatā yajetśrīvidyā tvaritā caiva pārijāteśvarī tathāpāśāṃkuśakarā raktā nijāyudhakaradvayāḥaṣṭapatre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥdvitīyā caitanyarūpā kāmeśī tadanantaramsiṃhāsanaṃ ca brahmākhyaṃ yajecca tadanantaramlalitābhairavī caiva kāmeśī bhairavī tathādakṣiṇe saṃsthitāścaiva yajet saubhāgyahetavemṛtasañjīvinī caiva mṛtyuñjayaparā tathāsiṃhāsanaṃ yajeddevi paścimāyāṃ diśi kramātkamaleśībhairavīṃ ca siddhakauleśabhairavīmkālikāmīśvarākhyaṃ ca yajet siṃhāsanaṃ budhaḥprathamā sundarī caiva dvitīyā sundarī tathāpañcamī sundarī caiva mahātripurasundarīvarābhayakarā raktāḥ pāśāṃkuśakarāḥ śubhāḥṣoḍaśāre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ajapā mātṛkā ceti pañca kośāḥ prakīrtitāḥcaturasre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥtriśaktiḥ sarvasāmrājyā lakṣmyaḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥpañca lakṣmīḥ pūjayitvā pañca kāmadughā yajetśrīvidyāmṛtapīṭheśī sudhāsūramṛteśvarīpāśāṃkuśasudhāpātrakalaśā raktavigrahāḥsthiticakre tu pūrvādi śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥvajravairocanī devī samayāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥsamayā pūjanānte tu ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yajetbindumadhye caturdikṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥsarvajñā nityatṛptā ca tathānādiprabodhinīnityānantā ca kathitā tathā bhogaṣaḍaṅgakevaradābhayadhāriṇyaḥ pradhānatanavaḥ striyaḥturīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vaiatra madhyavidhānīśe navāvṛttirathāmbiketurīyopāsakānāṃ ca etānyāvaśyakāni vaiudīcyāṃ prayajed devi kṣobhaṇadrāvaṇau tataḥagre saṃmohanaṃ yaṣṭvā cintayed bāṇadevatāḥantardaśāre deveśi pārśvayoragrayostathākāmamanmathakandarpamakaradhvajasaṃjñakāḥvarābhayakarā raktāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥsāmānyapātrasudhayā līnā vāgaparā parājñānamudrābhayāḥ śuklā vīṇāpustakapāṇayaḥagre ca bindumadhye ca sāmānyāmṛtabindubhiḥjāgratsvapnasuṣuptyaśca turīyā ca prakīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athāṣṭadalamūle ca vṛtte veṣṭanātha śivevāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī ambikecchā tathaiva cabhūcarī khecarī caiva jayā ca vijayā tathādalāṣṭamūlavṛtte tu vāmādyā divyabhūṣaṇāḥmuktācchatraṃ śaraccandracandrikāramyācamaraiḥprāntamuktāvalīrājatsvarṇādarśaṃ ca pīṭhikāmnavaratnasphuraddīptiṃ tāmbūlasya karaṇḍakamcaṣakaṃ svarṇaracitaṃ sudhākumbhaṃ kamaṇḍalumpūrṇaṃ ratnamayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kaṅkatīṃ gajadantajāmtataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjamūlavṛtte maheśvarividadhyādbhāvacinmāyānāthecchātuṣṭipuṣṭayaḥkriyātmajñānalokāśca devavedau tathaiva caśabdavarṇasvarāścaiva vargasaṃyogamantrakāḥṣoḍaśāramūlavṛtte raktā bhāvādiraśmayaḥtataḥ ṣoḍaśapatrābjabāhye prathamavṛttakeḍākinī rākiṇī caiva lākinī kākinī tathāṣoḍaśārabāhyavṛtte yoginyo ḍākinīmukhāḥmuṇḍamālāsamāyuktā daṃṣṭrābhīmamukhāmbujāḥmadhyavṛtte veṣṭanatve sāmānyasudhayā śivemahābhairavyatha siṃhabhairavī dhūmrabhairavīmohanākhyā bhairavīti bhairavyaḥ kathitāḥ priyepāśāṃkuśakarā bhīmāḥ kapālaśūlapāṇayaḥtataḥ sāmānyasudhayā bhairavān daśa pūjayetagnijihva ca kālāntaṃ karālaṃ caikapādakamṣoḍaśārāntyavṛtte tu herukādyā daśa sthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: meghaśyāmāḥ śavārūḍhāḥ kapāladaṇḍadhāriṇaḥśṛṇu vakṣye mahādevi navāvaraṇapūjanamtatastrikoṇaṃ cāṣṭāraṃ daśāraṃ ca daśārakambaindavādaṣṭakoṇāntaṃ sarvamadhyamidaṃ bhavetvasupatraṃ kalāpatraṃ caturasraṃ kramāt priyecatuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasāmvinā gurūpadeśena sādhakaṃ bhakṣayanti hisāmānyapātrasudhayā pūjayet siddhidevatāḥdvāreṣu vāyukoṇādikoṇeṣu hyadha ūrdhvataḥaṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā garimā tathāicchā prāptiḥ sarvakāmā mokṣasiddhiḥ kramāt priyemahābharaṇaratnāni sasuvarṇāni vai nidhīntrailokyamohane cakre madhyarekhāsamāśritāḥpāśāṃkuśābhayavarakarāḥ prakaṭarūpakāḥpūrvadvārādidvāreṣu śucikoṇādiṣu kramātvārāhyaindrī ca cāmuṇḍā mahālakṣmīḥ kramāt priyekapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭa bhairavāḥcohārapīṭhaṃ deveśi jālandharamataḥ parammātaro bhairavāṅkasthāḥ smeravaktrāḥ madālasāḥpāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ krameṇa dadhatīṃḥ smaretvajravaidūryamālāṃ ca padmaṃ ca varadaṃ tathāśūlaṃ kapālaṃ pretaṃ ca bibhrāṇāḥ kṣudradundubhimpāśāṃkuśavarābhītikarāḥ pīṭhāṣṭadevatāḥevaṃ tṛtīyarekhāyāṃ siddhivat pūjayet priyesarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvonmādinikā caiva tataḥ sarvamahāṃkuśāsarvayonistataḥ sarvatrikhaṇḍā parikīrtitāghṛtapāśāṃkuśāḥ sarvāḥ svasvamudrākarāstathāpāśāṃkuśotpalābhītipāṇayo raktavigrahāḥaṇimāsiddhipurataścakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajetetāḥ prakaṭayoginyaścaturasre vyavasthitāḥsavāhanāśca saparivārāścaiva sasiddhayaḥtarpitāḥ santviti vadejjalaṃ tatra viniḥkṣipetbhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ prathamāvaraṇarcanamiti te kathitaṃ bhadre prathamāvaraṇārcanamtataḥ ṣoḍaśapatreṣu kāmākarṣiṇikāṃ yajetkāmākarṣiṇikā caiva buddhyākarṣiṇikā tathāsparśākarṣiṇikā caiva rūpākarṣiṇikā tathācittākarṣiṇikā caiva dhairyākarṣiṇikā tathābījākarṣiṇikā caivāmṛtākarṣiṇikā tathāsarvāśāpūrake cakre dalaṣoḍaśake sthitāḥkalāṣoḍaśarūpāśca candramaṇḍalamadhyagāḥpāśāṃkuśa(dharāḥ)sudhāpūrṇakāśmarīghaṭadānandāḥ (?)yajedvidrāviṇīṃ mudrāṃ darśayedbhāgyahetavecakre samudrā ityādi devyai puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipetbhaktyā samarpaye tubhyaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇārcanamsarvasaṃkṣobhaṇe cakre dalāṣṭakavijṛmbhitepūrvādidikṣu patreṣu āgneyādividikṣu caanaṅgamadanā paścādanaṅgamadanāturāanaṅgamālinī hyetā bandhūkakusumaprabhāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anaṅgakusumāgre tu yajet tripurasundarīmetāguptatarāścaiva yoginyaḥ sarvasaṃ tataḥdevyai puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyādabhīṣṭheti ca mantravitsāmānyādbhiḥ paścimādivāmāvartakrameṇa casarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī śaktiḥ sarvavidrāviṇī tathāsarvasammohinī sarvastambhinī sarvajṛmbhiṇītataḥ sarvonmādinī ca tathā sarvārthasādhinīsarvamantramayī śaktiḥ sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarīsampradāyākhyayoginyaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥpāśāṃkuśau darpaṇaṃ ca pānapātraṃ sudhāmayamsarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīpūrve yajet tripuravāsinīmtata etāḥ sampradāyayoginya iti vai kramātbahirdaśārake cakre sāmānyasudhayā śivesarvasiddhipradā devī sarvasampatpradā tathāsarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocinīsarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinīsarvasiddhipradādyāśca yoginyaḥ sarvakāmadāḥmahāsaubhāgyagambhīrāḥ pīnavṛttaghanastanāḥnānāratnamayān dīpān dadhatyo hasitānanāḥsarvasiddhipradāgre tu cakreśīṃ tripurāṃ yajetetāśca kulakaulākhyayoginya iti pūrvavatsarvarakṣākare cakre'ntardaśāre maheśvarisarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradā tathāsarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathāpūjanīyā prayatnena sarvepsitaphalapradā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvajñādyāśca yoginyo jvalatpāvakatejasaḥpāśaṭaṅkāyudhajñānamudrāvaradasatkarāḥdevyai saṃdarśayed devi mudrāṃ sarvamahāṃkuśāmcakre samudrā ityādi dadyāt puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥpaścimādi krameṇaiva vaśinyādyā yajet kramātjayinī sarveśvarī ca kaulinī vāgaghīśvarīyoginyaḥ kāmadāyinyau dāḍimīkusumaprabhāḥnānābharaṇasampannāḥ pañcabāṇadhanurdharāḥyajet tripurasiddhāṃ ca cakreśīṃ vaśinīpuraḥetā rahasyayoginya ityādi ca maheśvariantarāle mahācakre sarvasiddhipradābhidhekāmeśvarasya kāmeśyā jṛmbhakā bāṇadevatāḥstambhakākhyā mahādevi tathaivāṃkuśadevatāḥrudrātmaśaktisahitā kāmeśī sarvasiddhidāpīṭhe pūrṇagirau caivoḍḍīśanāthātmikā tataḥvajreśvarī mahādevī tatastṛtīyakoṇakeṣaṣṭheśanāthātmikā ca tathā suṣuptyadhiṣṭhitābindumadhye maheśāni kūṭatrayavijṛmbhitecaryānāthātmikā caiva turīyādhiṣṭhitā tataḥsarvasiddhiprade cakre yoginyaḥ siddhidāyikāḥkāmeśvarīmukhāstisraḥ koṇatrayavirājitāḥraktāḥ vidyullatākārā uddāmakusumānvitāḥvarābhaye sudhāpātraṃ dhārayantyaḥ sukhāvahāḥmuktāphalasphuradbhūṣā nānābharaṇabhūṣitādadhato cāgrakoṇasthā rudraśaktiḥ prikīrtitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bālārkavasanā nīlakarṇacumbivilocanādakṣakoṇasthitā devī viṣṇuśaktiriyaṃ matāanargharatnaghaṭitabhūṣaṇā bhuvaneśvarībrahmaśaktirmaheśānī tāpatrayanikṛntanīcakreśīṃ tripurāmbāṃ ca kāmeśīpurato yajetetā atirahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvavatbinducakre maheśāni sarvānandamayābhidhekūṭatrayakrameṇaiva ratiḥ pratirmanobhavāsarvamantreśvarī caiva sarvacakreśvarī tathāsarvabhogeśvarī caiva sarvavīreśvarī tathāsarvavidyeśvarī caiva sarvasiddheśvarī tathā(--------------------) sarvacakreśvarī tathā)parāpararahasyākhyā yoginya iti pūrvakāḥpāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvā jñānamudrābhaye tathāśrīvidyābhimukhāḥ sarvā devatāḥ paricintayetathavā raśmayaḥ sarvā devīrūpeṇa cintayetcakreśīṃ ratipūrve tu mahātripurabhairavīmparāpararahasyākhyā yoginītyādinā priyedaśamaḥ śvāsaḥṣoḍaśairupacāraistu sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ śivammahāṣoḍhotitāśeṣaparivārāṃśca śāmbhaviparāprāsādamantreṇa turīyāvidyayāthavāgurupātrāmṛtenaivāthavā śrīpātrabindubhiḥparamādiśivaśrī ca pādukāṃ tarpayāmi cabinducakre ca pūrvādicaturdikṣu ca madhyataḥ

sanskrit: īśatatpuruṣāghoravāmasadyādimūlakaiḥrudraśambhuparāṇāṃ ca viśrānticaraṇān yajetpūjanīyāḥ pratyatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhayeyogmaśaḥ pārśvayugmeṣu śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥghṛtapāśāṃkuśā raktā varadābhayapāṇayaḥcaturdikṣu tatho'rdhvādhaḥ śrīpātrāmṛtabindubhiḥīśānasya kalā iṣṭvā manvasre puruṣasya tuṣoḍaśacchadapadme tu vāmedevakalā yajetśrīcakrasthāntarāleṣu kesareṣu ca vai kramātmahāṣoḍoditāśeṣadevatāḥ paripūjayetitthaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāyātha ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥdadyāt karpūrasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ paraśaktayeyathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt stutiṃ ca parameśvariphalaṃ kalpalatānāṃ ca cāruratnasphuratkalamnityānandi paraṃ brahmadhāma naumi sukhāptayegandhena culukaṃ madhye mudrāṃ vā tatra vai nyasetbhrāmayedratnavidyābhistridhā bhṛtvā tu mastakevāmakarṇaviśobhāḍyā bindubhūṣitamastakāḥratneśvarī devatā syānmāyābījaṃ tu bījakamsvaprakāśe tu deveśi viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥārā(rti ? tri)kamidaṃ devi gṛhāṇa mama siddhayevahatpuṭena hastābhyāṃ maṇḍaloddhāralakṣaṇamtāraṃ ca bhuvaneśānīṃ vyāpakādi ca maṇḍalamannodamiśraṃ bhāgena sādhāraṃ puṣpapūjitamtāraṃ parāṃ sarvavighnakṛdbhyaḥ sarva ca bhū likhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvoktabalidānaṃ tu kuryādvighnopaśāntayetataḥ kumārīḥ santarpya tripureśyānayāthavākhecaryāḥ śakticakrasya svāminīṃ saṃvidaṃ parāmśivakoṇe deśikebhyo nirmālyaṃ siddhaye kṣipetnāmamantreṇa ca svasya tarpayedupadeśataḥpunarādhāragaṃ kuryādācāre dīpalakṣaṇamkapālinyā vāpi pātraṃ tayā vāpi samuddharettattvatrayeṇa saṃyogāttarpayet svāntavāsinīmtṛtīyamīśarūpaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ munisattamaiḥśrīgurorājñayā devi svayaṃ śrītripurā bhavetākṛṣya mantrāt tatrasthaṃ śiṣikābhyo'kṣatādikamanarghyamapi vijñeyamakṣaraiḥ kathitaṃ mayāgopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre jananījāragarbhavatsahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ hanti māsena deśikaḥavaśyaṃ sarvakāleṣu paramājñādharo bhavetsamudravalayāṃ pṛthvīṃ saṃprāpya sukhamedhatesa buddhimān bhaveddevi sarvatra vijayī bhavetsvayambhūbāṇadeśe vā śaivasthāne maheśvarimuktārudrākṣapadmākṣasphaṭikodbhavayā tathājaptvā lakṣaikamātre tu bhūcaryo vighnakārikāḥtadā lakṣatrayaṃ kuryānniyamena śucirbudhaḥmanasoccāraṇaṃ devi japakoṭiphalapradamvācikāt mukhapātraṃ syācchrīgurorājñayā priyekusumbhapuṣpairjuhuyānmadhuratrayasamplutaiḥyonikuṇḍe bhagākāre vartulendvardhayoḥ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vākpatiryonikuṇḍe tu bhage cākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetnavatrikoṇe mahatīkhecarīsiddhivān bhavetśāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ lakṣmīrārogyaṃ vasukoṇakemallikāmālatībhiśca trimadhvaktairvacaspatiḥyoṣidvaśyā tato devī karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ madamcāmpeyaiḥ pāṭalai ramyairāmrairanyaiḥ phalairhunetśrīkhaṇḍaṃ cāgaruṃ devi karpūraṃ gugguluṃ hunethutvā phalaṃ trimadhvaktaṃ khecaratvaṃ catuṣpatheathavā navalakṣa tu japedvidyāṃ samāhitaḥsādhayet svargabhūlokapātālatalavāsinaḥdadhnā śatāṣṭakaṃ hutvā kālamṛtyuṃ vināśayetmadhvājyaguggulenaiva rājendraṃ vaśamānayetmadhvājyāktai raktavarṇaiḥ karavīraiḥ saguggulaiḥmadhvaktakaravīraistu sāṅgaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśaṃ nayetpāṭalairyūthikākundaiḥ śatapatraiśca jātibhiḥpūjanāddhavanādvāpi miśrairvā'miśritairapimucukundairbilvapatreḥ phalairasitanīrajaiḥnārikelaiśca kharjūrairdrākṣābhiścūtasatphalaiḥpūjanena ca homena śrīvidyāṃ paritoṣayetpūrvoktabalidānena guruṃ santoṣya ca kramātsamagraṃ kusumaṃ home kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bahudhā hunetsamagreṇaiva cūtasya phalena badaraṃ tathājambūphalaṃ samagraṃ syāddrākṣāṃ caiva tathā hunetphalaṃ laghu samagraṃ syāt kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ śaśītathaiva lavaṇaṃ lājā muṣṭipātraṃ hunedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrṇaṃ tu kramukārdhena śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kramukākṛtikuṇḍasya pūjanaṃ vakṣye mahāvighnavināśanamkhātaṃ ca racayet kuṇḍaṃ sarvatra sumanoharamsarvatraikāṃgulaṃ tyaktvā tisraḥ kāryāḥ suśobhanāḥcaturaṃgulavistārāstisro'pi parameśvariravyaṃgulisuvistārāṃ vasvaṃgulisuvistṛtāmlakṣaṇaṃ caturasrasya kathitaṃ tava sundaritena mānena sarvāṇi kuṇḍāni racayed budhaḥdakṣiṇādyūttarāntaṃ tu tisrastisraśca kārayetśarkarāṃ vikirettatra trikoṇaṃ tatpuṭaṃ likhetuparyupari bhedena tatra pīṭhaṃ samarcayetādhāraśaktikūrmau ca tato'nantaṃ varāhakaṃpātrāṇi kesarāṇyevaṃ tattatsthāneṣu pūjayetadharmāścaiva koṇeṣu pīṭhasya paripūjayetmadhye ṛtumatīṃ vedamātaraṃ vedamasyakāmvahniṃ kuṇḍe paribhrāmya kiñcidaṅgārakaṃ tyajetpaścāt prajvālayedvahniṃ jñānāgneḥ saṃkrameṇa tuśvāsamārgeṇa manuvidyonimārgeṇa saṃkṣipetādau vyāhṛtibhiḥ paścādvahnimantreṇa ca kramātsarvajñājñāpaya svāhā manunā prārthayet tataḥsuvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ viśvatomukhamsaṣaśā valarāyaśca ramasvasvarayā(rayaṣaṣṭhasvarā)nvitāḥpadmarāgā suvarṇā ca tṛtīyā bhadralohitākrameṇa yojayedbījairvinyaset parameśvarisurāśca pitaraścaiva gandharvā yakṣapannagāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrārciḥ svastipūrṇaṃ uttiṣṭhapuruṣastathāṅahṛdantaiḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni tato mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ nyasetaśvodayaiścaturthaḥ syādvaiśvānara ume tataḥmūrdhāṃsapārśvakaṭyandhukaṭipārśvāsakeṣu caevaṃ vinyastadehaḥ san paryukṣyārghyajalena cavaiśvānara tato jātaveda paścādihāvahasvāhānto'ṇurayaṃ tāraṃ vaktre citpiṅgalo'pi camadhye ca koṇaṣaṭke ca tato'ṅgāni prapūjayetpunarvaiśvānaraṃ japtvā trinetramaruṇaprabhamvaraṃ śaktiṃ svastikaṃ cābhītiṃ hastaiśca vibhratamarghyodakena pātrāṇi prokṣayecchuddhaye tataḥpraṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalaṃ sthālyāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathāsrukpātre ca sruve pātre ghṛte puṣpaṃ vinikṣipetmekhalāsu ca sarvāsu veṣṭayeddīpamālikāḥbrahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya hunedvaiśvānarāṇunāanena vidhinābhyarcya śrīcakraṃ tatra cintayetsamastacakracakreśīsahitāṃ homayet tataḥsamastacakracakreśīḥ prakaṭādyāśca yoginīḥtataḥ pūrvoktasudravyairhomayet subhagāṃ parāmrudraraktā suvarṇā ca sarvakāmaphalāptayeuccāṭanaṃ ca dhūminyāṃ karālinyāṃ ca māraṇamkṛte vighnaughaśamanaṃ nānyathā varavarṇinivasukoṣṭhaṃ likhet kūrmaṃ madhye sthāne prakalpayetkādyā vargāstu saptaite pūrvādikramato likhetsthānākṣaraṃ yatra devi siddhistatra na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra śūnyaṃ phalaṃ madhyakoṣṭhayugmaṃ tu mṛtyudamrogahānikarau pucchaṃ tayormadhyagataṃ bhavettathaiva siddhirnānyatra śrīgurorājñayā priyedīpāvaso'pi kartavyaḥ kiṃ punarhavane yajetsvabhambhūkusumāktaiśca kusumairakṣatairyajetgāyatrī samyaguccārya tadante'pyamukaṃ tataḥtataścāmukadevīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi casaptāhābhyantare mantrī vāṃchitaṃ samavāpnuyāttattadbhūtārṇakiraṇairvṛtāścakrasthadevatāḥevaṃ saṃsiddhavidyāyā viniyogakrama śṛṇusādhyapratikṛtiṃ nāma lekhanyaikāṃ śubhāṃ tataḥtyaktvā lajjāṃ samāyāti hyathānyat kathyate priyeātmānaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ tathā saubhāgyasundaraḥyasya nāmnā punaḥ samyak sa bhaveddāsa eva hiyonimudrādharo bhūtvā vegādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetgorocanākuṃkumābhyāṃ samabhāgaṃ ca candanampuṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gandhaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇamaṅganā vīkṣaṇādeva dāsī cāsya bhavet priyecintayan māsamātraṃ hi sādhyākhyāṃ lalanāṃ tataḥsindūraracite cakre rājānaṃ mohayet kṣaṇātcittāṅgāreṇa cakraṃ tu likhedraktadraveṇa hiarkanimbadravābhyāṃ tu likhinyārkasya saṃlikhetdhūpayeccandanaṃ rātrau vastraṃ vā dhārayet tataḥliptagomayabhūmau tu likhedrocanayā tataḥtadbhālagalahṛnnābhijanmamaṇdalayojitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāṅgasandhisaṃlīnaṃ kāmakūṭaṃ samālikhetkṣobhiṇībījamudrābhyāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japetsānurāgātivimalā kāmasāyakapīḍitāathavā mātṛkācakraṃ bāhyaṃ saṃveṣṭya mantravitavadhyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥsvanāma kramato lekhyaṃ pūrvavanmātṛkāṃ likhetanenaiva prakāreṇa rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥtrailokyamohano mantrī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥsādhyanāmnastrikoṇāntarmātṛkāṃ veṣṭayedbahiḥlokapālāśca rājāno duṣṭāstrailokyasaṃsthitāḥanena vidhinā nāma purīṃ sandarbhya saṃkṣipettasya saubhāgyamāyāti rājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ sadācakrāntaścintayennityaṃ māsaṣaṭkaṃ tato naraḥdṛṣṭyākarṣayate lokān viṣaṃ nāśayati jvarānrātrau sindūralikhitaṃ pūjayedekacittataḥakhaṇḍaṃ dikṣu koṇeṣu krameṇa paripūjayetbhūrjapatre likheccakraṃ rocanāgurukuṃkumaiḥmaṇḍalaṃ viṣamasthānaṃ bhūmau cakraṃ nidhāpayetunmattarasalākṣārkakṣīrakuṃkumarocanāḥyannāma tasya deveśi caurajaṃ vyāghrajaṃ bhayamahijaṃ vājijaṃ vāsti sarvān mohayati kṣaṇāttrikoṇobhayagāṃ caiva sādhyanāmāṅkitāmadhaḥpītadravyeṇa cakrānte likhedvidyāmadhastataḥtasmādbrahmāpi jīvo'pi sarvajño mūkatāṃ vrajetdakṣiṇābhimukho mantrī vahnau dagdhvā ripūn dahet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āranālasthitaṃ kuryādbhavedvidveṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇātsaṃlikhya rocanādravyairākāśe dṛṣṭigaṃ yathāmahānīlīrasodbhinnarocanādugdhamiśritaiḥanena vidhinā nīre sthāpayet tajjalena tupītaṃ cakraṃ yajet pūrve stambhayet sarvavādinaḥpaścime pūjitaṃ cakraṃ gairikālikhitaṃ tataḥtathaiva dakṣiṇāsyastu kṛṣṇaṃ cakraṃ samarcayetkramāddigantarāsyaḥ san vahnikoṇādiṣu kramātdugdhe vaśyakaraṃ kṣiptaṃ rocanālikhitaṃ haṭhātgomūtramadhyagaṃ caitadbhaveduccāṭanaṃ ripoḥsindūreṇa likheccakraṃ nirjane tu catuṣpathekulācārakrameṇaiva rātrau sampūjayet kramamcaturdaśyāṃ niśi svastho rudrabhūmau prapūjayetañjanaṃ vivaraṃ siddhiṃ guṭikāṃ pādukāñjanamsakalaṃ siddhijananaṃ mantrī prāpnoti nānyathāekaviṃśatirātraṃ tu niśi pretasthito jalepāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇaiḥ pauruṣeyairmaheśvarihartā kartā svayaṃ caiva mahadākarṣaṇaṃ bhavetpuruṣākarṣaṇaṃ caitadrājānaḥ kiṅkarāḥ priyevāgbhavārādhane devi jñānaṃ sārasvataṃ bhavetanena vidhinā devi vāgbhavārādhanaṃ bhavetkāmamanmathakandarpā makaradhvaja eva cakāmaṃ manmathamadhyasthaṃ devi kandarpaveśmagamanena kāmatattvena mohayejjagatīmimāmtasmāt kuṇḍalinī śaktiḥ śaktikūṭe maheśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuṣṣaṣṭiryataḥ koṭyo yoginīnāṃ mahaujasāmtato vāgbhavakūṭaṃ ca yadadyakacca vṛtrahanśaktikūṭaṃ samālikhya sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśetataḥ sarvajanaṃ me'nte vaśamānaya ṭhadvayamsarvavaśyakaraḥ puṃsāmāyurārogyasiddhidaḥardhaṃ saṃvādasūktasya punarardhaṃ kramāllikhetpratyahaṃ japataḥ puṃso yathāśakti viśeṣataḥkubera iva vittāḍhyo jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥṛkpañcakaṃ samākhyātaṃ mahāsārasvatapradamvavasvidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāmadhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaituḥmanuṣyā vadantideveṣvamṛtamajuryampalastijamadagnayo dadhuḥsundarī garbhagaṃ japyāt pṛthakpṛthagatandritaḥbahuśrutaḥ śāstrakartā śrutān vedāgamānapisakalahrīṃ amṛtasya deva dhāraṇo bhūyāsammanasaḥ kāmamākūtiṃ sakalahrīṃ vācaḥ satyamaśīmahiśubhayā smṛtyā saṃyunavatucaturthī tvaṃ soma praceti pañcamī tu prajāpateyo narastasya niyataṃ dhanadhānyadharāsutaiḥlakṣmīṃ samāvahedramyāṃ putrapautrādigāminīmvayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇāmpatayo rayīṇāmsindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhīrāḥrayīṇāmdhanairdhānyaiśca vibhavairanyaiścāśvagavādibhiḥsampuṭīkṛtya japatāṃ phalānyācakṣmahe sphuṭamśrīsūktaiḥ kāmarājākhyāṃ prajapedyatnato budhaḥtṛtīyena caturthena vandhyādoṣavināśanamsaptamena tu garbhasya sthiratā hyaṣṭamena tudaśamena pareṇāpi puṣpadoṣān vināśayetpumapatyaṃ bhavatyeva caturbhistatparairdhruvamtṛtīyena bhaveddhānyaṃ caturthena mahīṃ labhetsaptamādrājasammānamaṣṭamena dhṛtiḥ sthirāekādaśena vastrāṇi dvādaśena sutāṁllabhetpṛthivīṃ śasyasampannāṃ śriyaṃ pañcadaśena tuśrīvidyāvṛndanivahastvevaṃ sampuṭito yadijāyante tatkramaṃ jñātvā gurutaḥ śāstrato'pi vādīkṣā tu ṣoḍaśārṇāyāḥ (ṣaḍdarśanavidhā bhavetcaturviṃśatihastaṃ tu maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥyonikuṇḍāni vā kuryādardhacandranibhāni vāaṣṭāstrāṇyathavācāryakuṇḍamīśendramadhyataḥhastamātraṃ parityajya kuṇḍānyanyāni kalpayetdīkṣāyāṃ ṣoḍaśārṇāyāṃ japahomeṣu ṛtvijāmnārāyaṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ varāhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathāpañcadaśyāṃ samāyojya jape home ca pārvatijātavedasapañcarcaṃ devīlakṣmyostu sūktakeprāsādaṃ vāpāśupataṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃjñakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saure tu ghṛṇimantraṃ ca ṣaḍarṇaṃ vedavarṇakamajapākhyaṃ tu śākte tu bālāmantraśca bhairavībhairavī tripurāmbā ca bauddhe padmāvatī tathāmātaṅgī sumukhī caiva caṇḍamātaṅginī tathāmūlavidyāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva dīkṣāyāṃ śrīgurormanoḥśambhoścaraṇavidye dve parāprasādasaṃjñakeekārṇaṃ gāṇapatye tu mahāgaṇapatiṃ tathālakṣmīgaṇapatiṃ caiva herambagaṇapaṃ tathādakṣiṇākālikāyāstu ekārṇaṃ tryarṇameva cadaśākṣaradvayaṃ caiva tārāyāṃ ṣoḍaśākṣarīśrīvākkāmaparāruddhā trividhā tripuṭā tathāṣaṭkūṭā saptakūṭā syādaṣṭakūṭā tu pañcamīpītāmbarāṣṭavārāhyo dīkṣāyāṃ tu parasparamjayākhyā ca navārṇā ca śāntyagnilavaṇātmikāpañcāyatanabhedaistu saure śākte ca vaiṣṇavevaiṣṇavāṣṭakamadhye tu hitvā svāṣṭadaśākṣaramśaive pāśupataṃ hitvā tatra traiyambakaṃ kṣipetgāṇapatye gaṇānāṃ tvā hitvocchiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśvarametadāyatanānāṃ cāpyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparamṣaṭśāmbhavopadeśe tu hyaṅgāṅgitvaṃ parasparamsiddhalakṣmī rājyalakṣmīrvānyadbhedatrayaṃ punaḥanyavidyāsu mantreṣu tattadbhedaiḥ parasparampañcāyatanadīkṣāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥmahāgaṇeśamantreṇa ghṛṇimantreṇa saṃyutāsaṃyojya ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ japapūjanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mandasmitalasaddantamarīcidyotitānanāḥjalpākapuṃskokilodyaddevavṛndaṃ nirantramsuśroṇibhārādatyarthamandagāminya uttamāḥmārasenāpatiriva vanalakṣmyā gṛhaṃ yathāindirāyāḥ sodarasya navaratnamayasya casvarṇakuṭṭimasaṃśobhimahāratnamanorameprasiddhavikramaughasya pakṣirājasya copariratnodyanmakarākāracārukuṇḍalamaṇḍitamśaśikhaṇḍalasacchubhrakḷptāmalaviśeṣakamsmitasaṃśobhivaktrendukapolaphalakojjvalampakvabimbādharaṃ ramyaraktapadmapalāśavaturuhāramaṇivrātadīdhitiprollasadgalamgadākamalaśaṅkhāridhāriṇaṃ bāhudaṇḍakaiḥlasatkaustubhadīptyoghavidyotitatalena catrivalīśobhinā samyagromarājilasadrucāpītapaṭṭāṃśukarucā vilasanmaṇimekhalamkekikaṇṭhalasatkāntijaṅghāyugamanoharamśaśaraktasadṛkkāntidhvajābjāṅkitapattalamkṣamayā copagūḍhaṃ ca navamāṇikyaśobhitamsurāsurarṣipramukhaiḥ sevitaṃ cāpsarogaṇaiḥsurayopākarābjālilasaccāmararājitamyakṣavidyādharavyūhacāraṇādiniṣevitamkṛśānūpamajyotiṣā grastadaityaṃ śiraḥśobhidaṃṣṭrāsudīptadvijihvamveṇumādāya hastābhyāṃ vādayantaṃ mudānvitamnamo hasakahalahrīṃ nārāyaṇāya sakalahrīṃ

sanskrit: kheṭacāpau kuṇḍikāṃ ca triśūlaṃ brahmadaṇḍayuknānābharaṇasandīptaṃ pannagendrairalaṃkṛtamnamāmiśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ śubhrapadmāsanasthitamabhiṣiktasamastāṅgamarkendvanalalocanamakṣamālāṃ ca vāmordhve pāśaṃ vedamadhaḥkarehṛṣṭaṃ vyāptaṃ kalābhirdhṛtakapilajaṭaṃ bhāvaye'haṃ maheśammāṇikyamauliṃ dinanāthamīḍaṃ bandhūkakāntiṃ vilasattrinetrambandhūkābhaṃ trinetraṃ ca raviṃ dhyāyet subhūṣitamrviśvaṃ dyotayadārkamāśvaśiśiraṃ viśveśikāyā vapuḥhastaiścābhīṣṭadaṃ śaṅkhacakrapadmadharaṃ vibhumnānāratnasamopetaṃ ṛṣisaṃkhyāśvaśobhitamsāvitryā caiva gāyatryā sarasvatyā ca śobhitambrahmarandhrasphuradbhinnamuktālekhāvirājitāmviśuddhamuktābindvāḍhyacandrarekhākirīṭinīmsūryabhāsvanmahāratnakuṇḍalālaṃkṛtāṃ parāmkaṅkaṇādilasadbhūṣāmaṇibandhalasatprabhāmvajravaiḍūryamuktālimekhalāṃ vimalaprabhāmnakṣatramālāsaṅkāśamuktāma~jīramaṇḍitāmabhayaṃ ca prayacchantīṃ sādhakāya varānanedadhatīṃ cintayeddevīṃ vaśyasaubhāgyavākpradāmjapākusumasaṅkāśāmaruṇāmbarabhūṣaṇāmviśvasaundaryasarvasvaviśvasāgararūpiṇīmbrahmābjanetrarudreśaśivākhyairmuṇḍasaṃjñakaiḥpustakālaṃkṛtakarāṃ varadābhayadhāriṇīm

sanskrit: mukuṭordhvalasaccandrarekhāṃ raktāmbarāñcitāmvaradābhayahastāḍhyāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmnānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ sarvavairinikṛntanīmtriśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭakameva capustakaṃ ca cākṣamālāṃ ca śavasiṃhāsanasthitāmjapākusumasaṅkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumaprabhāmnānālaṅkārasubhagāṃ pīnonnataghanastanīmpāśāṃkuśavarābhītirdadhānāṃ ca śivāṃ śrayeābibhratīmābharaṇāni raktāṃ padmāvatīṃ padmamukhīṃ namāmimāptairnāgavarairvibhūṣitatanumāraktanetratrayāmtārāṃ śāvahṛdāvasanāṃ dṛḍhakucāmambāṃ trilokyāḥ smaretamṛtodadhimadhyasthe ratnadvīpe manoramekadambabilvakadvāri kalpavṛkṣopaśobhiteaṣṭapatraṃ mahāpadmaṃ kesarāntaḥsakarṇikampunaḥ ṣoḍaśapatraṃ syāttadbāhye syāccaturdalamtasya madhye sukhāsīnāṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ śucismitāmpralambālakasaṃyuktāṃ candrarekhāvataṃsitāmkiñcitsvedāmbumadhuralalāṭaphalakojjvalāmsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā muktāhāravibhūṣitāmvalayai ratnakhacitaiḥ keyurairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥāpīnamaṇḍalābhogasamunnatapayodharāmtamālanīlāṃ taruṇīṃ madhumattāṃ mataṅginīmkoṭibālārkasaṅkāśāṃ japākusumasannibhāmkarasphuritavallakīṃ vimalaśaṅkhatāṭaṅkinīmmākīrṇālakaveṇimabjajanayanāṃ dhyāyecchukaśyāmalām

sanskrit: vighneśaḥ phaṇibhūṣaṇo gaṇapatirbhūyādbhavadbhūtayesārdhendu prabhaje mahāgaṇapatiṃ netratrayodbhāsitamtadyonyāhitapāṇimāttavasumatpātrollasatpuṣkarammambhojodyatpuṭagatamamuṃ saṃsmaredvakratuṇḍamśliṣṭaḥ sauvarṇakāntyā gaṇapa iha mahāśrīkaro vaḥ śriye'stuṭaṅkāṅko modakaṃsyādradalasadabhaye dānamakaughadīptiḥiti kulayoginīmūlavidyāprāsādaparāyoginīmūlavidyāmohayamohaya klīṃ namaḥ svāhā iti rahasyayoginīmūlavidyāśāṃbhavīyoginīmūlavidyāhṛllekhāyoginīmūlavidyāsamayavimalāyoginīmūlavidyāparabodhinīyoginīmūlavidyā11 oṃ mokṣaṃ kuru iti pañcākṣarī yoginīmūlavidyā11 hasaiṃ hasakalahrīṃ hasauḥ lopāmudrācaitanyatripurāyoginīmūlavidyāparānandamayīśaktiḥ sauḥ ityanuttarakaulinīyoginīmūlavidyāgurūttamavimarśinīyoginīmūlavidyāanābhāsāyoginīmūlavidyā11 aiṃ iṃ īṃ ūṃ iti saṅketasāravidyāyoginīmūlavidyāaiṃblūṃraṃstrīṃ ityanuttaravāgvādinīyoginīmūlavidyā11 hasraiṃhasrīṃhasrauḥ ityanuttaravidyāyoginīmūlavidyāturīyāyoginīmūlavidyāaṅgatvena samākhyātā dvedve vidye samabhyasetvāruṇyau pāśimarutostatpare saumyadigbhavepītāmbarā bhoginī vā yāmyakuṇḍe praśasyate

sanskrit: bhavānī vāyukoṇe tu śyāmā tārā tu tatparecaturāmnāyavidyā vā prayojyāḥ parameśvaricidambaramahāmantraḥ pakṣirūpaśca śārabhaḥlakṣmījanārdano lakṣmīvāsudevastathaiva camārtaṇḍabhairavaścaiva mahāgaṇapatistathāgāṇapatyāḥ śriyā yuktāḥ sītārāmastathaiva capañcakāmāśca deveśi jainā bauddhāstathaiva caśivapañcākṣarībhedāḥ prāsādākhyāḥ śivāstathāgāṇapatye tathaikārṇabhedā ghṛṇimanustathāharidrāgaṇapaścaiva vaṭukāḥ kṣetrapālakāḥśrīkṛṣṇamantrabhedāśca dadhivāmanasaṃjñakāḥpuruṣottamasaṃjñāśca mālāmantrāstathaiva capaścimāmnāyavikhyātā dakṣiṇāmūrtireva cavetālāśceṭakāścaiva ye vai hariharātmakāḥuttarāmnāyavikhyātāḥ śīghrakālaphalapradāḥbhāsvadgaṇaśrīpatipārvatīśā vighneśvarārkādrisutā hariścaīśenavighnādhipaśaktikṛṣṇā madhyāgnikoṇakramatastu pūjyāḥgaṇeśārkāmbikeśānāstathā nārāyaṇārcanedevyarcane śivo vighnaḥ sūryo viṣṇustathaiva caāgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu sthāpyā aṅgāṅgibhāvataḥkṛtārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati śāmbhaviyantre sampūjitā devī sahasaiva prasīdatiyantramityāhuretasmin devaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥsarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tathā yantraṃ pratiṣṭhitamjñātvā gurumukhāt sarvaṃ pūjayedvidhinā śive

sanskrit: aṅgāṅgitvamapi tyaktvā devatāśāpamāpnuyātyajedāvaraṇopetān devāṁstattadvidhānataḥubhābhyāṃ labhate śāpaṃ mantrī cañcalamānasaḥvyaṅge'narhapaśuspṛṣṭe patite duṣṭabhūmiṣudaśasvapi ca no kuryuḥ sannidhānaṃ divaukasaḥdakṣiṇāśāmukho bhūtvā māraṇe pūjayetpriyeuttarābhimukho bhūtvā śāntikarmaṇi pūjayetnāryāḥ śaṅkaramārgato hi sukhadā vyastāstu te duḥkhadāḥliṅgapraṇālipuṣṭatvaṃ tāvadeva prakīrtitampañcasūtrasamāyuktaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ prapūjayetprāsāde tu tadūrdhvaṃ syāt pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥnāhaṃ tat triguṇaṃ kuryānnāhavat pīṭhavistṛtiḥvṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā madhye kaṇṭhasamanvitamtrimekhalamadhaścordhvaṃ samaṃ vāpi dvimekhalammekhalāmekabhāgena kuryāt khātaṃ ca tatsamamvistāraṃ tatsamaṃ mūle tadagraṃ ca tadardhataḥkuryāt pīṭhārdhaṃ dīrghaṃ vā praṇālaṃ śrīśivoditamlohādīnāṃ ca liṅgānāmidaṃ lakṣaṇamācaretekādaśaḥ śvāsaḥsauvarṇe rājate tāmre sphāṭike vaidrume tathākṛtvā cakrasya nirmāṇaṃ sthāpayet pūjayedapitāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣaṃ tadardhaṃ bhūrjapatraketeṣāṃ madhye sphāṭike tu sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavetsuvarṇaracitaṃ yantraṃ sarvarājavaśaṅkaramtāmraistu racitaṃ yantraṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃ matam
