sanskrit: māṇikyali(khya ? khi)taṃ yantraṃ rājyadaṃ bhuktidaṃ matamkḷptaṃ marakate yantraṃ sarvaśatruvināśanamtanme vadasva kṛpayā yadyahaṃ tava vallabhātāmrasya ravibhāgena pīṭha kuryānmanoharamśāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśatrunivarhaṇampātālavāsināṃ devi prastāro nimnarekhakaḥsvargalokādivāsānāṃ yantrāṇmerusaṃjñakaḥkramātsamunnataṃ sarvaṃ merurūpaṃ mayoditamnimnarekhāsamāyogādbhūprastāro mayoditaḥgopitavyaṃ tvayā bhadre svaguhyamiva santatamunnatonnatamāmadhyāccakraṃ syānnidhanaṃ dhanamekadviṣaṭkramonnāmaṃ śriyai kīrtye ca kalpatebhūcakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ cāpyaṣṭāraṃ ca samaṃ bhavetcaturasraṃ samaṃ devi ṣoḍaśārādibindukamcaturasraṃ samārabhya bindvantaṃ samarekhakamphalakāyāṃ paṭe bhittau sthāpayenna kadācanakulaṃ vittamapatyaṃ ca nirmūlayati sarvathāpalapramāṇaṃ kartavyamarcāpīṭhaṃ manoharamtasmin pīṭhe ca nirmāṇaṃ śrīcakrasya tu kārayetagniraṃgulavistāro yavārdhenocchritirbhavetsthitikrameṇa pūjā syāt sthiticakre maheśvaripratyekaṃ trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ tatsāṅkaryāt prayatnataḥunnatonnatamāmadhyaṃ vijñeyaṃ deśikottamaiḥsamordhvarekhānavakaṃ same pīṭhe ca yadbhavetsūkṣmarekhaṃ bhavettatra sthitisthityātmakaṃ śive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ardhaṃ kramādunnataṃ yaccaturasrāditastataḥvaiparītyena caitasya sthitisṛṣṭyātmatā bhavetkramonnataṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tu samaṃ syānnimnarekhakamlayasṛṣṭyātmakatvaṃ tu proktaṃ jñeyaṃ manīṣibhiḥlayasthityātmakaṃ proktaṃ vaiparītyena tasya tusthitisthityātmakaṃ cakraṃ praśastaṃ gṛhamedhināmsṛṣṭisthityātmakaṃ cakramaprajatvaṃ śriyaṃ labhetsthitisṛṣṭyātmakaṃ yantraṃ putrāyurdhanavṛddhidamanye proktāstu ye bhedāḥ śrīcakrasya maheśvaritasmāt sarvaprayatnena parīkṣyaiva samācaretsthiticakre tu sthityantā saṃhāre tu layāntatāprāptaṃ śrīguruṇā dattaṃ gurujyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhakaiḥpūjāṃ tatra prakurvīta sthityantāṃ parameśvaristhāne samatale ślakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā haṃsapadaṃ sudhīḥvṛttaṃ tu parito bhrāntvā tanmadhye sthāpayedbudhaḥṣaḍaṃgulaparīṇāhamūlaṃ śilpivareṇa tuśaṃkvagracchāyāsaṃpātasthānayościhnayugmakamdatvā vṛttāyatādhana sūtreṇecchādhikena vāvidhāya ca tayoḥ sandhidvayaprāpi prasārayetetasyārddhāṃśamānena kṛtvā koṇeṣu lāñchanamkṛtvā vṛtte tu yatra syācchāyāyāḥ parameśvaripraviṣṭanirgatācchāyā yadā tanmadhyanāḍikāḥantaraṃ dinayoriṣṭaiścaturādyairvibhāgataḥnāḍībhiḥ kalpitā bhāgā guṇanīyāḥ prayatnataḥprācīsūtraṃ pūrvabhāge uttare tūttarāyaṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cālyate cet sphuṭā sā syātprācī tu parameśvarivyāsārdhamāne śaṃkvardhaṃ sārdhe'sminkarṣaṇāya caśaṃkvaṅke'rvākśroṇirevamudagvyatyasya cāṃsakaudaṇḍayoragranaikaṭye'nyastiryamadhyacihnataḥmūladeśe lambasūtramaspṛśadbhāravadbhuvamskhalettatpūrayedanyannimnayedvāpi yuktitaḥbhānorgatyā diśo jñātvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet sudhīḥjyeṣṭhamadhyādhamatvena tanmānaṃ trividhaṃ matamhastairviṃśatibhiḥ kecinmānamuttamamūcireadhamaṃ daśabhirhastairmitamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥhastairmittaṃ vadantyeva vistārāyāmasaṃyutamdikṣu dvārāṇi catvāri sāṣṭāṃgulakaradvayāttato maṇḍapasūtraṃ tu triguṇaṃ parikalpayetiṣṭakābhirmṛdā vā sā kāryā darpaṇasannibhāte cottame tadardhoccā madhyamādhamayoḥ punaḥṛjavaḥ pañcahastāste saśikhāstu samantataḥsamāntarālāḥ sarve te sthāpyāḥ ṣoḍaśa deśikaiḥmadhyastambhacatuṣkāgrādekībhutāgrakaṃ punaḥśobhitaṃ kalaśenātha mukhasthena sudārujamācchādayettato vaṃśaiḥ kaṭaiḥ karadalaiśca tamaśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭotthaṃ toraṇaṃ nyasetviśālatā ca tasyātha daśabhistvaṃgulairmatāmadhyabhāge toraṇayostiryak kāṣṭhaṃ pravinyasetagnimīlītimantreṇa vinyaset pūrvatoraṇamagna āyeti mantreṇa paścimasya niveśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhve dhvajaṃ ca badhnīyāt ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitamtatastu lokapālānāṃ patākā bāhusammitāḥpītāraktaśyāmadhūmrāśvetadhūmrāsitārjunāḥyathāyogyaṃ daṇḍayutāstattanmantreṇa tānnyasetdukūlaveṣṭitastambhaṃ nānādīpādyalaṃkṛtamveṣṭitaṃ darbharajjvā ca vidadhyānmaṇḍapaṃ śubhamaṣṭottaraśatairhastaiḥ śatahastairathāpi vāṣaṣṭihastairaṣṭacatvāriṃśadbhirhastakaiḥ kramātcaturviṃśatihastairvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥtrikoṇamaṣṭapatrābhaṃ navakoṇaṃ dvikoṇakamdvādaśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ cāṣṭādaśaviṃśatikoṇakamdvātriṃśatkoṇakaṃ caiva ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṇakaṃ tathāśūrpakuntāsiśṛṅgāṭadhanurmudgarakākṛtiḥpūrṇābhiṣeke dīkṣāyāmabhiṣekādiśāntiṣukartavyāni viśeṣeṇa tattakarmaṇyatandritaiḥteṣu sūkṣmā visarpante reṇukāstrasareṇavaḥte'ṣṭau keśāhvayāste'ṣṭau likṣā yukāstadaṣṭakamsā tūttamāṃguliḥ saptayavā saiva tu madhyamāvinyastaistiryagaṣṭābhiryavairmānāntarāṃgulamācāryadakṣiṇakare madhyamāṃgulimadhyagamvināṃguṣṭhena śeṣābhirmuṣṭimaṃgulibhiḥ kṛtamyaṃ kaṃcitpauruṣāyāmaṃ vibhajya daśadhā punaḥdehalabdhāṃgulaṃ nāma jānīyāt tasya tatpunaḥmahāmānāṃguliriti mātrāṃgulirihocyatevedikāpīṭhaśivikārathādīnāṃ vidhiḥ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāgopakaraṇānāṃ ca kuryānmānāṃgulena vaidehalabdhāṃgulenaiva pratimāṅgāni kalpayetcatuṣkuṇḍī madhyame syātkaniṣṭhe'pyekakuṇḍakamśūle navāṃgulaṃ dairghya turīyāṃśena vistṛtiḥhīne caivaṃ samākhyātaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ ropayettathāprāgādikramayogena nyasetteṣāṃ svadārujamnavaikādaśabhāgaistāmiṣṭakābhiḥ prakalpayettato bhūmitale śuddha tuṣāṅgāravivarjitepañcibhaḥ saptabhirhastairnavabhirvā mitāntaramaṣṭahastasamucchrāyāḥ saṃsthāpyā dvādaśābhitaḥtatpañcamāṃśaṃ nikhanenmedinyāṃ tantravittamaḥdvāreṣu toraṇāni syuḥ kramāt kṣīramahīruhāmdaśāṃgulapramāṇena tatparīṇāha īritaḥśūlāni kalpayenmadhye toraṇe hastamānataḥvitānadarbhamālādyairalaṃkurvīta maṇḍapamcaturasrāṃ tato vedīṃ maṇḍalāya prakalpayetkṣetraṃ vibhajya madhyeṃ'śe pūrvādi parikalpayetcaturasraṃ yonimardhacandraṃ tryasraṃ ca vartulamācāryakuṇḍaṃ madhye syād gaurīpatimahendrayoḥsamantāt kuṇḍametat syāccaturasraṃ śubhāvahamcaturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcadhā vibhajet sudhīḥbhrāmayet koṇamānena tadānyadapi mantravitcaturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ daśadhā vibhajet punaḥjyāsūtraṃ pātayedagre tanmānādbhrāmayet tataḥcaturdhā bhedite kṣetre nyasedubhayapārśvayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūtratrayamadhaḥ kuryāt tryasraṃ kuṇḍamudāhṛtambhrāmayettena mānena vṛttaṃ kuṇḍamanuttamambhāgaṃ nyasedekamekaṃ mānenānena madhyataḥsūtraṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamuttamamekabhāgaṃ bahirnyasya bhrāmayettena vartulampadmakuṇḍamidaṃ proktaṃ vilocanamanoharambhāgamekaṃ bahirnyasya caturasraṃ prakalpayetbāhyasya caturasrasya koṇābhyāṃ parilāñchayetaṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍametaddhi tantravidbhirudīritamkṛtvā tatpūrvataḥ paścāddvādaśāṃgulamānataḥkuryāddhaṃsapadaṃ koṣṭhānyabhitasteṣu pātayetprākpratyakcihnamānena tayorevāvalambataḥprasārya sūtraṃ tasyāpi mārjayitvoktamānataḥpūrvataḥ paścimadvandvakoṣṭhayormadhyadeśataḥuttarāgrāvadhi tathā dakṣiṇāgrāvadhi priyevikāsitabrahmasūtrāvadhi sūtradvayaṃ bhavettasminnevānyakuṇḍāni vadāmi samamānataḥlabhyate sarvakuṇḍeṣu tena sarvāṇi sarvataḥśeṣāṃśāṃśakamānena tanmadhyādbhrāmayet tathāpratyekaṃ paścimaṃ sūtraṃ tanmānenātha sūtrayoḥtiryaksūtrādbahistena mānena bhramayettathātena mānena ca tathā kṛtvā vṛttamatisphuṭamtatra ṣaṭsūtrapātena bhavet kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍasrakamaṣṭamāṃśapramāṇena karkaṭena tu madhyataḥaṣṭamāṃśadvayenaiva madhyato vartulaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturthaṃ tu bhavet kṣetraṃ vyāsatulyena ca bhramāttasyaikaṃ bhāgamādāya bhaktvā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥbhāgamādāya tadbāhye pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śiveśāstroktavidhinā devi tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhettanmānaṃ karkaṭaṃ kṛtvā kesarāgre vidhāya calikhitvā kṛtihastena patrāgrāṇi samālikhetlikhenedavaśiṣṭaṃ tu kesarāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalampatrākārā yathā samyagjāyante parameśvarividhāya caturasra tu pūrvakoṇārdhamānataḥteṣu cihneṣu kṛtvāṣṭasūtrāṇi paritaḥ śivemānena parito bhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ yathā tataḥpātayet pañca sūtrāṇi tat syātpañcāsrakuṇḍakamtena mānena saṃbhrāntyā kṛtvā vṛttaṃ tathā tataḥvṛtte vidhāya cihnāni sapta sūtrāṇi pātayetbhogāḥ putrā yonikuṇḍe hyardhacandraṃ śubhāvahamripughātakaraṃ kecidvṛttaṃ śāntikaraṃ jaguḥvṛṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ vāpi padmakuṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥpañcakoṇaṃ cābhicāraśamane bhūtakṛntanecaturasraṃ vṛttamardhacandraṃ tryasramiti kramātnirmāṇaṃ sakalaṃ vakṣye yathāvidhi tavānaghevidadhyādvṛttakuṇḍāni cararāśicatuṣṭayevidadhyāccaturasrāṇiḥ tataḥ kuṇḍānyanukramātubhayātmasu kurvīta yonikuṇḍāni maṅgalesthireṣvapi trikoṇāni pareṣu tu catuṣṭayekulīrasiṃhāvatha tannir-ṛtyāṃ kanyakā tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nakrakumbhāvuttarato mīnamīśe tu saṃsthitamyāmyasaumyakarau kuṇḍamudaraṃ paścime tathāaratnimātraṃ tu śate sahasramitahomakecaturhastamitaṃ lakṣe ṣaṭkaraṃ daśalakṣaketathaikahastamārabhya daśahastaṃ vivarddhayetdvihastasya ca kuṇḍasya tato dvaiguṇyamiṣyateśatāni pañca vidyante tanmūlaṃ brahmasūtrakamaṃgulāni dvipañcāśadekādaśaśatāni cacatasraśca tathā yūkā yavāḥ sapta tathaiva casaptadaśaśatānyaṣṭāviṃśatistvaṃgulāni catanmūlamaṃgulānyekacatvāriṃśaccaturyavāḥcaturaṃgulayuktāni trayoviṃśacchatāni camūlaṃ tasyāṃgulānyaṣṭacatvāriṃśanmitaṃ bhavetdvisahasraṃ śatānyaṣṭāvaśītirbījamucyatetanmūlamaṣṭapañcāśadaṃgulāni ca ṣaḍyavāvedasaṃkhyāsahasrāṇi dvāviṃśatsahitāni cabrahmasūtraṃ tataścāṣṭahastakṣetrāṃgulāni caaṃgulāni tathā saptaṣaṣṭiḥ sapta yavāḥ punaḥśatāni tvekapañcāśaccaturbhiradhikāni cadvāsaptatiraṃgulāni mūlamasya prakīrtitamsahasrāṇīṣusaṃkhyāni munisaṃkhyaśatāni cavardhayet pañcasaptatyādhikaiḥ saptayavaistathāatiyatnaṃ samāsthāya kuṇḍānyāracayet sudhīḥprathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣatetrasareṇuraṣṭaguṇau rathareṇustu saṃsmṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bālāgrāṇyaṣṭa likṣā tu yūkā likṣāṣṭakaṃ smṛtamratniraṃguliparvāṇāṃ vijñeyastvekaviṃśatiḥcatvāri viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulāni tukāryāḥhastamānena tanmadhye tāvannimnāyataṃ khanettṛtīyāṃśo bhavedatra tantre sarvatra cāṃguliḥaratnistaddvayena syāddhastastaddvayataḥ śiveṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulā sā syāt tanmānaiḥ kuṇḍakalpanamekā saḍaṃgulotsedhavistarā mekhalā matātasmātsamyak parīkṣyaivaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhamicchatāvakrakuṇḍe tu santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhalebhāryāvināśakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ proktaṃ yonyā vinā kṛtamśṛṅgārarahitaṃ yacca yajamānavināśakṛtvāgrodhaḥ kaṇṭhahīne syādasiddhirnyūnakhātakevyādhayaḥ saṃpravartante viyonau syādapasmṛtiḥcaturviṃśatikaṃ bhāgamaṃgulaṃ parikalpayetyoniṃ suśobhanāṃ kiñcinnimnāmunnālikāṃ śanaiḥkumbhadvayasamāyuktāmaśvatthadalasannibhāmaṣṭāṃgulaiśca vistīrṇā cāyatā dvādaśāṃgulaiḥmekhalārthaṃ pṛthagbhūmirna grāhyā bāhyataḥ priyevibhajya tena kartavyā mekhalākaṇṭhanābhayaḥpañcamasyāpi kuṇḍasya yonirdakṣiṇadiksthitātridvyekāṃgulavistāraṃ kramānnyūnāgramiṣyateaṣṭacchadaṃ sarojaṃ tu vidadhyāccāruvigrahamvistārādapi cotsedhaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaḍbhirudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattatkuṇḍānurūpaṃ vā mānamasya nigadyatedvitrivedāṃgulopetaḥ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu vardhayetnābhikṣetraṃ tridhā bhittvā tataḥ kurvīta karṇikāmpurā tasya vadhāyaiva sarve devāḥ samudyamamāvayostannirāsāya māmetyākathayaṃstathādarpaśāntirna cedasya viśvamāsīdupadrutamkhātvā tamavanau tasya śarīre sthāpayettathāniyojya teṣāṃ ye pūjāvimukhāstaiḥ kṛtāni tutasmātteṣāmarcanaṃ tu pratyabdaṃ kurvatāṃ sadākṛtvā samalatāṃ bhūmiṃ caturasrākṛtiṃ śubhāmcatuṣpadayute tasyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhe ca deśikaḥprādakṣiṇyena pūrvādi yajet koṣṭhacatuṣṭayekoṇārdhakoṣṭhayorekamekaṃ mantrī samarcayetsāvitraḥ savitā śakra indrajidrudratajjitaukoṇārdhakoṇapārśveṣu vahnyādīśāntamarcayetcarakiṃ ca vidāriṃ ca pūtānāṃ caiva deśikaḥīśānaścā (tha parjanyo jayantaḥ śakrabhāskarauagniḥ pūṣā ca vitatho yamo'tha gṛharakṣakaḥnir-ṛtiśca) tathā dauvārikaḥ sugrīvakastathāpaścimāśāsthakoṣṭheṣu pūjyā ete yathākramamargalo ditirapyevamaditiśca yathākramamcitrai rajobhirāpūrya devatānāṃ padāni vaiaṣṭottaraśataṃ cāṣṭottaraviṃśatimeva vābaliṃ ca teṣāṃ kurvīta pāyasairvyañjanānvitaiḥsvagehe vāstupūjāyāṃ maṇḍale tu samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na sarpapīḍā nānyonyakalahādyaśubhāni caarogī vijayī khyātaḥ ciraṃ jīvati tadgṛhesacivāmātyasenānībhavaneṣu pure tathāna ceduktānyathārūpaphalaiḥ kleśo'niśaṃ bhavetbījāropaṇakarmedaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvakāmadambhavane maṇḍale kuryādeke prāgvaruṇāyatampadāni dvādaśātra syusteṣu sthānatrayaṃ bhavetpītaraktasitaśyāmai rajobhirvahnipūrvakamvaiṣṇavyaḥ pālikāḥ proktāścaturviṃśāṃgulocchritāḥśaivāḥ śarāvāścatvāro bhānvaṃgulasamucchrayāḥśālipūrṇeṣu gandhādidarbhakūrcayuteṣu caśaṅkhasvanena nādaiśca pañcabhirbrāhmaṇāśiṣātāni priyaṃguśyāmākatilasarṣapaśālayaḥharidrābhiśca saṃsicya vastrairāchādayedguruḥtrividhasyāpi pātrasya saptasvapi dineṣu cadadhisaktvannamityuktaṃ pitṛbhyastilataṇḍulāḥcaturthe'hani nāgebhyo nārikelaghṛtāplutampadmākṣatāśca ṣaṣṭhe'hni śivāyāpūpasaṃyutamyadi syānnavarātraṃ ca tadobhayadine balimpraṇavādyairhṛdantaiḥ svanāmabhirbalimantrakaḥjyaiṣṭhe mṛtyupradā sā syādāṣāḍhe bandhunāśinīāśvine sarvasiddhiḥ syāt kārtike jñānadāyinīmāghe suvarṇalābhaḥ syāt phālgune sarvasiddhidāmaraṇaṃ bhavati jyaiṣṭhe cāṣāḍhe bandhunāśanamprajānāmāśvine māse sarvataḥ śubhameva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pauṣe jñānakṣayo māghe bhavenmedhāvivardhanammārgaphālgunake śreṣṭhā jyaiṣṭhe caiva tu sādhamāānandadā śrāvaṇe sā pauṣe bhādre ca ninditāśukle sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kṛṣṇe madhyamato bhavethastacitrāsvātimaitraviśākhāśca dhaniṣṭhayāsvātīrādhe revatī ca tathā cāpyuttarātrayampūrvāyāṃ daṇḍayedrājā maghāyāṃ mṛtyumādiśetpūrvāṣāḍhe bhayaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇe'nekarogadātrayodaśī ca daśamī praśastāa sarvakāmadādvādaśyāmapi kartavyaṃ trayodaśyāmathāpi vādaśamī śuklapakṣasya dvādaśī ca viśeṣataḥsaptamyāṃ dhanalābhaḥ syādaṣṭamyāṃ gurunāśanamekādaśyāṃ bhavellābho dhanasya vṛṣabhasya caśiṣyahāniścaturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsī tu siddhidācaturdaśī śivasyoktā vācaḥ proktā trayodaśīcaturthī gaṇanāthasya bhānoḥ proktā tu saptamīśanau mṛtyuḥ kṣayaṃ bhaume some sarvatra niṣphalamiti jñātvā varārohe mantraṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥbudhe'bhiyogarahitā gurau putrānvito bhavetiti jñātvā varārohe dīkṣāṃ dadyādviśāladhīḥsukarmā ca dhṛtirvṛddhirdhruvaḥ siddhiśca harṣaṇaḥpūrvābhādrapadā ṣaṣṭhī daśamī rohiṇī tathānakṣatralumpā ityete devānāmapi nāśadāḥśakunyādīni viṣṭiṃ ca viśeṣeṇa vivarjayetvṛṣe maraṇamāpnoti mithune'patyanāśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanyā lakṣmīpradā nityaṃ tulāyāṃ sarvasiddhayaḥmakaraḥ putradaḥ proktaḥ kumbho dhanasamṛddhidaḥmeṣe sarvasamṛddhiḥ syāt kanyā ratnapradā bhavetmakare putralābhaḥ syātkumbhe paśusamṛddhayaḥevaṃ lagnaphalaṃ jñātvā mantraṃ dadyād viśāladhiḥsukhadaṃ śubhadaṃ nityaṃ kanyādyaṃ sarvasiddhidamdīkṣāyāṃ tu śubhāḥ sarve randhrasthāḥ sarvanāśakāḥkṛṣṇe tārābalaṃ kuryāt svanāmādivicintanammadhyāhne sarvasiddhiḥ syāt sāyāhne sarvato bhaveddivā sarvaṃ prakurvīta siddhidaṃ paramaṃ smṛtamkṣepo dyūtabilapraveśagaṇanārambhāḥ prasiddhyanti cagrahaṇāddevadeveśi kālaḥ sapta dināvadhikālacarcā na kartavyā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥmantradīkṣāṃ prakurvāṇo māsarkṣādīnna śodhayetsūryagrahaṇakālena samo nānyaḥ kadācanana māsatithivārādiśodhanaṃ sūryaparvaṇisiddhirbhavati mantrasya vinābhyāsena vegataḥjanakasya tu dīkṣā dāridryaṃ saptajanmasumantramātrasya kathanamupadeśaḥ sa ucyayeyābhirvinā na labhyante sarvamantraphalāni vaitena dīkṣā iti proktāstāsāṃ tattvavicārakaiḥkalāmayī vedhamayī catasro jñānadāḥ śubhāḥpañcavādyaninādaiśca vedaghoṣaiḥ suhṛdvṛtaḥdatvā varaṇasāmagrīṃ saṃkalpya vṛṇuyādgurumgurutveneti sambhāṣya tvāmahaṃ ca tato vṛṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathocitaṃ guro karma kuruṣveti vadecchiśuḥtataḥ śiṣyeṇa sahito yāyādyāgagṛhaṃ guruḥhārakuṇḍalakeyuramudrikāṅgadabhūṣaṇaiḥmahārghavastratāmbūlaiḥ phalapuṣpasugandhakaiḥṛtvijo'pi tathābhyarcya vṛṇuyāduktasaṃkhyakānśrīparṇīvṛkṣapīṭhāni hastamānāniḥ mānataḥsaptaviṃśatidarbhāṇāṃ veṇyo'gre granthibhūṣitāḥsukhoṣṇodakasampūrṇāḥ pādyārthe tāmragaṇḍakāḥdūrvodakasamāyuktāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ pṛthakpṛthaksampuṭā madhuparkārthaṃ kāṃsyā daghyādipūritāḥmayūrapatracchatrāṇi soṣṇīṣāṇi samāharetanyatsmārte yadapyuktaṃ madhuparkasya pūjaneanyebhyo madhuparkasya viprebhyaḥ pūjanaṃ smṛtamanyairdvijaiḥ samaṃ yatra deśikasya prapūjanamdeśikendro vidhānena snātvā nirvatitāhnikaḥācāryaḥ pūrvadivase upaveśya samāsanedantān viśodhya purataḥ sthaṇḍile hastamātrakeīśānāgre jñānalābhaḥ prāgagre bhūtiruttamārākṣasāgre mṛtyubhayaṃ vāruṇyagre manaḥśucamamaṅgalasthānapāte prāyaścittaṃ samācaretkrūrasvapne'dhamā dīkṣā hyakrūre madhyamā matāvidhāyācamanaṃ tatra sāmānyārghyaṃ vidhāya catataśca deśiko vighnān divyānālokanena capārthivān pārṣṇighātaistattribhirutsārya yatnataḥutsāritānāṃ bhūtānāṃ dadadvartma tu dakṣiṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arghyāmbunā ca gavyena yāgasthāne susecitesamvīkṣya mūlamanunā hyastreṇa prokṣayet tataḥśrīkhaṇḍāgarucandraiśca bhūṣite'streṇa saptadhāsajalān vikirenmantrī pratyūhaghnān hi maṇḍalamāsanāya tu vārddhānyā īśāne sthāpayecca tānvedikāyāṃ likhet paścāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍalamdeśiko vedikāmadhye gomayenopalepitecatuṣkoṣṭhasamāyuktaṃ karṇasūtravibhūṣitamkoṇasthakoṣṭhamadhyeṣu dṛśyante matsyakā yathāmakareṣveṣu sūtrāṇi dadyāccatvāri mantravitmakarān pūrvavat kuryāt tatra sūtrāṇi pātayetprādurbhavanti ramyāṇi sūtrāṇyevaṃ vikāśayettadbahiḥ paritaḥ pīṭhamekapaṃktyā prakalpayettato'nyapaṃktiyugmena dvāraśobhā vidhānataḥatha vakṣye vidhānena sarojalekhanakramamtato vṛttatrayaṃ madhye kuryāt samyag yathāvidhiantyavṛttena patrāṇi patrāgrāṃstyakta bhāgataḥkiñjalkāgreṣu saṃsthāpya pārśvatastvardhacandrakāndalāgramānato vṛttaṃ kuryāt samyag vicakṣaṇaḥbahirekena kurvīta patrāgrāṇi vidhānavitsāmānyaṃ kamalaṃ hyetacchāstre sarvatra gīyateatiriktaiḥ padaiḥ pīṭhagātrāṇi racayettataḥkoṣṭhadvayena caikena pratyekaṃ dvārapārśvayoḥupaśobhāstataḥ koṣṭhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṇāni kalpayetniśārajo bhavetpītaṃ śuklaṃ taṇḍulajaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pulākadāhasaṃbhūtaṃ śyāmaṃ bilvacchadotthitamutsedhatārako rekhāḥ śuklā aṃgulamānataḥpītavarṇena cūrṇena karṇikāṃ pūrayettataḥśyāmena rajasā sandhiṃ mantraviccābhipūrayetkiñjalkān pītaraktena pīṭhagātrāṇi śubhrataḥpatramūlaphalākāramaṇḍitā hṛdayaṅgamāḥśubhreṇa rajasā dvāracatuṣkaṃ pūrayettataḥkṛṣṇavarṇena koṇāni bahī rekhātrayaṃ tataḥsāmānyaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetaduttamampūrvokte caturasre tu tāvat sūtrāṇi pātayetvedānvitaṃ tu tanmadhye padmaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā śubhampūrvavadvāraśobhā syādupaśobhātra nāsti vaianyatsarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ proktamaṇḍalavacchubhampātayet kramaśaḥ sūtraṃ yāvatkoṣṭhāni sarvataḥpadmaṃ caturbhiḥ koṣṭhaiḥ syāt kuryāt tatparitaḥ punaḥcatuṣkeṣu tu padmāni vidadhyānmantravittamaḥyāvatṣoḍaśa koṣṭhāni bhavantyetāni mārjayetrajobhiḥ śuklahāridraraktanīlaiḥ prapūrayetuditaṃ maṇḍalaṃ hyetannavanābhaṃ suśobhanammaṇḍalaṃ syāttu pañcābjaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradametanmaṇḍalamadhye tu kuryādanyatamaṃ budhaḥvedikāyāmāsane sa prāṅmukhaḥ saṃviśedathadeśikendrastu saṃsthāpya pūjopakaraṇāni tusugandhijalapūrṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanāya cavyajanaṃ mukuraṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ dikṣu mantravit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha kuryāt tālatrayaṃ budhaḥmahastu tata utpannaṃ rakṣayettaṃ hi sarvataḥnyāsādikaṃ tataḥ kuryāddeśiko yatamānasaḥdevatāṃ hṛdaye nyasya mūlamantrasya deśikaḥyasya mantrasya pañcāṅgaṃ netraṃ tasya vihīyatetattanmantroktamārgeṇa nyāsānanyān samācaretdehātmake tataḥ pīṭhe dhyāyenmantrasya devatāmjalena pūritāṃ dakṣe prokṣaṇīṃ sthāpayet tataḥpādyamācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca mantravitsvātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cānyatpūjopakaraṇādikamyogapīṭhaṃ samabhyarcya nyāsamārgeṇa mantravitdevatātmā tataḥ pañca kuryādvā sumanoñjalīnpūjayecca nivedyena rahitaiścandanādibhiḥsamāpayedidaṃ sarvaṃ prokṣaṇyadbhiḥ samācaretupacāraiścandanādyairmaṇḍalaṃ pūjayedguruḥdarbhāṃ nyaseduparyeṣāṃ sākṣataṃ kūrcakraṃ tataḥbrahmagranthiyutāstvagradeśe kūrca ihocyatesvarṇādiracitaṃ tatra kalaśaṃ chidravarjitamcandanāgurukarpūrairmadhye samyakpradhūpitamnava ratnāni niḥkṣipya kumbhe kūrcamathoparipuṣpaṃ nīlaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ vidrumaṃ mauktikaṃ tathāmauktikāni ca ratnāni deśikastantravittamaḥmūlamantraṃ japannante cintayannaikyamātmanaḥpañcāśadoṣadhikvāthaiḥ pūrayettadanantaramgandhapaṅkaprasūnādivāsitairvā śubhairjalaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhāṣṭakaṃ śubhaṃ mantrī sarvasamaptatpradāyakamkalādidevatārūpaṃ śaṅkhanīraṃ ghaṭe kṣipetsasihlakajaṭāmāṃsīsaṭībhiḥ śaktisambhavamsevyakaṃ ca jaṭāmāṃsī vaiṣṇavaṃ tadudīritamsurabhirbhūtagandhā ca kuṭhī gandhakuṭhī smṛtātamālāgarukarpūraiḥ śāmbhavaṃ cāṣṭagandhakamsaśaktikaṃ jalaṃ kumbhe bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥkalādvādaśakaṃ sauraṃ pūjayet tadanantaramvedādibhedasañjātāḥ kalāḥ pañcāśatairyutāḥmadhye madhye ṛcaḥ pañca pūjanīyā imā apivasurantamantrapadaṃ rikṣasaddhopadaṃ tataḥroṇasatpadamuccārya nṛṣadvarapade vadetvadejjā ṛtajetyasmādadrijāśabdamuccaretuktvā bṛhatpadaṃ vānte prathamo mantra īritaḥuktvā ṣṇuḥ stavate paścādvīryeṇa mṛpadaṃ vadetyasyoruṣu triṣu padaṃ tato vikramaṇeṣvadhitoyastho mādhavaḥ paścādvāntaṃ syāttāyaśāntiyukcaturmukhaḥ sacandrārdhastataḥ syācca yajāmahepadamurvārukamiva bandhanānmṛpadaṃ vadettoyasthā śālmalī proktā sahajāḍhāntaviṣṇuyukyatu tvaṣṭāpadaṃ paścāt tato rūpāṇi piṃśatugarbhaṃ dadhātviti padamāṣāḍhī padmanābhayukāvāhyādau kalāḥ paścāt sannidhāpya ca deśikaḥyatra yatra kalāpūjāvidhistatraivameva hikalādaśakamāvāhya sṛṣṭyādyāḥ sannidhāpya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00217 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā kalānāṃ pūjayecca tāḥnivṛttyādyāścāpi yajeduktayuktyā vicakṣaṇaḥśaktisāntāvamī sapta dhruvabhedāḥ samīritāḥsutrāmavallarīnaddhaiḥ kalpavṛkṣamanīpayāpaścādakṣatasaṃyuktāṃ saphalāṃ śubhacakrikāmkalpavṛkṣaphalānāṃ hi matyā viśadadhīrguruḥpradhānakumbhaṃ saṃsthāpya vedyāmevaṃ gurūttamaḥprāgvanmaṇḍalamālikhya padmaṃ cāṣṭadalaṃ śubhamdhruvaṃ dharāṃ vākpatiṃ ca vighneśaṃ teṣu pūjayetamṛtaṃ durjayaṃ caiva siddhārthaṃ maṅgalaṃ tathāpūrvādiṣvaṣṭakumbheṣu teṣāṃ mantraistu vaidikaiḥairāvataṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ vāmanaṃ kumudāñjanaupunarvedyāṃ gururgatvā upaviśya nijāsanetasyāṃ mūrtau samāvāhya pūjayediṣṭadevatāmnirgamayya ca caitanyaṃ nāsikāgravinirgatammastakāntaṃ samutthāpya tasyāmāvāhayet tataḥsannirodha ca sakalīkaraṇaṃ tvavaguṇṭhanamāsanādiprasūnāntānupacārān prakalpya casarvānte lokapālānāṃ tadastrāṇāṃ ca pūjanammaṅgalāṃkurapātrāṇi sthāpanīyāni mantriṇāsaṃsthāpya vahniṃ saṃskṛtya vaiśvadevaṃ samācaretmūlāṇunā tato hutvā sājyena haviṣā sudhīḥsampūjya tāṃ candanādyaiḥ pīṭhamūrtau tu yojayetpārṣadebhyaścandanādipuṣpākṣatasamanvitampunaryajeccopacāraiḥ pañcabhirdarśayet tataḥ
